title: 分散式共識服務
summary: 以Raft 狀態、quorum 與線性化證據連結 16 個技術單元，新增 32 步原理、架構、假想算例、實驗設計與失效驗證。 原有步驟及進度識別完整保留。
summaryEn: Sixteen technical units connect raft state, quorums and linearizability evidence through 32 new tasks covering principles, architecture, assumed calculations, experiment design and failure validation. Existing steps and progress identities are preserved.
scope: 公開原理的雙語工程教育；工作臺是概念模擬，不是特定廠商產品的完整模擬器。數值為自行設定的教學假設。實驗僅限離線模型、自己的隔離環境或明確授權的測試資料；不掃描或改動真實第三方系統，未測平臺保留未決。
scopeEn: Bilingual engineering education from public principles; the workbench is a conceptual simulation, not a complete simulator of any vendor product. Inputs are original teaching assumptions. Experiments use offline models, owned isolated environments or explicitly authorized test data, never scan/modify third-party systems and leave untested platforms unresolved.

stages.title: 故障模型與複製狀態
stages.description: 界定當機、延遲、狀態機與多數的保證範圍。
stages.descriptionEn: Define crashes, delays, state machines and majority guarantees.

steps.title: 界定共識服務的保證
steps.objective: 把一致決策與一般資料複製分開。
steps.objectiveEn: Separate agreed decisions from ordinary copying.
steps.instruction: 選一個配置鍵值服務；列出讀寫需求；畫三個副本；寫下同一日誌位置不可執行不同命令的不變量。
steps.instructionEn: Choose a configuration key-value service; list read/write needs; draw three replicas; state that one log position must not apply conflicting commands.
steps.observation: 副本內容暫時不同不必然代表已提交狀態衝突。
steps.observationEn: Temporary replica differences need not imply conflicting committed state.
steps.failure: 不要以「有三份」直接宣告一致性，補上提交規則。
steps.failureEn: Do not infer consistency from three copies; add commitment rules.
steps.check: 服務契約有資料模型及可檢查不變量。
steps.checkEn: The contract has a data model and testable invariant.

knowledge.title: 原理與限制
knowledge.text: 共識協調決策順序，複製只是必要機制之一。
knowledge.textEn: Consensus coordinates decision order; replication is one mechanism.

knowledge.title: 驗證與判讀
knowledge.text: 安全性與能否持續服務是不同問題。
knowledge.textEn: Safety and continued availability are different questions.

quiz.question: 三份資料是否自動構成共識？
quiz.questionEn: Do three copies automatically provide consensus?
options: 否，仍需決策與提交規則。
是，複製數量決定所有語義。
是，三台永遠不會失效。
optionsEn: No; decision and commitment rules are still needed.
Yes; copy count determines all semantics.
Yes; three machines cannot fail.
quiz.explanation: 否，仍需決策與提交規則。 共識協調決策順序，複製只是必要機制之一。
quiz.explanationEn: No; decision and commitment rules are still needed. Consensus coordinates decision order; replication is one mechanism.

steps.title: 建立當機與網路延遲模型
steps.objective: 明確 Raft 不處理的惡意行為。
steps.objectiveEn: State malicious behavior outside Raft's basic model.
steps.instruction: 畫正常、停機及慢訊息三情境；標出丟失、重排及重複訊息；另列任意偽造訊息的情境；將它標為不同信任模型。
steps.instructionEn: Draw normal, crashed and delayed-message cases; mark loss, reordering and duplication; list arbitrary forged messages separately; identify the different trust model.
steps.observation: 無法立即分辨停機與網路很慢。
steps.observationEn: A crash cannot always be immediately distinguished from a slow network.
steps.failure: 不把一般 Raft 描述為拜占庭容錯。
steps.failureEn: Do not describe ordinary Raft as Byzantine fault tolerant.
steps.check: 故障表明確列出涵蓋與不涵蓋項。
steps.checkEn: The failure table states covered and excluded cases.

knowledge.title: 原理與限制
knowledge.text: Raft 的基本保證建立在非拜占庭故障假設上。
knowledge.textEn: Basic Raft guarantees assume non-Byzantine failures.

knowledge.title: 驗證與判讀
knowledge.text: 逾時是懷疑訊號，不是停機的絕對證明。
knowledge.textEn: Timeout is suspicion, not proof of a crash.

quiz.question: 訊息逾時能證明遠端永久停機嗎？
quiz.questionEn: Does timeout prove permanent remote failure?
options: 能，網路沒有排隊。
不能，也可能是延遲或分割。
能，因此可忽略任期。
optionsEn: Yes; networks never queue.
No; delay or partition is also possible.
Yes; terms can therefore be ignored.
quiz.explanation: 不能，也可能是延遲或分割。 Raft 的基本保證建立在非拜占庭故障假設上。
quiz.explanationEn: No; delay or partition is also possible. Basic Raft guarantees assume non-Byzantine failures.

steps.title: 建立確定性的狀態機
steps.objective: 確保相同命令序列產生相同結果。
steps.objectiveEn: Ensure equal command sequences produce equal results.
steps.instruction: 定義 set 與 increment 命令；讓三副本由同一初始值開始；依同順序回放；再加入本地時間作輸入並找出分歧。
steps.instructionEn: Define set and increment commands; start three replicas identically; replay in the same order; add local time as an input and locate divergence.
steps.observation: 外部時間或隨機數未記錄時會造成不一致。
steps.observationEn: Unrecorded time or randomness can cause divergence.
steps.failure: 將非確定值先寫入命令資料，不在各副本臨時生成。
steps.failureEn: Record nondeterministic values in command data rather than generating them per replica.
steps.check: 三份狀態與每一步命令可重放對照。
steps.checkEn: All three states and each command can be replayed.

knowledge.title: 原理與限制
knowledge.text: 複製狀態機依賴確定的應用結果。
knowledge.textEn: Replicated state machines rely on deterministic application.

knowledge.title: 驗證與判讀
knowledge.text: 一致的日誌無法補救不確定的應用邏輯。
knowledge.textEn: An agreed log cannot fix nondeterministic application logic.

quiz.question: 相同日誌但各自讀取當下時間有何風險？
quiz.questionEn: What if replicas read local time despite sharing a log?
options: 必然更一致。
可省略命令順序。
狀態結果可能不同。
optionsEn: Consistency necessarily improves.
Command order becomes unnecessary.
State results may diverge.
quiz.explanation: 狀態結果可能不同。 複製狀態機依賴確定的應用結果。
quiz.explanationEn: State results may diverge. Replicated state machines rely on deterministic application.

steps.title: 計算三台與五台的多數
steps.titleEn: Compute majorities for three and five nodes
steps.objective: 以集合交集理解容錯。
steps.objectiveEn: Understand fault tolerance through quorum intersection.
steps.instruction: 列出三台的所有兩台集合；比較任兩集合交集；再算五台的三票多數；移除不同數量節點檢查能否形成多數。
steps.instructionEn: List all two-member sets from three nodes; compare intersections; calculate three-vote majorities for five; remove nodes and check quorum availability.
steps.observation: 多數交集支持已決定資訊跨任期保存。
steps.observationEn: Majority intersection helps retain decided information across terms.
steps.failure: 不要把「活著的節點過半」取代既定投票成員多數。
steps.failureEn: Do not redefine quorum as a majority of currently reachable members.
steps.check: 表格正確顯示三台需二票、五台需三票。
steps.checkEn: Show that three members need two votes and five need three.

knowledge.title: 原理與限制
knowledge.text: 多數是相對於叢集的投票成員配置。
knowledge.textEn: A majority is defined by the voting membership configuration.

knowledge.title: 驗證與判讀
knowledge.text: 失去多數時可停止進展以保持安全性。
knowledge.textEn: Without a majority, progress can stop to preserve safety.

quiz.question: 五投票成員只剩兩台可通訊，能提交新寫入嗎？
quiz.questionEn: Can two reachable members of five commit a new write?
options: 不能，未達三票多數。
能，因為兩台互相同意。
能，將失聯者自動刪除即可。
optionsEn: No; three votes are required.
Yes; they agree with each other.
Yes; automatically delete unreachable members.
quiz.explanation: 不能，未達三票多數。 多數是相對於叢集的投票成員配置。
quiz.explanationEn: No; three votes are required. A majority is defined by the voting membership configuration.

steps.title: 區分記錄、提交與套用
steps.objective: 避免以本地寫入冒充服務完成。
steps.objectiveEn: Avoid treating local append as completed service.
steps.instruction: 畫客戶端到領導者再到跟隨者的時序；標本地保存、符合提交條件及套用三點；放入一個只到領導者的命令；判斷可否回覆成功。
steps.instructionEn: Draw client-to-leader-to-follower timing; mark local persistence, valid commitment and application; add a leader-only entry; decide whether success is justified.
steps.observation: 日誌存在於某台不等於已提交。
steps.observationEn: An entry on one node is not necessarily committed.
steps.failure: 若直接以收到請求回成功，回到服務契約檢查耐久語義。
steps.failureEn: Check durability semantics if success is returned on receipt alone.
steps.check: 時序圖三狀態清楚且回覆位置有理由。
steps.checkEn: Distinguish all three states and justify response timing.

knowledge.title: 原理與限制
knowledge.text: 提交與套用是不同邊界。
knowledge.textEn: Commitment and application are distinct boundaries.

knowledge.title: 驗證與判讀
knowledge.text: 成功回覆必須符合對外 API 承諾。
knowledge.textEn: Success responses must satisfy the external API contract.

quiz.question: 領導者已寫入本地就必定已提交嗎？
quiz.questionEn: Does local leader persistence necessarily imply commitment?
options: 一定，本地磁碟就是多數。
不一定，還需協定提交條件。
一定，客戶端已送出就算完成。
optionsEn: Yes; one disk is a majority.
No; protocol commitment conditions still apply.
Yes; sending means completion.
quiz.explanation: 不一定，還需協定提交條件。 提交與套用是不同邊界。
quiz.explanationEn: No; protocol commitment conditions still apply. Commitment and application are distinct boundaries.

steps.title: 建立節點持久狀態帳本
steps.objective: 理解重啟後需保留的協定資訊。
steps.objectiveEn: Identify protocol information that must survive restart.
steps.instruction: 為節點畫 currentTerm、votedFor 與 log 三欄；模擬投票後重啟；比較保留與遺失投票資訊；指出哪種情況可能重複投票。
steps.instructionEn: Track currentTerm, votedFor and log; simulate restart after voting; compare retained and lost vote state; identify potential double voting.
steps.observation: 應答前保存的順序會影響正確性。
steps.observationEn: Persistence-before-response order affects correctness.
steps.failure: 不要只備份鍵值資料卻忽略協定狀態語義。
steps.failureEn: Do not equate key-value backup with all protocol-state semantics.
steps.check: 帳本標出何時保存、何時回覆及重啟讀回。
steps.checkEn: Mark persistence, response and restart recovery points.

knowledge.title: 原理與限制
knowledge.text: Raft 的任期、投票與日誌含必要持久狀態。
knowledge.textEn: Raft terms, votes and logs include necessary persistent state.

knowledge.title: 驗證與判讀
knowledge.text: 磁碟寫入成功的定義須符合系統耐久假設。
knowledge.textEn: A successful write must meet the durability assumptions.

quiz.question: 投票記錄遺失後重啟可能造成什麼？
quiz.questionEn: What can losing vote state across restart cause?
options: 自動提高共識可靠度。
使多數要求永久降低。
同任期不當重複投票的風險。
optionsEn: Automatically stronger consensus.
A permanently smaller quorum.
Risk of an improper second vote in the same term.
quiz.explanation: 同任期不當重複投票的風險。 Raft 的任期、投票與日誌含必要持久狀態。
quiz.explanationEn: Risk of an improper second vote in the same term. Raft terms, votes and logs include necessary persistent state.

stages.title: 選舉、日誌與提交
stages.description: 依任期與日誌規則逐一回放訊息。
stages.descriptionEn: Replay messages against term and log rules.

steps.title: 回放任期與領導者選舉
steps.objective: 按任期區分過期訊息。
steps.objectiveEn: Distinguish stale messages by term.
steps.instruction: 畫三節點的 follower、candidate、leader 狀態；觸發一個教學逾時；逐張傳送票卡；加入舊任期訊息並標出應拒絕處。
steps.instructionEn: Draw follower, candidate and leader states for three nodes; trigger a teaching timeout; deliver vote cards individually; add an old-term message and mark rejection.
steps.observation: 新任期訊息會改變節點對領導權的認知。
steps.observationEn: Newer terms change a node's view of leadership.
steps.failure: 不以機器名稱或實體時間決定任期較新。
steps.failureEn: Do not decide term order from machine names or wall clocks.
steps.check: 每一步記錄任期、角色與投票。
steps.checkEn: Record term, role and vote at every step.

knowledge.title: 原理與限制
knowledge.text: 任期是協定的邏輯次序。
knowledge.textEn: Terms provide protocol logical ordering.

knowledge.title: 驗證與判讀
knowledge.text: 角色轉換需依訊息與協定條件。
knowledge.textEn: Role transitions follow messages and protocol conditions.

quiz.question: 舊任期領導者的訊息可覆蓋新任期嗎？
quiz.questionEn: Can an old leader overwrite a newer term?
options: 不能，應按任期規則處理。
可以，只要名稱排序較前。
可以，只要傳送速度較快。
optionsEn: No; apply the term rules.
Yes, if its name sorts earlier.
Yes, if it sends faster.
quiz.explanation: 不能，應按任期規則處理。 任期是協定的邏輯次序。
quiz.explanationEn: No; apply the term rules. Terms provide protocol logical ordering.

steps.title: 檢查候選者日誌新舊
steps.objective: 避免遺漏已決定的歷史。
steps.objectiveEn: Avoid electing a candidate that loses decided history.
steps.instruction: 給三節點不同最後任期與索引；先比較最後任期；相同時再比較索引；為每個投票決定寫理由。
steps.instructionEn: Assign different last-log terms and indexes; compare last terms first; use indexes when terms tie; justify each vote.
steps.observation: 日誌比較不是只數項目最多。
steps.observationEn: Log freshness is not simply the largest entry count.
steps.failure: 若只按索引投票，重新比較最後項的任期。
steps.failureEn: Compare final-entry terms before an index-only vote.
steps.check: 所有投票都能依相同排序規則重現。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce each vote with the same ordering rule.

knowledge.title: 原理與限制
knowledge.text: Raft 選舉限制候選者日誌的足夠新鮮度。
knowledge.textEn: Raft restricts candidate log freshness.

knowledge.title: 驗證與判讀
knowledge.text: 任期優先於最後索引的比較可避免錯誤直覺。
knowledge.textEn: Term-before-index ordering prevents misleading length-only intuition.

quiz.question: 最後索引較大一定比較新嗎？
quiz.questionEn: Is a larger final index always more up to date?
options: 是，日誌只看長度。
否，還須先比較最後任期。
是，任期只供顯示。
optionsEn: Yes; only length matters.
No; compare the final term first.
Yes; terms are decorative.
quiz.explanation: 否，還須先比較最後任期。 Raft 選舉限制候選者日誌的足夠新鮮度。
quiz.explanationEn: No; compare the final term first. Raft restricts candidate log freshness.

steps.title: 驗證日誌前綴匹配
steps.objective: 用索引與任期定位衝突。
steps.objectiveEn: Locate conflicts with index and term.
steps.instruction: 畫領導者與跟隨者日誌；為一次 AppendEntries 填前項索引與任期；製造一個不匹配；回退到共同前綴再推演更新。
steps.instructionEn: Draw leader and follower logs; fill previous index and term for AppendEntries; introduce a mismatch; return to the common prefix and replay the update.
steps.observation: 相同索引可以在未提交部分含不同內容。
steps.observationEn: The same index can differ in uncommitted suffixes.
steps.failure: 不要合併兩份衝突命令為同一位置。
steps.failureEn: Do not merge conflicting commands into one position.
steps.check: 回放保留共同前綴並解釋衝突處理。
steps.checkEn: Preserve the common prefix and explain conflict handling.

knowledge.title: 原理與限制
knowledge.text: Raft 用前項匹配檢查日誌連續性。
knowledge.textEn: Raft checks continuity using preceding-entry matching.

knowledge.title: 驗證與判讀
knowledge.text: 未提交尾端與已提交歷史有不同處理限制。
knowledge.textEn: Uncommitted suffixes and committed history have different constraints.

quiz.question: 索引相同就能直接接受新項嗎？
quiz.questionEn: Does a matching index alone justify acceptance?
options: 可以，任期永不變。
可以，命令內容不重要。
不能，還需匹配任期等條件。
optionsEn: Yes; terms never change.
Yes; command content is irrelevant.
No; matching term and other conditions matter.
quiz.explanation: 不能，還需匹配任期等條件。 Raft 用前項匹配檢查日誌連續性。
quiz.explanationEn: No; matching term and other conditions matter. Raft checks continuity using preceding-entry matching.

steps.title: 辨認當前任期提交規則
steps.objective: 避免只按任意多數副本計算提交。
steps.objectiveEn: Avoid committing arbitrary old entries by replica count alone.
steps.instruction: 建立含舊任期項的三節點日誌；標出新領導者任期；比較只複製舊項與提交一個當前任期項；追蹤被涵蓋的前綴。
steps.instructionEn: Build three logs containing an older-term entry; mark the new leader's term; compare copying that old entry with committing a current-term entry; track the implied prefix.
steps.observation: 舊項已在多數出現不等於可直接套用同一計數規則。
steps.observationEn: An old entry appearing on a majority does not permit the same direct counting rule.
steps.failure: 務必依原論文限制，不把所有多數副本都標成已提交。
steps.failureEn: Follow the paper's restriction; do not mark every majority-held entry committed.
steps.check: 回放清楚分辨直接提交及隨前綴成為已提交。
steps.checkEn: Distinguish direct commitment from commitment through the prefix.

knowledge.title: 原理與限制
knowledge.text: Raft 領導者以副本數推進提交時需檢查當前任期。
knowledge.textEn: A Raft leader advancing commitment by counting replicas checks the current term.

knowledge.title: 驗證與判讀
knowledge.text: 正確提交新任期項可同時確立前序項。
knowledge.textEn: Committing a current-term entry also establishes prior entries.

quiz.question: 舊任期項只要多數持有就能直接按相同規則提交嗎？
quiz.questionEn: Can an older-term entry always be directly committed by the same majority rule?
options: 不能，需遵守當前任期限制。
能，任期與安全性無關。
能，只要磁碟容量足夠。
optionsEn: No; the current-term restriction matters.
Yes; term is unrelated to safety.
Yes, if disk space is sufficient.
quiz.explanation: 不能，需遵守當前任期限制。 Raft 領導者以副本數推進提交時需檢查當前任期。
quiz.explanationEn: No; the current-term restriction matters. A Raft leader advancing commitment by counting replicas checks the current term.

steps.title: 回放網路分割與舊領導者
steps.titleEn: Replay a partition and a stale leader
steps.objective: 理解一致性與可用性的分離。
steps.objectiveEn: Understand the separation of safety and availability.
steps.instruction: 把五節點分成三與二；將舊領導者放少數側；在兩側各送一請求；記錄誰能形成多數，恢復連線後再比較日誌。
steps.instructionEn: Partition five nodes into three and two; place the old leader in the minority; submit a request on each side; track quorum formation and reconcile after healing.
steps.observation: 自認領導者不等於有能力提交。
steps.observationEn: Believing oneself leader does not imply commitment ability.
steps.failure: 不讓少數側自行改小成員數以繞過多數。
steps.failureEn: Do not let the minority shrink membership to bypass quorum.
steps.check: 兩側提交結果與恢復後狀態不違反不變量。
steps.checkEn: Commit results and post-healing state preserve the invariant.

knowledge.title: 原理與限制
knowledge.text: 少數分區無法取得原配置多數。
knowledge.textEn: A minority partition cannot obtain the original configuration's quorum.

knowledge.title: 驗證與判讀
knowledge.text: 暫時停止寫入可防止互相衝突的決定。
knowledge.textEn: Temporarily stopping writes can prevent conflicting decisions.

quiz.question: 少數側舊領導者可只靠自己承諾新寫入嗎？
quiz.questionEn: Can an isolated minority leader commit alone?
options: 可以，領導者權限無限制。
不能，仍需多數。
可以，將逾時視為同意。
optionsEn: Yes; leadership is unlimited.
No; a majority is still required.
Yes; interpret timeout as approval.
quiz.explanation: 不能，仍需多數。 少數分區無法取得原配置多數。
quiz.explanationEn: No; a majority is still required. A minority partition cannot obtain the original configuration's quorum.

steps.title: 設計重複與亂序訊息測試
steps.objective: 檢查協定是否依內容而非到達次序。
steps.objectiveEn: Check protocol decisions beyond arrival order.
steps.instruction: 複製一張舊回覆卡；將兩張訊息交換順序；重播同一批訊息；檢查任期、索引與已提交狀態是否保持一致。
steps.instructionEn: Duplicate an old reply; swap two messages; replay the batch; check terms, indexes and committed state for consistency.
steps.observation: 最晚到達的訊息不一定最新。
steps.observationEn: The last message to arrive need not be newest.
steps.failure: 若以到達時間覆寫狀態，補上任期及索引比較。
steps.failureEn: Add term and index checks if arrival order overwrites state.
steps.check: 測試紀錄包含原順序與擾動順序的結果。
steps.checkEn: Record outcomes for original and perturbed schedules.

knowledge.title: 原理與限制
knowledge.text: 網路重複及重排是協定需面對的情境。
knowledge.textEn: Duplicates and reordering are protocol concerns.

knowledge.title: 驗證與判讀
knowledge.text: 不變量應在每一步成立，而非只看最終畫面。
knowledge.textEn: Invariants should hold at each step, not only in the final display.

quiz.question: 最後到的回覆一定代表最新狀態嗎？
quiz.questionEn: Does the latest arrival always represent the newest state?
options: 是，傳輸時間等於邏輯時間。
是，只要資料包較大。
否，要檢查任期與索引。
optionsEn: Yes; transit order equals logical time.
Yes, if the packet is larger.
No; check term and index.
quiz.explanation: 否，要檢查任期與索引。 網路重複及重排是協定需面對的情境。
quiz.explanationEn: No; check term and index. Duplicates and reordering are protocol concerns.

stages.title: 讀寫語義與成員維護
stages.description: 檢查 API、重試、watch 與成員變更的邊界。
stages.descriptionEn: Check API, retries, watches and membership boundaries.

steps.title: 比較線性化與可陳舊讀取
steps.titleEn: Compare linearizable and potentially stale reads
steps.objective: 依應用契約選擇讀取語義。
steps.objectiveEn: Choose read semantics from the application contract.
steps.instruction: 畫寫入成功後再讀取的時間線；讓一個跟隨者落後；比較需確認最新狀態與容許舊值的讀取；為配置與統計快取各選語義。
steps.instructionEn: Draw a completed write followed by a read; lag one follower; compare freshness-checked and stale-permitted reads; choose semantics for configuration and statistical caches.
steps.observation: 較低延遲讀取可能付出新鮮度代價。
steps.observationEn: Lower-latency reads may trade away freshness.
steps.failure: 不將 watch 或任意本地讀取直接標為線性化。
steps.failureEn: Do not label watches or arbitrary local reads linearizable.
steps.check: 時間線能說明哪些舊值違反所選契約。
steps.checkEn: The timeline identifies stale values violating the selected contract.

knowledge.title: 原理與限制
knowledge.text: 線性化與實際時間先後有關。
knowledge.textEn: Linearizability constrains real-time ordering.

knowledge.title: 驗證與判讀
knowledge.text: etcd 的 serializable 讀取選項可能回傳相對多數較舊的值。
knowledge.textEn: etcd's serializable read option may return data stale relative to quorum.

quiz.question: 完成寫入後的強一致讀取可任意讀落後副本嗎？
quiz.questionEn: Can a strong read after completed write use an arbitrary lagging replica?
options: 不能，需滿足新鮮度保證。
可以，所有副本永遠同步。
可以，只要有 TLS。
optionsEn: No; freshness guarantees must hold.
Yes; all replicas are always synchronized.
Yes, provided TLS is used.
quiz.explanation: 不能，需滿足新鮮度保證。 線性化與實際時間先後有關。
quiz.explanationEn: No; freshness guarantees must hold. Linearizability constrains real-time ordering.

steps.title: 處理逾時與重試的不確定性
steps.objective: 避免把未知結果當失敗後重做。
steps.objectiveEn: Avoid treating unknown outcome as definite failure.
steps.instruction: 模擬寫入已提交但回覆遺失；讓客戶端重試 increment；比較有無請求識別碼；設計重複請求的結果查詢紀錄。
steps.instructionEn: Commit a write but lose its response; retry an increment; compare with and without request IDs; design result lookup for duplicates.
steps.observation: 客戶端逾時時操作可能已成功。
steps.observationEn: An operation may have succeeded despite client timeout.
steps.failure: 不宣稱共識自動提供所有應用的恰好一次語義。
steps.failureEn: Do not claim consensus automatically gives every application exactly-once semantics.
steps.check: 案例能避免無意重複業務效果。
steps.checkEn: The design prevents unintended duplicate business effects.

knowledge.title: 原理與限制
knowledge.text: 傳输不確定性與提交狀態是不同問題。
knowledge.textEn: Transport uncertainty and commitment are separate issues.

knowledge.title: 驗證與判讀
knowledge.text: 應用需明確設計冪等或重複偵測。
knowledge.textEn: Applications need explicit idempotency or deduplication.

quiz.question: 收到逾時能否確定操作未發生？
quiz.questionEn: Does timeout prove the operation did not happen?
options: 能，所以立即重做一定安全。
不能，結果可能未知。
能，伺服器必定已回滾。
optionsEn: Yes; immediate repetition is always safe.
No; the outcome may be unknown.
Yes; the server must have rolled back.
quiz.explanation: 不能，結果可能未知。 傳输不確定性與提交狀態是不同問題。
quiz.explanationEn: No; the outcome may be unknown. Transport uncertainty and commitment are separate issues.

steps.title: 用比較交換保護更新
steps.objective: 防止讀後寫覆蓋他人修改。
steps.objectiveEn: Prevent read-modify-write from overwriting another update.
steps.instruction: 讓兩客戶端讀相同版本；各提出不同修改；先執行無條件更新；再以版本條件重演並記錄拒絕的一方。
steps.instructionEn: Let two clients read the same version; propose different edits; perform unconditional writes; replay with a version condition and record the rejected update.
steps.observation: 共識可排序寫入，但無條件覆蓋仍可能違反業務意圖。
steps.observationEn: Consensus orders writes, but unconditional overwrites can still violate intent.
steps.failure: 不要把伺服器一致性當成自動解決所有應用競爭。
steps.failureEn: Do not equate server consistency with automatic resolution of all application races.
steps.check: 回放顯示衝突被顯式識別而非悄悄遺失。
steps.checkEn: The replay exposes conflicts instead of silently losing updates.

knowledge.title: 原理與限制
knowledge.text: 條件交易將預期版本納入寫入判斷。
knowledge.textEn: Conditional transactions include the expected version in the write decision.

knowledge.title: 驗證與判讀
knowledge.text: 業務不變量需由應用和儲存語義共同維持。
knowledge.textEn: Business invariants need application logic and storage semantics together.

quiz.question: 為何一致資料庫仍可能遺失使用者修改？
quiz.questionEn: Why can a consistent store still lose a user's intended edit?
options: 因為共識完全沒有順序。
因為版本檢查一定無效。
無條件覆寫可按順序覆蓋先前修改。
optionsEn: Because consensus has no ordering.
Because version checks never work.
Ordered unconditional writes can overwrite earlier edits.
quiz.explanation: 無條件覆寫可按順序覆蓋先前修改。 條件交易將預期版本納入寫入判斷。
quiz.explanationEn: Ordered unconditional writes can overwrite earlier edits. Conditional transactions include the expected version in the write decision.

steps.title: 規劃 watch 中斷與歷史壓縮
steps.objective: 處理事件歷史已不再保留的情況。
steps.objectiveEn: Handle event history that is no longer retained.
steps.instruction: 畫 revision 逐次增加的事件列；中斷一個觀察者；壓縮部分舊歷史；分別推演可續看與需重新取得快照的情境。
steps.instructionEn: Draw increasing revisions; disconnect a watcher; compact older history; replay cases that can resume and those needing a fresh snapshot.
steps.observation: 快取必須知道自己最後確認的 revision。
steps.observationEn: A cache needs its last confirmed revision.
steps.failure: 不把壓縮後不存在的歷史當成空事件。
steps.failureEn: Do not interpret unavailable compacted history as no events.
steps.check: 重連流程明確區分續看與重建快取。
steps.checkEn: The reconnection plan distinguishes resume from cache rebuild.

knowledge.title: 原理與限制
knowledge.text: watch 的可恢復性受到保留歷史範圍限制。
knowledge.textEn: Watch resumption is limited by retained history.

knowledge.title: 驗證與判讀
knowledge.text: watch 本身不等同線性化讀取保證。
knowledge.textEn: A watch is not itself a linearizable-read guarantee.

quiz.question: 需要的 revision 已被壓縮時應如何處理？
quiz.questionEn: What if the required revision has been compacted?
options: 重新同步狀態並建立新的觀察起點。
假裝中間沒有任何變更。
只把本地 revision 任意加一。
optionsEn: Resynchronize state and establish a new watch point.
Assume no intervening changes.
Increment the local revision arbitrarily.
quiz.explanation: 重新同步狀態並建立新的觀察起點。 watch 的可恢復性受到保留歷史範圍限制。
quiz.explanationEn: Resynchronize state and establish a new watch point. Watch resumption is limited by retained history.

steps.title: 以 learner 規劃擴容
steps.objective: 避免追趕新節點時提前改變多數條件。
steps.objectiveEn: Avoid changing quorum before a new node catches up.
steps.instruction: 畫三投票成員及一非投票 learner；追蹤 learner 的落後索引；比較直接增加投票者的情境；列出提升前需驗證的狀態。
steps.instructionEn: Draw three voters and one nonvoting learner; track the learner's lag; compare immediately adding a voter; list checks before promotion.
steps.observation: 非投票複製者可先追趕而不增加當前多數門檻。
steps.observationEn: A nonvoter can catch up without increasing the current quorum threshold.
steps.failure: 不讓 learner 自動被當成已可投票成員。
steps.failureEn: Do not silently count a learner as a voter.
steps.check: 配置表在每階段列出投票者及多數數目。
steps.checkEn: List voters and quorum size at every stage.

knowledge.title: 原理與限制
knowledge.text: 成員變更會影響協定的多數定義。
knowledge.textEn: Membership changes affect quorum definitions.

knowledge.title: 驗證與判讀
knowledge.text: etcd learner 需追上後經受控提升。
knowledge.textEn: An etcd learner catches up before controlled promotion.

quiz.question: learner 剛加入時是否計入投票多數？
quiz.questionEn: Does a newly added learner count toward voting quorum?
options: 計入，只要網路接通。
不計入，直到正式提升。
計入，只要有磁碟。
optionsEn: Yes, once connected.
No, until promoted.
Yes, once it has a disk.
quiz.explanation: 不計入，直到正式提升。 成員變更會影響協定的多數定義。
quiz.explanationEn: No, until promoted. Membership changes affect quorum definitions.

steps.title: 比較機器故障與共同故障域
steps.titleEn: Compare machine failures and shared failure domains
steps.objective: 避免把節點數誤當獨立性。
steps.objectiveEn: Avoid equating node count with independence.
steps.instruction: 把五節點分配到三個機房；列供電與網路共用項；模擬失去一個機房；重新算剩餘多數，另比較跨區延遲。
steps.instructionEn: Place five nodes across three sites; list shared power and network dependencies; lose one site; recalculate quorum and compare intersite latency.
steps.observation: 節點分散可以減少共同失效，但增加通訊成本。
steps.observationEn: Distribution can reduce shared failure but add communication cost.
steps.failure: 不只看伺服器數，還需看多數分布。
steps.failureEn: Inspect quorum placement, not just server count.
steps.check: 方案同時記錄失效容忍與延遲假設。
steps.checkEn: Record both failure tolerance and latency assumptions.

knowledge.title: 原理與限制
knowledge.text: 容錯數只在故障假設與成員配置內成立。
knowledge.textEn: Failure counts hold within their assumptions and membership configuration.

knowledge.title: 驗證與判讀
knowledge.text: 可用率設計需考慮共同故障域。
knowledge.textEn: Availability design must consider shared failure domains.

quiz.question: 五台都放同一機房可抵抗整個機房失效嗎？
quiz.questionEn: Can five nodes in one site survive losing that site?
options: 能，五台永遠剩三台。
能，Raft 會重建停電機房。
不能，存在共同故障域。
optionsEn: Yes; five always leave three.
Yes; Raft recreates a powered-off site.
No; the site is a shared failure domain.
quiz.explanation: 不能，存在共同故障域。 容錯數只在故障假設與成員配置內成立。
quiz.explanationEn: No; the site is a shared failure domain. Failure counts hold within their assumptions and membership configuration.

stages.title: 效能、復原與驗證
stages.description: 以延遲分布、隔離復原與故障矩陣驗證服務。
stages.descriptionEn: Verify service with latency distributions, isolated recovery and failure matrices.

steps.title: 拆解提交延遲
steps.objective: 找出網路與磁碟瓶頸。
steps.objectiveEn: Locate network and storage bottlenecks.
steps.instruction: 畫接收、日誌持久化、複製與回覆時間線；填假設延遲；比較快速平均但慢尾端磁碟；指出哪個多數完成時刻控制本次提交。
steps.instructionEn: Draw receipt, persistence, replication and response timing; add hypothetical delays; compare fast average but slow-tail storage; identify the quorum-completion time for the request.
steps.observation: 平均 IOPS 不足以描述持久寫入尾端延遲。
steps.observationEn: Average IOPS does not characterize durable-write tail latency.
steps.failure: 不把吞吐量數字直接當單次回應延遲。
steps.failureEn: Do not equate throughput with individual response latency.
steps.check: 時間帳本區分排隊、網路與儲存。
steps.checkEn: Separate queueing, network and storage time.

knowledge.title: 原理與限制
knowledge.text: 共識提交需要通訊及持久儲存。
knowledge.textEn: Consensus commitment needs communication and durable storage.

knowledge.title: 驗證與判讀
knowledge.text: 尾端延遲可影響請求與叢集穩定。
knowledge.textEn: Tail latency can affect requests and cluster stability.

quiz.question: 磁碟平均速度快就一定適合嗎？
quiz.questionEn: Does a fast average disk rate prove suitability?
options: 不一定，須量測持久化與尾端延遲。
一定，所有寫入時間相同。
一定，Raft 不使用磁碟。
optionsEn: No; measure durable writes and tail latency.
Yes; every write takes the same time.
Yes; Raft does not use disks.
quiz.explanation: 不一定，須量測持久化與尾端延遲。 共識提交需要通訊及持久儲存。
quiz.explanationEn: No; measure durable writes and tail latency. Consensus commitment needs communication and durable storage.

steps.title: 建立負載與延遲分布
steps.objective: 避免用單一平均掩蓋使用者體驗。
steps.objectiveEn: Avoid hiding user experience behind one mean.
steps.instruction: 設計讀寫比與資料大小兩項變因；為三種假設負載畫延遲分布；比較中位與尾端；同時記錄錯誤率及排隊長度。
steps.instructionEn: Vary read/write ratio and value size; draw latency distributions for three hypothetical loads; compare median and tail; record errors and queue length.
steps.observation: 吞吐上升時尾端延遲可能先惡化。
steps.observationEn: Tail latency can worsen before throughput stops increasing.
steps.failure: 只報成功請求延遲會漏掉失敗，補上錯誤率。
steps.failureEn: Include error rates rather than latency only for successful requests.
steps.check: 比較固定硬體及語義，並標明工作負載。
steps.checkEn: Keep hardware and semantics fixed and state the workload.

knowledge.title: 原理與限制
knowledge.text: 效能結論與工作負載密切相關。
knowledge.textEn: Performance conclusions depend strongly on workload.

knowledge.title: 驗證與判讀
knowledge.text: 百分位需足夠樣本與明確量測區間。
knowledge.textEn: Percentiles need adequate samples and defined measurement intervals.

quiz.question: 只比較平均延遲有何限制？
quiz.questionEn: What limits average-latency comparison?
options: 可完整描述所有使用者。
可能掩蓋慢尾端與失敗請求。
能取代所有負載說明。
optionsEn: It describes every user completely.
It can hide slow tails and failures.
It replaces workload description.
quiz.explanation: 可能掩蓋慢尾端與失敗請求。 效能結論與工作負載密切相關。
quiz.explanationEn: It can hide slow tails and failures. Performance conclusions depend strongly on workload.

steps.title: 區分快照、壓縮與備份
steps.objective: 辨認節省空間與災難復原的不同目的。
steps.objectiveEn: Separate space reduction from disaster recovery.
steps.instruction: 畫日誌、當前狀態及外部備份三區；標示歷史壓縮移除什麼；標示快照保存什麼；模擬誤刪資料後比較只剩副本與保有備份。
steps.instructionEn: Draw log, current state and external backup; mark what compaction removes; mark snapshot contents; compare accidental deletion with replicas only versus retained backup.
steps.observation: 一致複製也會把錯誤刪除傳到所有副本。
steps.observationEn: Consistent replication also propagates accidental deletion.
steps.failure: 不把三副本當作歷史備份策略。
steps.failureEn: Do not treat three replicas as a historical backup strategy.
steps.check: 說明每種機制可處理與不能處理的問題。
steps.checkEn: State what each mechanism does and cannot address.

knowledge.title: 原理與限制
knowledge.text: 高可用與備份處理不同風險。
knowledge.textEn: High availability and backups address different risks.

knowledge.title: 驗證與判讀
knowledge.text: 快照是否可用需驗證內容、版本與完整性。
knowledge.textEn: Usable snapshots require content, version and integrity checks.

quiz.question: 多副本能自動復原已提交的誤刪嗎？
quiz.questionEn: Can replicas automatically undo a committed accidental deletion?
options: 能，副本永遠保留所有歷史。
能，只需加第四台。
不能，通常都複製了同一刪除。
optionsEn: Yes; replicas retain all history forever.
Yes; just add a fourth node.
No; they usually replicated that deletion.
quiz.explanation: 不能，通常都複製了同一刪除。 高可用與備份處理不同風險。
quiz.explanationEn: No; they usually replicated that deletion. High availability and backups address different risks.

steps.title: 在隔離環境規劃復原演練
steps.objective: 證明備份可以還原而非只是存在。
steps.objectiveEn: Demonstrate restorability rather than backup existence.
steps.instruction: 選一份教學快照及預期鍵值摘要；畫與正式服務隔離的新叢集；檢查還原後資料及客戶端 revision 假設；記錄恢復時間及資料缺口。
steps.instructionEn: Choose a teaching snapshot and expected key summary; draw a new cluster isolated from production; check restored data and client revision assumptions; record recovery time and data gap.
steps.observation: 舊快照可能使依 revision 的快取產生相容問題。
steps.observationEn: Older snapshots can cause revision-dependent cache compatibility issues.
steps.failure: 不把還原節點連回舊叢集；此步只做隔離演練計畫。
steps.failureEn: Do not reconnect restored nodes to the old cluster; plan isolated rehearsal only.
steps.check: 計畫包含完整性、資料驗證及客戶端重同步。
steps.checkEn: Include integrity, data verification and client resynchronization.

knowledge.title: 原理與限制
knowledge.text: 復原建立新的邏輯叢集，需處理身分與資料歷史。
knowledge.textEn: Recovery forms a new logical cluster with identity and history considerations.

knowledge.title: 驗證與判讀
knowledge.text: 備份時間之後的資料缺口應明確量化。
knowledge.textEn: Data gaps after the backup point should be explicit.

quiz.question: 備份檔存在就足以證明可復原嗎？
quiz.questionEn: Does a backup file's existence prove recoverability?
options: 不足，需隔離還原與資料驗證。
足夠，檔名就是完整性證據。
足夠，版本差異永遠無影響。
optionsEn: No; isolated restoration and validation are needed.
Yes; its name proves integrity.
Yes; version differences never matter.
quiz.explanation: 不足，需隔離還原與資料驗證。 復原建立新的邏輯叢集，需處理身分與資料歷史。
quiz.explanationEn: No; isolated restoration and validation are needed. Recovery forms a new logical cluster with identity and history considerations.

steps.title: 建立故障矩陣與不變量檢查
steps.titleEn: Build a failure matrix and invariant checks
steps.objective: 讓每種故障都有可反駁的預期。
steps.objectiveEn: Give each failure a falsifiable expectation.
steps.instruction: 列領導者停機、少數分割、慢磁碟及重複請求；為每列寫安全與可用預期；逐步回放；保留失敗軌跡而非只写通過。
steps.instructionEn: List leader crash, minority partition, slow disk and duplicate request; specify safety and availability expectations; replay stepwise; preserve failing traces instead of pass marks only.
steps.observation: 暫停服務可能符合預期，衝突提交則不符合。
steps.observationEn: A service pause can be expected; conflicting commits are not.
steps.failure: 不要把任何逾時都視為一致性錯誤，先分類。
steps.failureEn: Classify timeouts rather than treating each as a consistency violation.
steps.check: 每案例有觸發、觀察、不變量與恢復條件。
steps.checkEn: Each case has trigger, observation, invariant and recovery condition.

knowledge.text: 故障測試需同時驗證安全性及進展條件。
knowledge.textEn: Failure tests check safety and progress conditions separately.

knowledge.title: 驗證與判讀
knowledge.text: 可重現訊息軌跡比總結分數更有診斷價值。
knowledge.textEn: Reproducible message traces diagnose better than an aggregate score.

quiz.question: 失去多數後拒絕新寫入一定是設計失敗嗎？
quiz.questionEn: Is refusing writes after losing quorum necessarily a design failure?
options: 是，任何拒絕都代表資料錯誤。
不是，可能正是維持安全性的行為。
是，應改成單機立即承諾。
optionsEn: Yes; any refusal means corrupted data.
No; it can preserve safety as intended.
Yes; immediately commit on one node instead.
quiz.explanation: 不是，可能正是維持安全性的行為。 故障測試需同時驗證安全性及進展條件。
quiz.explanationEn: No; it can preserve safety as intended. Failure tests check safety and progress conditions separately.

steps.title: 比較資料庫、配置中心與協調服務
steps.objective: 了解可共用的共識核心與應用差異。
steps.objectiveEn: Identify shared consensus and application differences.
steps.instruction: 把配置中心、資料庫分片與分散鎖放成三欄；比較資料量、延遲及不變量；標出共用日誌概念；整理一頁設計與復原交付資料。
steps.instructionEn: Compare configuration, database shards and distributed locks; list data volume, latency and invariants; mark shared log concepts; assemble a one-page design and recovery dossier.
steps.observation: 共識核心相似不代表業務語義相同。
steps.observationEn: Similar consensus cores do not imply identical application semantics.
steps.failure: 不將本課程紙上 Raft 推演宣稱為可直接上線的共識實作。
steps.failureEn: Do not present paper Raft exercises as a production-ready implementation.
steps.check: 交付包含契約、故障模型、測試與衍生學習比較。
steps.checkEn: Include contract, failure model, tests and related-study comparison.

knowledge.title: 原理與限制
knowledge.text: 共識是分散式系統的組件，不是完整產品。
knowledge.textEn: Consensus is a distributed-system component, not an entire product.

knowledge.title: 驗證與判讀
knowledge.text: 應用需補足存取控制、資料生命週期及營運驗證。
knowledge.textEn: Applications add access control, data lifecycle and operational verification.

quiz.question: 三種服務共享 Raft 就代表可直接互換嗎？

代表，應用不需任何驗證。
不代表，資料模型與契約仍不同。
optionsEn: Yes; consensus determines every feature.
Yes; applications need no verification.
No; data models and contracts differ.
quiz.explanation: 不代表，資料模型與契約仍不同。 共識是分散式系統的組件，不是完整產品。
quiz.explanationEn: No; data models and contracts differ. Consensus is a distributed-system component, not an entire product.

stages.title: 任期與選舉

stages.descriptionEn: Four technical units develop terms and elections through separate principle/architecture and experiment/validation tasks with saved progress and knowledge checks.

steps.title: 失效模型：原理與架構
steps.objective: 以「失效模型」建立可檢查的架構、原理與驗證依據。
steps.objectiveEn: Establish reviewable architecture, principles and evidence for failure model.
steps.instruction: 先觀看師傅示意，辨識「失效模型」的資料、控制與時間關係。Raft 一般處理 crash fault 而非任意惡意節點。 在離線工作臺畫出元件／資料流，列出輸入、輸出、保存狀態與合法轉移；建立基準與擾動兩種假想情境，寫下可被反駁的預測。以「列出模型內與外的失效。」設計下一步驗證。記錄版本、單位、未知參數與模型外的行為。
steps.instructionEn: Watch the mentor and identify data, control and timing relationships for failure model. Raft generally handles crashes, not arbitrary malicious nodes. Draw components/data flows offline; specify inputs, outputs, retained state and legal transitions. Build baseline and perturbed hypothetical cases and make a falsifiable prediction. Plan validation using: List in-model and out-of-model failures. Record versions, units, unknowns and out-of-model behavior.
steps.observation: 列出模型內與外的失效。
steps.observationEn: List in-model and out-of-model failures.
steps.failure: 常見誤判：五節點 Raft 兩節點仍可單獨提交。 本步需分開功能正確、資源上界與證據範圍，不可把假想結果當作真實平臺保證。
steps.failureEn: Common mistake: Two nodes alone can commit in five-node Raft. Separate correctness, resource bounds and evidence scope; hypothetical results are not real-platform guarantees.
steps.check: 提交「失效模型」的兩情境架構／狀態圖、參數表與可反駁預測；標出哪些資料支援「Raft 一般處理 crash fault 而非任意惡意節點。」。
steps.checkEn: Submit failure model two-case architecture/state diagrams, parameter table and falsifiable prediction; identify evidence supporting the principle.

knowledge.title: 失效模型的原理與邊界
knowledge.text: Raft 一般處理 crash fault 而非任意惡意節點。
knowledge.textEn: Raft generally handles crashes, not arbitrary malicious nodes.

knowledge.title: 失效模型的驗證設計
knowledge.text: 列出模型內與外的失效。 保留基準與擾動的完整輸入／輸出，以語義、容量或時間條件檢查，並明列假想模型未涵蓋的現實因素。
knowledge.textEn: List in-model and out-of-model failures. Retain complete inputs/outputs for baseline and perturbation, check semantic/capacity/timing criteria and state real-world factors omitted from the hypothetical model.

knowledge.title: 本課原創量化算例
knowledge.text: 假設五個投票節點，多數=3，最多容忍兩個節點不可用；3+2 分割僅 3 節點側可在其他條件滿足時提交。30 ms 對等 RTT 只提供路徑預算，不保證 30 ms 提交，仍需持久化與排程。
knowledge.textEn: With five voting nodes, majority=3 and at most two unavailable nodes are tolerated. In a 3+2 split only the three-node side may commit if other conditions hold. A 30 ms peer RTT is a path budget, not a commit guarantee.

quiz.question: 本步審查「失效模型」與整體「分散式共識服務」時，哪項陳述或驗證有依據？

options: Raft 一般處理 crash fault 而非任意惡意節點。
五節點 Raft 兩節點仍可單獨提交。
Raft 的 crash 模型自動防止 Byzantine 節點。
optionsEn: Raft generally handles crashes, not arbitrary malicious nodes.
Two nodes alone can commit in five-node Raft.
Raft crash tolerance automatically prevents Byzantine nodes.
quiz.explanation: Raft 一般處理 crash fault 而非任意惡意節點。 列出模型內與外的失效。 其餘選項混淆不同架構或證據的適用邊界。
quiz.explanationEn: Raft generally handles crashes, not arbitrary malicious nodes. List in-model and out-of-model failures. The alternatives confuse architectural or evidence boundaries.

steps.title: 失效模型：實驗與驗證

steps.instructionEn: Replay the mentor for failure model and execute in your own isolated model or worksheet: List in-model and out-of-model failures. Check the principle: Raft generally handles crashes, not arbitrary malicious nodes. Preserve input, expected output, observed output and differences. Propose two competing causes and a discriminating observation. Apply predefined semantic, capacity or latency criteria and mark untested real-platform claims unresolved.
steps.observation: 列出模型內與外的失效。
steps.observationEn: List in-model and out-of-model failures.
steps.failure: 常見誤判：五節點 Raft 兩節點仍可單獨提交。 本步需分開功能正確、資源上界與證據範圍，不可把假想結果當作真實平臺保證。
steps.failureEn: Common mistake: Two nodes alone can commit in five-node Raft. Separate correctness, resource bounds and evidence scope; hypothetical results are not real-platform guarantees.
steps.check: 提交「失效模型」的輸入與結果對照、競爭原因、接受／保留理由；逐項說明「列出模型內與外的失效。」的證據與尚未驗證範圍。
steps.checkEn: Submit failure model input/output comparisons, competing causes and pass/hold rationale; state evidence and untested scope for the experiment.

steps.instruction: 先觀看師傅示意，辨識「網路分割」的資料、控制與時間關係。失去 quorum 可保安全而失去進度。 在離線工作臺畫出元件／資料流，列出輸入、輸出、保存狀態與合法轉移；建立基準與擾動兩種假想情境，寫下可被反駁的預測。以「分析本課 3+2 分割。」設計下一步驗證。記錄版本、單位、未知參數與模型外的行為。
steps.instructionEn: Watch the mentor and identify data, control and timing relationships for network partitions. Losing quorum preserves safety but stops progress. Draw components/data flows offline; specify inputs, outputs, retained state and legal transitions. Build baseline and perturbed hypothetical cases and make a falsifiable prediction. Plan validation using: Analyze the course 3+2 partition. Record versions, units, unknowns and out-of-model behavior.
steps.observation: 分析本課 3+2 分割。
steps.observationEn: Analyze the course 3+2 partition.
steps.failure: 常見誤判：五節點 Raft 兩節點仍可單獨提交。 本步需分開功能正確、資源上界與證據範圍，不可把假想結果當作真實平臺保證。
steps.failureEn: Common mistake: Two nodes alone can commit in five-node Raft. Separate correctness, resource bounds and evidence scope; hypothetical results are not real-platform guarantees.
steps.check: 提交「網路分割」的兩情境架構／狀態圖、參數表與可反駁預測；標出哪些資料支援「失去 quorum 可保安全而失去進度。」。
steps.checkEn: Submit network partitions two-case architecture/state diagrams, parameter table and falsifiable prediction; identify evidence supporting the principle.

steps.title: 網路分割：實驗與驗證
steps.objective: 用「分析本課 3+2 分割。」檢查「網路分割」的假設、結果及失效邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Validate assumptions, outcomes and failure boundaries for network partitions using the specified experiment.

steps.instructionEn: Replay the mentor for network partitions and execute in your own isolated model or worksheet: Analyze the course 3+2 partition. Check the principle: Losing quorum preserves safety but stops progress. Preserve input, expected output, observed output and differences. Propose two competing causes and a discriminating observation. Apply predefined semantic, capacity or latency criteria and mark untested real-platform claims unresolved.
steps.observation: 分析本課 3+2 分割。
steps.observationEn: Analyze the course 3+2 partition.
steps.failure: 常見誤判：五節點 Raft 兩節點仍可單獨提交。 本步需分開功能正確、資源上界與證據範圍，不可把假想結果當作真實平臺保證。
steps.failureEn: Common mistake: Two nodes alone can commit in five-node Raft. Separate correctness, resource bounds and evidence scope; hypothetical results are not real-platform guarantees.
steps.check: 提交「網路分割」的輸入與結果對照、競爭原因、接受／保留理由；逐項說明「分析本課 3+2 分割。」的證據與尚未驗證範圍。
steps.checkEn: Submit network partitions input/output comparisons, competing causes and pass/hold rationale; state evidence and untested scope for the experiment.

title: 資料串流處理平台

stages.description: 四個技術單元以原理／架構與實驗／驗證兩步完成「事件與分區」；每步獨立保存進度與知識測驗。

steps.title: 事件 schema：原理與架構
steps.objective: 以「事件 schema」建立可檢查的架構、原理與驗證依據。
steps.objectiveEn: Establish reviewable architecture, principles and evidence for event schema.
steps.instruction: 先觀看師傅示意，辨識「事件 schema」的資料、控制與時間關係。資料格式演進需維持消費者相容。 在離線工作臺畫出元件／資料流，列出輸入、輸出、保存狀態與合法轉移；建立基準與擾動兩種假想情境，寫下可被反駁的預測。以「比較新增選填與改型別。」設計下一步驗證。記錄版本、單位、未知參數與模型外的行為。
steps.instructionEn: Watch the mentor and identify data, control and timing relationships for event schema. Schema evolution preserves consumer compatibility. Draw components/data flows offline; specify inputs, outputs, retained state and legal transitions. Build baseline and perturbed hypothetical cases and make a falsifiable prediction. Plan validation using: Compare optional additions and type changes. Record versions, units, unknowns and out-of-model behavior.
steps.observation: 比較新增選填與改型別。

knowledge.text: 假設每秒 50,000 筆事件、每筆 400 B：原始流量=20 MB/s。保留 24 h=1.728 TB，三份複本=5.184 TB，未計壓縮、索引、重試與編碼。晚到容許 10 s 不代表所有事件準時。
knowledge.textEn: Assume 50,000 events/s at 400 B/event: 20 MB/s raw traffic, 1.728 TB over 24 h and 5.184 TB for three replicas, excluding compression, indexes, retries and encoding. A 10 s lateness allowance does not ensure timely arrivals.

steps.instructionEn: Replay the mentor for acceptance history and execute in your own isolated model or worksheet: Check event sets and window outputs. Check the principle: Equal totals may hide duplicates and losses. Preserve input, expected output, observed output and differences. Propose two competing causes and a discriminating observation. Apply predefined semantic, capacity or latency criteria and mark untested real-platform claims unresolved.

steps.observationEn: Check event sets and window outputs.
steps.failure: 常見誤判：Exactly-once 處理自動保證所有外部副作用一次。 本步需分開功能正確、資源上界與證據範圍，不可把假想結果當作真實平臺保證。
steps.failureEn: Common mistake: Exactly-once processing guarantees every external effect once. Separate correctness, resource bounds and evidence scope; hypothetical results are not real-platform guarantees.
steps.check: 提交「驗收歷史」的輸入與結果對照、競爭原因、接受／保留理由；逐項說明「核對事件集合與窗口結果。」的證據與尚未驗證範圍。
steps.checkEn: Submit acceptance history input/output comparisons, competing causes and pass/hold rationale; state evidence and untested scope for the experiment.

scope: 公開原理的雙語工程教育；工作臺是概念模擬，不是特定廠商產品的完整模擬器。數值為自行設定的教學假設。實驗僅限離線模型、自己的隔離環境或明確授權的測試資料；不掃描或改動真實第三方系統，未測平臺保留未決。
scopeEn: Bilingual engineering education from public principles; the workbench is a conceptual simulation, not a complete simulator of any vendor product. Inputs are original teaching assumptions. Experiments use offline models, owned isolated environments or explicitly authorized test data, never scan/modify third-party systems and leave untested platforms unresolved.

title: 容器編排叢集
summary: 以宣告式控制、排程與工作負載隔離連結 16 個技術單元，新增 32 步原理、架構、假想算例、實驗設計與失效驗證。
summaryEn: Sixteen technical units connect declarative control, scheduling and workload isolation through 32 new tasks covering principles, architecture, assumed calculations, experiment design and failure validation.

stages.title: 控制平面與宣告
stages.description: 四個技術單元以原理／架構與實驗／驗證兩步完成「控制平面與宣告」；每步獨立保存進度與知識測驗。
stages.descriptionEn: Four technical units develop control plane and declarations through separate principle/architecture and experiment/validation tasks with saved progress and knowledge checks.

steps.title: 宣告狀態：原理與架構
steps.objective: 以「宣告狀態」建立可檢查的架構、原理與驗證依據。
steps.objectiveEn: Establish reviewable architecture, principles and evidence for desired state.
steps.instruction: 先觀看師傅示意，辨識「宣告狀態」的資料、控制與時間關係。宣告期望與實際狀態會短暫不同。 在離線工作臺畫出元件／資料流，列出輸入、輸出、保存狀態與合法轉移；建立基準與擾動兩種假想情境，寫下可被反駁的預測。以「畫 reconcile 的迭代。」設計下一步驗證。記錄版本、單位、未知參數與模型外的行為。
steps.instructionEn: Watch the mentor and identify data, control and timing relationships for desired state. Desired and observed state may temporarily differ. Draw components/data flows offline; specify inputs, outputs, retained state and legal transitions. Build baseline and perturbed hypothetical cases and make a falsifiable prediction. Plan validation using: Draw reconciliation iterations. Record versions, units, unknowns and out-of-model behavior.
steps.observation: 畫 reconcile 的迭代。
steps.observationEn: Draw reconciliation iterations.

steps.failureEn: Common mistake: Every running pod is ready for users. Separate correctness, resource bounds and evidence scope; hypothetical results are not real-platform guarantees.

knowledge.title: 宣告狀態的驗證設計

knowledge.textEn: Draw reconciliation iterations. Retain complete inputs/outputs for baseline and perturbation, check semantic/capacity/timing criteria and state real-world factors omitted from the hypothetical model.

knowledge.title: 本課原創量化算例
knowledge.text: 假設四節點各 8 CPU，每節點保留 1 CPU，allocatable 合計 28 CPU。每個不可跨節點拆分的 pod request 2 CPU，單節點只能放 floor(7/2)=3 個，四節點最多 12 個；14 個 pod 雖需合計 28 CPU，仍確定無法全部排程。拓撲、記憶體與裝置限制可能使上限更低。
knowledge.textEn: Four assumed 8-CPU nodes reserve 1 CPU each, totaling 28 allocatable CPUs. Each indivisible 2-CPU-request pod fits on one node: floor(7/2)=3 pods/node and at most 12 across four nodes. Fourteen pods need 28 CPU in aggregate but definitely cannot all schedule; topology, memory or device constraints may lower the bound further.

steps.instructionEn: Replay the mentor for requests and execute in your own isolated model or worksheet: Audit course allocatable CPU. Check the principle: Scheduling uses requests, not measured averages. Preserve input, expected output, observed output and differences. Propose two competing causes and a discriminating observation. Apply predefined semantic, capacity or latency criteria and mark untested real-platform claims unresolved.

steps.title: Pod 隔離：原理與架構
steps.objective: 以「Pod 隔離」建立可檢查的架構、原理與驗證依據。

steps.instruction: 先觀看師傅示意，辨識「Pod 隔離」的資料、控制與時間關係。容器共用核心不是完整 VM 隔離。 在離線工作臺畫出元件／資料流，列出輸入、輸出、保存狀態與合法轉移；建立基準與擾動兩種假想情境，寫下可被反駁的預測。以「標出 namespace 與 host 邊界。」設計下一步驗證。記錄版本、單位、未知參數與模型外的行為。
steps.instructionEn: Watch the mentor and identify data, control and timing relationships for pod isolation. Containers sharing a kernel differ from VMs. Draw components/data flows offline; specify inputs, outputs, retained state and legal transitions. Build baseline and perturbed hypothetical cases and make a falsifiable prediction. Plan validation using: Mark namespace and host boundaries. Record versions, units, unknowns and out-of-model behavior.
steps.observation: 標出 namespace 與 host 邊界。

steps.check: 提交「Pod 隔離」的兩情境架構／狀態圖、參數表與可反駁預測；標出哪些資料支援「容器共用核心不是完整 VM 隔離。」。

knowledge.title: 本課原創量化算例
knowledge.text: 假設四節點各 8 CPU，每節點保留 1 CPU，allocatable 合計 28 CPU。每個不可跨節點拆分的 pod request 2 CPU，單節點只能放 floor(7/2)=3 個，四節點最多 12 個；14 個 pod 雖需合計 28 CPU，仍確定無法全部排程。拓撲、記憶體與裝置限制可能使上限更低。
knowledge.textEn: Four assumed 8-CPU nodes reserve 1 CPU each, totaling 28 allocatable CPUs. Each indivisible 2-CPU-request pod fits on one node: floor(7/2)=3 pods/node and at most 12 across four nodes. Fourteen pods need 28 CPU in aggregate but definitely cannot all schedule; topology, memory or device constraints may lower the bound further.

scope: 公開原理的雙語工程教育；工作臺是概念模擬，不是特定廠商產品的完整模擬器。數值為自行設定的教學假設。實驗僅限離線模型、自己的隔離環境或明確授權的測試資料；不掃描或改動真實第三方系統，未測平臺保留未決。

steps.instructionEn: Watch the mentor and identify data, control and timing relationships for execution contracts. Function interfaces define input, output and timeout. Draw components/data flows offline; specify inputs, outputs, retained state and legal transitions. Build baseline and perturbed hypothetical cases and make a falsifiable prediction. knowledge.title: 本課原創量化算例
knowledge.text: 假設請求率 200/s，每請求服務 100 ms，不含排隊，Little 法則所需平均在途量 L=λW=20。若每實例一請求，需至少平均 20 活躍槽；不是 20 實例就能保證 p99 或突發 SLO。
knowledge.textEn: At assumed 200 requests/s and 100 ms service time without queueing, Little’s law gives average in-flight L=20. One request/instance needs at least 20 mean active slots, not a p99 or burst SLO guarantee.

steps.instructionEn: Replay the mentor for execution contracts and execute in your own isolated model or worksheet: Check normal and failed responses. Check the principle: Function interfaces define input, output and timeout. Preserve input, expected output, observed output and differences. Propose two competing causes and a discriminating observation. Apply predefined semantic, capacity or latency criteria and mark untested real-platform claims unresolved.
steps.observation: 核對正常與失敗回應。
steps.observationEn: Check normal and failed responses.
steps.failure: 常見誤判：Serverless 代表伺服器與維運成本不存在。 本步需分開功能正確、資源上界與證據範圍，不可把假想結果當作真實平臺保證。

steps.check: 提交「執行契約」的輸入與結果對照、競爭原因、接受／保留理由；逐項說明「核對正常與失敗回應。」的證據與尚未驗證範圍。
steps.checkEn: Submit execution contracts input/output comparisons, competing causes and pass/hold rationale; state evidence and untested scope for the experiment.

knowledge.textEn: Check normal and failed responses. Retain complete inputs/outputs for baseline and perturbation, check semantic/capacity/timing criteria and state real-world factors omitted from the hypothetical model.

knowledge.title: 本課原創量化算例
knowledge.text: 假設請求率 200/s，每請求服務 100 ms，不含排隊，Little 法則所需平均在途量 L=λW=20。若每實例一請求，需至少平均 20 活躍槽；不是 20 實例就能保證 p99 或突發 SLO。
knowledge.textEn: At assumed 200 requests/s and 100 ms service time without queueing, Little’s law gives average in-flight L=20. One request/instance needs at least 20 mean active slots, not a p99 or burst SLO guarantee.

steps.objectiveEn: Establish reviewable architecture, principles and evidence for queueing and rejection.
steps.instruction: 先觀看師傅示意，辨識「排隊與拒絕」的資料、控制與時間關係。無界排隊可讓延遲及成本失控。 在離線工作臺畫出元件／資料流，列出輸入、輸出、保存狀態與合法轉移；建立基準與擾動兩種假想情境，寫下可被反駁的預測。以「比較排隊上限與拒絕政策。」設計下一步驗證。記錄版本、單位、未知參數與模型外的行為。
steps.instructionEn: Watch the mentor and identify data, control and timing relationships for queueing and rejection. Unbounded queues inflate latency and cost. Draw components/data flows offline; specify inputs, outputs, retained state and legal transitions. Build baseline and perturbed hypothetical cases and make a falsifiable prediction. Plan validation using: Compare queue bounds and rejection policies. Record versions, units, unknowns and out-of-model behavior.
steps.observation: 比較排隊上限與拒絕政策。
steps.observationEn: Compare queue bounds and rejection policies.
steps.failure: 常見誤判：Serverless 代表伺服器與維運成本不存在。 本步需分開功能正確、資源上界與證據範圍，不可把假想結果當作真實平臺保證。
steps.failureEn: Common mistake: Serverless means servers and operational costs do not exist. Separate correctness, resource bounds and evidence scope; hypothetical results are not real-platform guarantees.
steps.check: 提交「排隊與拒絕」的兩情境架構／狀態圖、參數表與可反駁預測；標出哪些資料支援「無界排隊可讓延遲及成本失控。」。
steps.checkEn: Submit queueing and rejection two-case architecture/state diagrams, parameter table and falsifiable prediction; identify evidence supporting the principle.

knowledge.title: 排隊與拒絕的原理與邊界
knowledge.titleEn: Queueing and rejection principle and boundaries
knowledge.text: 無界排隊可讓延遲及成本失控。
knowledge.textEn: Unbounded queues inflate latency and cost.

knowledge.title: 排隊與拒絕的驗證設計
knowledge.text: 比較排隊上限與拒絕政策。 保留基準與擾動的完整輸入／輸出，以語義、容量或時間條件檢查，並明列假想模型未涵蓋的現實因素。
knowledge.textEn: Compare queue bounds and rejection policies. Retain complete inputs/outputs for baseline and perturbation, check semantic/capacity/timing criteria and state real-world factors omitted from the hypothetical model.

quiz.question: 本步審查「排隊與拒絕」與整體「無伺服器執行平台」時，哪項陳述或驗證有依據？
quiz.questionEn: When reviewing queueing and rejection within serverless execution platforms, which statement or check is supported?
options: Serverless 代表伺服器與維運成本不存在。
Little 法則平均量可保證 p99 延遲。
無界排隊可讓延遲及成本失控。
optionsEn: Serverless means servers and operational costs do not exist.
Little’s-law averages guarantee p99 latency.
Unbounded queues inflate latency and cost.
quiz.explanation: 無界排隊可讓延遲及成本失控。 比較排隊上限與拒絕政策。 其餘選項混淆不同架構或證據的適用邊界。
quiz.explanationEn: Unbounded queues inflate latency and cost. Compare queue bounds and rejection policies. The alternatives confuse architectural or evidence boundaries.

steps.title: 排隊與拒絕：實驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Queueing and rejection: experiment and validation
steps.objective: 用「比較排隊上限與拒絕政策。」檢查「排隊與拒絕」的假設、結果及失效邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Validate assumptions, outcomes and failure boundaries for queueing and rejection using the specified experiment.
steps.instruction: 重播師傅對「排隊與拒絕」的示範，在自己的隔離模型或試算表執行：比較排隊上限與拒絕政策。 核對「無界排隊可讓延遲及成本失控。」是否成立；保留輸入、預期、實際結果與差異。至少提出兩個競爭原因，選擇一項能區分它們的新增觀察。依事前定義的語義、容量或延遲條件判斷通過／保留，未執行的真實平臺項目不得標為實測。
steps.instructionEn: Replay the mentor for queueing and rejection and execute in your own isolated model or worksheet: Compare queue bounds and rejection policies. Check the principle: Unbounded queues inflate latency and cost. Preserve input, expected output, observed output and differences. Propose two competing causes and a discriminating observation. Apply predefined semantic, capacity or latency criteria and mark untested real-platform claims unresolved.
steps.observation: 比較排隊上限與拒絕政策。
steps.observationEn: Compare queue bounds and rejection policies.
steps.failure: 常見誤判：Serverless 代表伺服器與維運成本不存在。 本步需分開功能正確、資源上界與證據範圍，不可把假想結果當作真實平臺保證。
steps.failureEn: Common mistake: Serverless means servers and operational costs do not exist. Separate correctness, resource bounds and evidence scope; hypothetical results are not real-platform guarantees.
steps.check: 提交「排隊與拒絕」的輸入與結果對照、競爭原因、接受／保留理由；逐項說明「比較排隊上限與拒絕政策。」的證據與尚未驗證範圍。
steps.checkEn: Submit queueing and rejection input/output comparisons, competing causes and pass/hold rationale; state evidence and untested scope for the experiment.

title: 服務網格與流量控制
summary: 以服務身分、路由政策與韌性控制連結 16 個技術單元，新增 32 步原理、架構、假想算例、實驗設計與失效驗證。
summaryEn: Sixteen technical units connect service identities, routing policies and resilience through 32 new tasks covering principles, architecture, assumed calculations, experiment design and failure validation.

stages.title: 流量架構與發現
stages.description: 四個技術單元以原理／架構與實驗／驗證兩步完成「流量架構與發現」；每步獨立保存進度與知識測驗。
stages.descriptionEn: Four technical units develop traffic architecture and discovery through separate principle/architecture and experiment/validation tasks with saved progress and knowledge checks.

steps.title: 服務發現：原理與架構
steps.objective: 以「服務發現」建立可檢查的架構、原理與驗證依據。
steps.objectiveEn: Establish reviewable architecture, principles and evidence for service discovery.
steps.instruction: 先觀看師傅示意，辨識「服務發現」的資料、控制與時間關係。邏輯服務需對應目前可用端點。 在離線工作臺畫出元件／資料流，列出輸入、輸出、保存狀態與合法轉移；建立基準與擾動兩種假想情境，寫下可被反駁的預測。以「畫端點新增與移除時序。」設計下一步驗證。記錄版本、單位、未知參數與模型外的行為。
steps.instructionEn: Watch the mentor and identify data, control and timing relationships for service discovery. Logical services resolve to current endpoints. Draw components/data flows offline; specify inputs, outputs, retained state and legal transitions. Build baseline and perturbed hypothetical cases and make a falsifiable prediction. Plan validation using: Draw endpoint addition/removal timing. Record versions, units, unknowns and out-of-model behavior.
steps.observation: 畫端點新增與移除時序。
steps.observationEn: Draw endpoint addition/removal timing.
steps.failure: 常見誤判：mTLS 已完成所有業務授權。 本步需分開功能正確、資源上界與證據範圍，不可把假想結果當作真實平臺保證。
steps.failureEn: Common mistake: mTLS completes every business authorization check. Separate correctness, resource bounds and evidence scope; hypothetical results are not real-platform guarantees.
steps.check: 提交「服務發現」的兩情境架構／狀態圖、參數表與可反駁預測；標出哪些資料支援「邏輯服務需對應目前可用端點。」。
steps.checkEn: Submit service discovery two-case architecture/state diagrams, parameter table and falsifiable prediction; identify evidence supporting the principle.

knowledge.title: 服務發現的原理與邊界
knowledge.text: 邏輯服務需對應目前可用端點。
knowledge.textEn: Logical services resolve to current endpoints.

knowledge.title: 服務發現的驗證設計
knowledge.text: 畫端點新增與移除時序。 保留基準與擾動的完整輸入／輸出，以語義、容量或時間條件檢查，並明列假想模型未涵蓋的現實因素。
knowledge.textEn: Draw endpoint addition/removal timing. Retain complete inputs/outputs for baseline and perturbation, check semantic/capacity/timing criteria and state real-world factors omitted from the hypothetical model.

knowledge.title: 本課原創量化算例
knowledge.text: 假設原始 1000 requests/s，每個最多重試兩次，最差請求嘗試量可達 3000/s（首次加兩次），不表示全部成功。若每次 timeout 200 ms 且順序重試，總預算需至少 600 ms 外加 backoff。
knowledge.textEn: At 1000 original requests/s with at most two retries, attempts may reach 3000/s including first attempts. Sequential 200 ms timeouts need at least 600 ms plus backoff, without guaranteeing success.

quiz.question: 本步審查「服務發現」與整體「服務網格與流量控制」時，哪項陳述或驗證有依據？
quiz.questionEn: When reviewing service discovery within service meshes and traffic control, which statement or check is supported?
options: 邏輯服務需對應目前可用端點。
mTLS 已完成所有業務授權。
增加重試次數必定提升整體可用率。
optionsEn: Logical services resolve to current endpoints.
mTLS completes every business authorization check.
More retries necessarily improve overall availability.
quiz.explanation: 邏輯服務需對應目前可用端點。 畫端點新增與移除時序。 其餘選項混淆不同架構或證據的適用邊界。
quiz.explanationEn: Logical services resolve to current endpoints. Draw endpoint addition/removal timing. The alternatives confuse architectural or evidence boundaries.

steps.title: 服務發現：實驗與驗證
steps.objective: 用「畫端點新增與移除時序。」檢查「服務發現」的假設、結果及失效邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Validate assumptions, outcomes and failure boundaries for service discovery using the specified experiment.
steps.instruction: 重播師傅對「服務發現」的示範，在自己的隔離模型或試算表執行：畫端點新增與移除時序。 核對「邏輯服務需對應目前可用端點。」是否成立；保留輸入、預期、實際結果與差異。至少提出兩個競爭原因，選擇一項能區分它們的新增觀察。依事前定義的語義、容量或延遲條件判斷通過／保留，未執行的真實平臺項目不得標為實測。
steps.instructionEn: Replay the mentor for service discovery and execute in your own isolated model or worksheet: Draw endpoint addition/removal timing. Check the principle: Logical services resolve to current endpoints. Preserve input, expected output, observed output and differences. Propose two competing causes and a discriminating observation. Apply predefined semantic, capacity or latency criteria and mark untested real-platform claims unresolved.
steps.observation: 畫端點新增與移除時序。
steps.observationEn: Draw endpoint addition/removal timing.
steps.failure: 常見誤判：mTLS 已完成所有業務授權。 本步需分開功能正確、資源上界與證據範圍，不可把假想結果當作真實平臺保證。
steps.failureEn: Common mistake: mTLS completes every business authorization check. Separate correctness, resource bounds and evidence scope; hypothetical results are not real-platform guarantees.
steps.check: 提交「服務發現」的輸入與結果對照、競爭原因、接受／保留理由；逐項說明「畫端點新增與移除時序。」的證據與尚未驗證範圍。
steps.checkEn: Submit service discovery input/output comparisons, competing causes and pass/hold rationale; state evidence and untested scope for the experiment.

scope: 公開原理的雙語工程教育；工作臺是概念模擬，不是特定廠商產品的完整模擬器。數值為自行設定的教學假設。實驗僅限離線模型、自己的隔離環境或明確授權的測試資料；不掃描或改動真實第三方系統，未測平臺保留未決。
scopeEn: Bilingual engineering education from public principles; the workbench is a conceptual simulation, not a complete simulator of any vendor product. Inputs are original teaching assumptions. Experiments use offline models, owned isolated environments or explicitly authorized test data, never scan/modify third-party systems and leave untested platforms unresolved.

title: 可觀測性與分散式追蹤

summaryEn: Sixteen technical units connect telemetry semantics, context and reliable sampling through 32 new tasks covering principles, architecture, assumed calculations, experiment design and failure validation.

stages.title: 訊號與量測契約

stages.descriptionEn: Four technical units develop signals and measurement contracts through separate principle/architecture and experiment/validation tasks with saved progress and knowledge checks.

steps.title: 三類訊號：原理與架構
steps.objective: 以「三類訊號」建立可檢查的架構、原理與驗證依據。
steps.objectiveEn: Establish reviewable architecture, principles and evidence for signal types.
steps.instruction: 先觀看師傅示意，辨識「三類訊號」的資料、控制與時間關係。Metrics、logs 與 traces 回答不同問題。 在離線工作臺畫出元件／資料流，列出輸入、輸出、保存狀態與合法轉移；建立基準與擾動兩種假想情境，寫下可被反駁的預測。以「將問題配對適當訊號。」設計下一步驗證。記錄版本、單位、未知參數與模型外的行為。
steps.instructionEn: Watch the mentor and identify data, control and timing relationships for signal types. Metrics, logs and traces answer different questions. Draw components/data flows offline; specify inputs, outputs, retained state and legal transitions. Build baseline and perturbed hypothetical cases and make a falsifiable prediction. Plan validation using: Match questions to signals. Record versions, units, unknowns and out-of-model behavior.
steps.observation: 將問題配對適當訊號。
steps.observationEn: Match questions to signals.
steps.failure: 常見誤判：頭部採樣可以預先保證留下所有未來錯誤。 本步需分開功能正確、資源上界與證據範圍，不可把假想結果當作真實平臺保證。
steps.failureEn: Common mistake: Head sampling guarantees retaining every future error. Separate correctness, resource bounds and evidence scope; hypothetical results are not real-platform guarantees.
steps.check: 提交「三類訊號」的兩情境架構／狀態圖、參數表與可反駁預測；標出哪些資料支援「Metrics、logs 與 traces 回答不同問題。」。
steps.checkEn: Submit signal types two-case architecture/state diagrams, parameter table and falsifiable prediction; identify evidence supporting the principle.

knowledge.title: 本課原創量化算例
knowledge.text: 假設 10,000 traces/s、每 trace 8 spans、每 span 500 B：原始=40 MB/s，頭部 10% 採樣理想為 4 MB/s，未含批次與標頭。低機率錯誤可能被漏採，不可宣稱保留全部錯誤。
knowledge.textEn: Assume 10,000 traces/s, 8 spans/trace and 500 B/span: 40 MB/s raw; ideal 10% head sampling gives 4 MB/s, excluding batches and headers. Rare errors may be missed; this does not retain every error.

Head sampling guarantees retaining every future error.
Nearby trace times prove a unique root cause.

steps.instruction: 重播師傅對「根因證據」的示範，在自己的隔離模型或試算表執行：列出兩個可反駁假說。 核對「關聯不等於獨立因果證明。」是否成立；保留輸入、預期、實際結果與差異。至少提出兩個競爭原因，選擇一項能區分它們的新增觀察。依事前定義的語義、容量或延遲條件判斷通過／保留，未執行的真實平臺項目不得標為實測。
steps.instructionEn: Replay the mentor for causal evidence and execute in your own isolated model or worksheet: List two falsifiable hypotheses. Check the principle: Correlation does not establish independent causality. Preserve input, expected output, observed output and differences. Propose two competing causes and a discriminating observation. Apply predefined semantic, capacity or latency criteria and mark untested real-platform claims unresolved.

steps.checkEn: Submit causal evidence input/output comparisons, competing causes and pass/hold rationale; state evidence and untested scope for the experiment.

scope: 公開原理的雙語工程教育；工作臺是概念模擬，不是特定廠商產品的完整模擬器。數值為自行設定的教學假設。實驗僅限離線模型、自己的隔離環境或明確授權的測試資料；不掃描或改動真實第三方系統，未測平臺保留未決。
scopeEn: Bilingual engineering education from public principles; the workbench is a conceptual simulation, not a complete simulator of any vendor product. Inputs are original teaching assumptions. Experiments use offline models, owned isolated environments or explicitly authorized test data, never scan/modify third-party systems and leave untested platforms unresolved.

workedExample.title: 原創可重算假想案例

workedExample.text: 假設 10,000 traces/s、每 trace 8 spans、每 span 500 B：原始=40 MB/s，頭部 10% 採樣理想為 4 MB/s，未含批次與標頭。低機率錯誤可能被漏採，不可宣稱保留全部錯誤。

workedExample.assumptions: 使用算例明列的單位、邊界與理想化前提；改變版本、工作負載、故障模型或資源條件後重算。
workedExample.assumptionsEn: Use the stated units, boundaries and idealizations; recalculate after version, workload, fault-model or resource changes.
workedExample.sourceScope: 作者原創算例；官方來源支援原理與背景，不是這組數字的實測來源。
workedExample.sourceScopeEn: Original assumed example; official sources support principles/context, not measurements of these numbers.

title: 持續整合與交付管線
summary: 以隔離建置、證據與受控部署連結 16 個技術單元，新增 32 步原理、架構、假想算例、實驗設計與失效驗證。
summaryEn: Sixteen technical units connect isolated builds, evidence and controlled deployment through 32 new tasks covering principles, architecture, assumed calculations, experiment design and failure validation.

stages.title: 原始碼與觸發
stages.description: 四個技術單元以原理／架構與實驗／驗證兩步完成「原始碼與觸發」；每步獨立保存進度與知識測驗。
stages.descriptionEn: Four technical units develop sources and triggers through separate principle/architecture and experiment/validation tasks with saved progress and knowledge checks.

steps.title: 觸發邊界：原理與架構
steps.objective: 以「觸發邊界」建立可檢查的架構、原理與驗證依據。
steps.objectiveEn: Establish reviewable architecture, principles and evidence for trigger boundaries.
steps.instruction: 先觀看師傅示意，辨識「觸發邊界」的資料、控制與時間關係。外部 PR 代碼與發佈信任等級不同。 在離線工作臺畫出元件／資料流，列出輸入、輸出、保存狀態與合法轉移；建立基準與擾動兩種假想情境，寫下可被反駁的預測。以「分類事件可取用的權限。」設計下一步驗證。記錄版本、單位、未知參數與模型外的行為。
steps.instructionEn: Watch the mentor and identify data, control and timing relationships for trigger boundaries. External PR code and releases have different trust levels. Draw components/data flows offline; specify inputs, outputs, retained state and legal transitions. Build baseline and perturbed hypothetical cases and make a falsifiable prediction. Plan validation using: Classify permissions available to events. Record versions, units, unknowns and out-of-model behavior.
steps.observation: 分類事件可取用的權限。
steps.observationEn: Classify permissions available to events.
steps.failure: 常見誤判：秘密遮蔽會可靠移除所有編碼變形。 本步需分開功能正確、資源上界與證據範圍，不可把假想結果當作真實平臺保證。
steps.failureEn: Common mistake: Secret masking reliably removes every encoded transformation. Separate correctness, resource bounds and evidence scope; hypothetical results are not real-platform guarantees.
steps.check: 提交「觸發邊界」的兩情境架構／狀態圖、參數表與可反駁預測；標出哪些資料支援「外部 PR 代碼與發佈信任等級不同。」。
steps.checkEn: Submit trigger boundaries two-case architecture/state diagrams, parameter table and falsifiable prediction; identify evidence supporting the principle.

knowledge.title: 觸發邊界的原理與邊界
knowledge.text: 外部 PR 代碼與發佈信任等級不同。
knowledge.textEn: External PR code and releases have different trust levels.

knowledge.title: 觸發邊界的驗證設計
knowledge.text: 分類事件可取用的權限。 保留基準與擾動的完整輸入／輸出，以語義、容量或時間條件檢查，並明列假想模型未涵蓋的現實因素。
knowledge.textEn: Classify permissions available to events. Retain complete inputs/outputs for baseline and perturbation, check semantic/capacity/timing criteria and state real-world factors omitted from the hypothetical model.

knowledge.title: 本課原創量化算例
knowledge.text: 假設串列工作 2、8、6、4 min，總 20 min；若 8 與 6 min 可獨立平行，關鍵路徑=2+max(8,6)+4=14 min。兩工作不得共享可變 workspace；runner 成本仍約 20 worker-min。
knowledge.textEn: Assume serial jobs of 2, 8, 6 and 4 min: 20 min. Independent parallel 8/6 min jobs give a 14 min critical path. They must not share mutable workspaces; total worker time remains about 20 worker-min.

quiz.question: 本步審查「觸發邊界」與整體「持續整合與交付管線」時，哪項陳述或驗證有依據？

options: 外部 PR 代碼與發佈信任等級不同。

快取命中就可略過依賴與來源驗證。

Secret masking reliably removes every encoded transformation.
Cache hits permit skipping dependency/source verification.

steps.instruction: 先觀看師傅示意，辨識「測試分層」的資料、控制與時間關係。單元與整合測試涵蓋不同邊界。 在離線工作臺畫出元件／資料流，列出輸入、輸出、保存狀態與合法轉移；建立基準與擾動兩種假想情境，寫下可被反駁的預測。以「建立功能與系統契約對應。」設計下一步驗證。記錄版本、單位、未知參數與模型外的行為。
steps.instructionEn: Watch the mentor and identify data, control and timing relationships for test layers. Unit/integration tests cover different boundaries. Draw components/data flows offline; specify inputs, outputs, retained state and legal transitions. Build baseline and perturbed hypothetical cases and make a falsifiable prediction. Plan validation using: Map functions to system contracts. Record versions, units, unknowns and out-of-model behavior.
steps.observation: 建立功能與系統契約對應。
steps.observationEn: Map functions to system contracts.
steps.failure: 常見誤判：快取命中就可略過依賴與來源驗證。 本步需分開功能正確、資源上界與證據範圍，不可把假想結果當作真實平臺保證。
steps.failureEn: Common mistake: Cache hits permit skipping dependency/source verification. Separate correctness, resource bounds and evidence scope; hypothetical results are not real-platform guarantees.
steps.check: 提交「測試分層」的兩情境架構／狀態圖、參數表與可反駁預測；標出哪些資料支援「單元與整合測試涵蓋不同邊界。」。
steps.checkEn: Submit test layers two-case architecture/state diagrams, parameter table and falsifiable prediction; identify evidence supporting the principle.

knowledge.title: 測試分層的原理與邊界
knowledge.text: 單元與整合測試涵蓋不同邊界。
knowledge.textEn: Unit/integration tests cover different boundaries.

knowledge.title: 測試分層的驗證設計
knowledge.text: 建立功能與系統契約對應。 保留基準與擾動的完整輸入／輸出，以語義、容量或時間條件檢查，並明列假想模型未涵蓋的現實因素。
knowledge.textEn: Map functions to system contracts. Retain complete inputs/outputs for baseline and perturbation, check semantic/capacity/timing criteria and state real-world factors omitted from the hypothetical model.

quiz.question: 本步審查「測試分層」與整體「持續整合與交付管線」時，哪項陳述或驗證有依據？
quiz.questionEn: When reviewing test layers within continuous integration and delivery pipelines, which statement or check is supported?
options: 秘密遮蔽會可靠移除所有編碼變形。
單元與整合測試涵蓋不同邊界。
快取命中就可略過依賴與來源驗證。
optionsEn: Secret masking reliably removes every encoded transformation.
Unit/integration tests cover different boundaries.
Cache hits permit skipping dependency/source verification.
quiz.explanation: 單元與整合測試涵蓋不同邊界。 建立功能與系統契約對應。 其餘選項混淆不同架構或證據的適用邊界。
quiz.explanationEn: Unit/integration tests cover different boundaries. Map functions to system contracts. The alternatives confuse architectural or evidence boundaries.

steps.title: 測試分層：實驗與驗證
steps.objective: 用「建立功能與系統契約對應。」檢查「測試分層」的假設、結果及失效邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Validate assumptions, outcomes and failure boundaries for test layers using the specified experiment.
steps.instruction: 重播師傅對「測試分層」的示範，在自己的隔離模型或試算表執行：建立功能與系統契約對應。 核對「單元與整合測試涵蓋不同邊界。」是否成立；保留輸入、預期、實際結果與差異。至少提出兩個競爭原因，選擇一項能區分它們的新增觀察。依事前定義的語義、容量或延遲條件判斷通過／保留，未執行的真實平臺項目不得標為實測。
steps.instructionEn: Replay the mentor for test layers and execute in your own isolated model or worksheet: Map functions to system contracts. Check the principle: Unit/integration tests cover different boundaries. Preserve input, expected output, observed output and differences. Propose two competing causes and a discriminating observation. Apply predefined semantic, capacity or latency criteria and mark untested real-platform claims unresolved.
steps.observation: 建立功能與系統契約對應。
steps.observationEn: Map functions to system contracts.
steps.failure: 常見誤判：快取命中就可略過依賴與來源驗證。 本步需分開功能正確、資源上界與證據範圍，不可把假想結果當作真實平臺保證。
steps.failureEn: Common mistake: Cache hits permit skipping dependency/source verification. Separate correctness, resource bounds and evidence scope; hypothetical results are not real-platform guarantees.
steps.check: 提交「測試分層」的輸入與結果對照、競爭原因、接受／保留理由；逐項說明「建立功能與系統契約對應。」的證據與尚未驗證範圍。
steps.checkEn: Submit test layers input/output comparisons, competing causes and pass/hold rationale; state evidence and untested scope for the experiment.

steps.title: 發布證據：實驗與驗證
steps.objective: 用「核對主張與可驗證證據。」檢查「發布證據」的假設、結果及失效邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Validate assumptions, outcomes and failure boundaries for release evidence using the specified experiment.
steps.instruction: 重播師傅對「發布證據」的示範，在自己的隔離模型或試算表執行：核對主張與可驗證證據。 核對「Provenance 記錄來源與建置流程。」是否成立；保留輸入、預期、實際結果與差異。至少提出兩個競爭原因，選擇一項能區分它們的新增觀察。依事前定義的語義、容量或延遲條件判斷通過／保留，未執行的真實平臺項目不得標為實測。
steps.instructionEn: Replay the mentor for release evidence and execute in your own isolated model or worksheet: Compare claims and verifiable evidence. Check the principle: Provenance records source and build process. Preserve input, expected output, observed output and differences. Propose two competing causes and a discriminating observation. Apply predefined semantic, capacity or latency criteria and mark untested real-platform claims unresolved.
steps.observation: 核對主張與可驗證證據。
steps.observationEn: Compare claims and verifiable evidence.
steps.failure: 常見誤判：快取命中就可略過依賴與來源驗證。 本步需分開功能正確、資源上界與證據範圍，不可把假想結果當作真實平臺保證。
steps.failureEn: Common mistake: Cache hits permit skipping dependency/source verification. Separate correctness, resource bounds and evidence scope; hypothetical results are not real-platform guarantees.
steps.check: 提交「發布證據」的輸入與結果對照、競爭原因、接受／保留理由；逐項說明「核對主張與可驗證證據。」的證據與尚未驗證範圍。
steps.checkEn: Submit release evidence input/output comparisons, competing causes and pass/hold rationale; state evidence and untested scope for the experiment.

stages.title: 部署與回復
stages.description: 四個技術單元以原理／架構與實驗／驗證兩步完成「部署與回復」；每步獨立保存進度與知識測驗。
stages.descriptionEn: Four technical units develop deployment and rollback through separate principle/architecture and experiment/validation tasks with saved progress and knowledge checks.

steps.title: 部署批准：原理與架構
steps.objective: 以「部署批准」建立可檢查的架構、原理與驗證依據。
steps.objectiveEn: Establish reviewable architecture, principles and evidence for deployment approval.
steps.instruction: 先觀看師傅示意，辨識「部署批准」的資料、控制與時間關係。批准需繫結審核過的確定產物。 在離線工作臺畫出元件／資料流，列出輸入、輸出、保存狀態與合法轉移；建立基準與擾動兩種假想情境，寫下可被反駁的預測。以「建立批准後產物變更反例。」設計下一步驗證。記錄版本、單位、未知參數與模型外的行為。
steps.instructionEn: Watch the mentor and identify data, control and timing relationships for deployment approval. Approval binds a reviewed artifact. Draw components/data flows offline; specify inputs, outputs, retained state and legal transitions. Build baseline and perturbed hypothetical cases and make a falsifiable prediction. Plan validation using: Construct post-approval artifact-change cases. Record versions, units, unknowns and out-of-model behavior.
steps.observation: 建立批准後產物變更反例。
steps.observationEn: Construct post-approval artifact-change cases.
steps.failure: 常見誤判：秘密遮蔽會可靠移除所有編碼變形。 本步需分開功能正確、資源上界與證據範圍，不可把假想結果當作真實平臺保證。
steps.failureEn: Common mistake: Secret masking reliably removes every encoded transformation. Separate correctness, resource bounds and evidence scope; hypothetical results are not real-platform guarantees.
steps.check: 提交「部署批准」的兩情境架構／狀態圖、參數表與可反駁預測；標出哪些資料支援「批准需繫結審核過的確定產物。」。
steps.checkEn: Submit deployment approval two-case architecture/state diagrams, parameter table and falsifiable prediction; identify evidence supporting the principle.

scope: 公開原理的雙語工程教育；工作臺是概念模擬，不是特定廠商產品的完整模擬器。數值為自行設定的教學假設。實驗僅限離線模型、自己的隔離環境或明確授權的測試資料；不掃描或改動真實第三方系統，未測平臺保留未決。

steps.title: 重現定義：原理與架構
steps.objective: 以「重現定義」建立可檢查的架構、原理與驗證依據。

steps.instruction: 先觀看師傅示意，辨識「重現定義」的資料、控制與時間關係。相同程式行為不等於相同位元。 在離線工作臺畫出元件／資料流，列出輸入、輸出、保存狀態與合法轉移；建立基準與擾動兩種假想情境，寫下可被反駁的預測。以「比較語義與位元驗收。」設計下一步驗證。記錄版本、單位、未知參數與模型外的行為。

knowledge.text: 比較語義與位元驗收。 保留基準與擾動的完整輸入／輸出，以語義、容量或時間條件檢查，並明列假想模型未涵蓋的現實因素。

knowledge.title: 本課原創量化算例
knowledge.text: ZIP 基本 DOS 時間欄位只有 2 s 精度：同分鐘 0 s 與 1 s 可能編碼相同，0 s 與 2 s 才改變該欄位；額外時間欄位可有不同精度。必須比較實際編碼的 metadata，不能宣稱邏輯時間差 1 s 必然改變包摘要。固定檔案清單、順序、工具版本與正規化時間後比較位元。128 MiB 在假設 256 MiB/s 下雜湊約 0.5 s。
knowledge.textEn: ZIP basic DOS time fields have 2 s precision: seconds 0 and 1 in one minute may encode identically, whereas 0 and 2 change that field; extra timestamp fields may use other precision. Compare encoded metadata rather than claiming every logical 1 s change alters the archive digest. Match manifests, order, tool versions and normalized times for byte comparison. Hashing 128 MiB at assumed 256 MiB/s takes 0.5 s.

steps.failure: 常見誤判：相同原始碼即可忽略工具鏈和時間差異。 本步需分開功能正確、資源上界與證據範圍，不可把假想結果當作真實平臺保證。

steps.check: 提交「輸入清單」的輸入與結果對照、競爭原因、接受／保留理由；逐項說明「列出所有顯式和隱含輸入。」的證據與尚未驗證範圍。

knowledge.title: 本課原創量化算例
knowledge.text: ZIP 基本 DOS 時間欄位只有 2 s 精度：同分鐘 0 s 與 1 s 可能編碼相同，0 s 與 2 s 才改變該欄位；額外時間欄位可有不同精度。必須比較實際編碼的 metadata，不能宣稱邏輯時間差 1 s 必然改變包摘要。固定檔案清單、順序、工具版本與正規化時間後比較位元。128 MiB 在假設 256 MiB/s 下雜湊約 0.5 s。

Hashing 128 MiB at assumed 256 MiB/s takes 0.5 s.

scope: 公開原理的雙語工程教育；工作臺是概念模擬，不是特定廠商產品的完整模擬器。數值為自行設定的教學假設。實驗僅限離線模型、自己的隔離環境或明確授權的測試資料；不掃描或改動真實第三方系統，未測平臺保留未決。
scopeEn: Bilingual engineering education from public principles; the workbench is a conceptual simulation, not a complete simulator of any vendor product. Inputs are original teaching assumptions. Experiments use offline models, owned isolated environments or explicitly authorized test data, never scan/modify third-party systems and leave untested platforms unresolved.
