knowledge.title: 本課原創量化算例
knowledge.text: 假想更新 metadata 門檻為 2-of-3 金鑰，單一有效簽章不滿足政策；三把中的任兩把才滿足門檻。若 metadata 到期 24 h，即使簽章正確，過期後仍需依政策拒絕，不是永久信任。
knowledge.textEn: For fictional 2-of-3 metadata keys, one valid signature fails policy and any two satisfy the threshold. With 24 h expiry, valid signatures do not establish freshness after expiry.

quiz.question: 本步審查「內容摘要」與整體「套件簽章與供應鏈驗證」時，哪項陳述或驗證有依據？
quiz.questionEn: When reviewing content digests within package signing and supply-chain verification, which statement or check is supported?
options: 摘要識別特定位元而非作者身分。
透明日誌的存在就代表網站授權該 signer。
有效簽章讓 metadata 永遠不會過期。
optionsEn: Digests identify bytes, not author identity.
A transparency entry means the site authorized the signer.
Valid signatures make metadata never expire.
quiz.explanation: 摘要識別特定位元而非作者身分。 核對來源聲明與摘要差別。 其餘選項混淆不同架構或證據的適用邊界。
quiz.explanationEn: Digests identify bytes, not author identity. Compare origin claims and digests. The alternatives confuse architectural or evidence boundaries.

steps.title: 內容摘要：實驗與驗證
steps.objective: 用「核對來源聲明與摘要差別。」檢查「內容摘要」的假設、結果及失效邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Validate assumptions, outcomes and failure boundaries for content digests using the specified experiment.
steps.instruction: 重播師傅對「內容摘要」的示範，在自己的隔離模型或試算表執行：核對來源聲明與摘要差別。 核對「摘要識別特定位元而非作者身分。」是否成立；保留輸入、預期、實際結果與差異。至少提出兩個競爭原因，選擇一項能區分它們的新增觀察。依事前定義的語義、容量或延遲條件判斷通過／保留，未執行的真實平臺項目不得標為實測。
steps.instructionEn: Replay the mentor for content digests and execute in your own isolated model or worksheet: Compare origin claims and digests. Check the principle: Digests identify bytes, not author identity. Preserve input, expected output, observed output and differences. Propose two competing causes and a discriminating observation. Apply predefined semantic, capacity or latency criteria and mark untested real-platform claims unresolved.
steps.observation: 核對來源聲明與摘要差別。
steps.observationEn: Compare origin claims and digests.
steps.failure: 常見誤判：透明日誌的存在就代表網站授權該 signer。 本步需分開功能正確、資源上界與證據範圍，不可把假想結果當作真實平臺保證。
steps.failureEn: Common mistake: A transparency entry means the site authorized the signer. Separate correctness, resource bounds and evidence scope; hypothetical results are not real-platform guarantees.
steps.check: 提交「內容摘要」的輸入與結果對照、競爭原因、接受／保留理由；逐項說明「核對來源聲明與摘要差別。」的證據與尚未驗證範圍。
steps.checkEn: Submit content digests input/output comparisons, competing causes and pass/hold rationale; state evidence and untested scope for the experiment.

knowledge.title: 內容摘要的原理與邊界

knowledge.title: 內容摘要的驗證設計
knowledge.text: 核對來源聲明與摘要差別。 保留基準與擾動的完整輸入／輸出，以語義、容量或時間條件檢查，並明列假想模型未涵蓋的現實因素。
knowledge.textEn: Compare origin claims and digests. Retain complete inputs/outputs for baseline and perturbation, check semantic/capacity/timing criteria and state real-world factors omitted from the hypothetical model.

steps.title: 簽章契約：原理與架構
steps.objective: 以「簽章契約」建立可檢查的架構、原理與驗證依據。
steps.objectiveEn: Establish reviewable architecture, principles and evidence for signature contracts.
steps.instruction: 先觀看師傅示意，辨識「簽章契約」的資料、控制與時間關係。簽章需驗證算法、內容與信任金鑰。 在離線工作臺畫出元件／資料流，列出輸入、輸出、保存狀態與合法轉移；建立基準與擾動兩種假想情境，寫下可被反駁的預測。以「用測試金鑰核對不同內容。」設計下一步驗證。記錄版本、單位、未知參數與模型外的行為。
steps.instructionEn: Watch the mentor and identify data, control and timing relationships for signature contracts. Verification checks algorithm, bytes and trusted key. Draw components/data flows offline; specify inputs, outputs, retained state and legal transitions. Build baseline and perturbed hypothetical cases and make a falsifiable prediction. Plan validation using: Check different content with test keys. Record versions, units, unknowns and out-of-model behavior.
steps.observation: 用測試金鑰核對不同內容。
steps.observationEn: Check different content with test keys.
steps.failure: 常見誤判：有效簽章讓 metadata 永遠不會過期。 本步需分開功能正確、資源上界與證據範圍，不可把假想結果當作真實平臺保證。
steps.failureEn: Common mistake: Valid signatures make metadata never expire. Separate correctness, resource bounds and evidence scope; hypothetical results are not real-platform guarantees.
steps.check: 提交「簽章契約」的兩情境架構／狀態圖、參數表與可反駁預測；標出哪些資料支援「簽章需驗證算法、內容與信任金鑰。」。
steps.checkEn: Submit signature contracts two-case architecture/state diagrams, parameter table and falsifiable prediction; identify evidence supporting the principle.

steps.title: Artifact 繫結：實驗與驗證

steps.instruction: 重播師傅對「Artifact 繫結」的示範，在自己的隔離模型或試算表執行：檢查 tag 移動後的摘要。 核對「簽章應繫結完整指定產物。」是否成立；保留輸入、預期、實際結果與差異。至少提出兩個競爭原因，選擇一項能區分它們的新增觀察。依事前定義的語義、容量或延遲條件判斷通過／保留，未執行的真實平臺項目不得標為實測。
steps.instructionEn: Replay the mentor for artifact binding and execute in your own isolated model or worksheet: Check digest after tag movement. Check the principle: Signatures bind the exact artifact. Preserve input, expected output, observed output and differences. Propose two competing causes and a discriminating observation. Apply predefined semantic, capacity or latency criteria and mark untested real-platform claims unresolved.
steps.observation: 檢查 tag 移動後的摘要。
steps.observationEn: Check digest after tag movement.
steps.failure: 常見誤判：有效簽章讓 metadata 永遠不會過期。 本步需分開功能正確、資源上界與證據範圍，不可把假想結果當作真實平臺保證。
steps.failureEn: Common mistake: Valid signatures make metadata never expire. Separate correctness, resource bounds and evidence scope; hypothetical results are not real-platform guarantees.
steps.check: 提交「Artifact 繫結」的輸入與結果對照、競爭原因、接受／保留理由；逐項說明「檢查 tag 移動後的摘要。」的證據與尚未驗證範圍。
steps.checkEn: Submit artifact binding input/output comparisons, competing causes and pass/hold rationale; state evidence and untested scope for the experiment.

Draw components/data flows offline; specify inputs, outputs, retained state and legal transitions. Build baseline and perturbed hypothetical cases and make a falsifiable prediction. Plan validation using: Audit fictional issuer/subject combinations. Record versions, units, unknowns and out-of-model behavior.

steps.title: 離線驗證：原理與架構
steps.objective: 以「離線驗證」建立可檢查的架構、原理與驗證依據。

steps.instruction: 先觀看師傅示意，辨識「離線驗證」的資料、控制與時間關係。離線包需帶足合法驗證證據。 在離線工作臺畫出元件／資料流，列出輸入、輸出、保存狀態與合法轉移；建立基準與擾動兩種假想情境，寫下可被反駁的預測。以「列出簽章、chain 與政策。」設計下一步驗證。記錄版本、單位、未知參數與模型外的行為。
steps.instructionEn: Watch the mentor and identify data, control and timing relationships for offline verification. Offline bundles need sufficient valid evidence. Draw components/data flows offline; specify inputs, outputs, retained state and legal transitions. Build baseline and perturbed hypothetical cases and make a falsifiable prediction. Plan validation using: List signatures, chains and policy. Record versions, units, unknowns and out-of-model behavior.
steps.observation: 列出簽章、chain 與政策。

steps.failure: 常見誤判：有效簽章讓 metadata 永遠不會過期。 本步需分開功能正確、資源上界與證據範圍，不可把假想結果當作真實平臺保證。

steps.objective: 用「列出簽章、chain 與政策。」檢查「離線驗證」的假設、結果及失效邊界。

steps.instruction: 重播師傅對「離線驗證」的示範，在自己的隔離模型或試算表執行：列出簽章、chain 與政策。 核對「離線包需帶足合法驗證證據。」是否成立；保留輸入、預期、實際結果與差異。至少提出兩個競爭原因，選擇一項能區分它們的新增觀察。依事前定義的語義、容量或延遲條件判斷通過／保留，未執行的真實平臺項目不得標為實測。
steps.instructionEn: Replay the mentor for offline verification and execute in your own isolated model or worksheet: List signatures, chains and policy. Check the principle: Offline bundles need sufficient valid evidence. Preserve input, expected output, observed output and differences. Propose two competing causes and a discriminating observation. Apply predefined semantic, capacity or latency criteria and mark untested real-platform claims unresolved.
steps.observation: 列出簽章、chain 與政策。

steps.failure: 常見誤判：有效簽章讓 metadata 永遠不會過期。 本步需分開功能正確、資源上界與證據範圍，不可把假想結果當作真實平臺保證。
steps.failureEn: Common mistake: Valid signatures make metadata never expire. Separate correctness, resource bounds and evidence scope; hypothetical results are not real-platform guarantees.
steps.check: 提交「離線驗證」的輸入與結果對照、競爭原因、接受／保留理由；逐項說明「列出簽章、chain 與政策。」的證據與尚未驗證範圍。
steps.checkEn: Submit offline verification input/output comparisons, competing causes and pass/hold rationale; state evidence and untested scope for the experiment.

scope: 公開原理的雙語工程教育；工作臺是概念模擬，不是特定廠商產品的完整模擬器。數值為自行設定的教學假設。實驗僅限離線模型、自己的隔離環境或明確授權的測試資料；不掃描或改動真實第三方系統，未測平臺保留未決。
scopeEn: Bilingual engineering education from public principles; the workbench is a conceptual simulation, not a complete simulator of any vendor product. Inputs are original teaching assumptions. Experiments use offline models, owned isolated environments or explicitly authorized test data, never scan/modify third-party systems and leave untested platforms unresolved.

workedExample.assumptionsEn: Use the stated units, boundaries and idealizations; recalculate after version, workload, fault-model or resource changes.
workedExample.sourceScope: 作者原創算例；官方來源支援原理與背景，不是這組數字的實測來源。
workedExample.sourceScopeEn: Original assumed example; official sources support principles/context, not measurements of these numbers.

title: 災難復原與備份演練
summary: 以RPO、RTO 與獨立還原證據連結 16 個技術單元，新增 32 步原理、架構、假想算例、實驗設計與失效驗證。
summaryEn: Sixteen technical units connect rpo, rto and independent restore evidence through 32 new tasks covering principles, architecture, assumed calculations, experiment design and failure validation.

stages.title: 業務目標與範圍
stages.description: 四個技術單元以原理／架構與實驗／驗證兩步完成「業務目標與範圍」；每步獨立保存進度與知識測驗。
stages.descriptionEn: Four technical units develop business goals and scope through separate principle/architecture and experiment/validation tasks with saved progress and knowledge checks.

steps.title: RPO：原理與架構
steps.objective: 以「RPO」建立可檢查的架構、原理與驗證依據。
steps.objectiveEn: Establish reviewable architecture, principles and evidence for rpo.
steps.instruction: 先觀看師傅示意，辨識「RPO」的資料、控制與時間關係。可容忍資料損失需用時間或事件界定。 在離線工作臺畫出元件／資料流，列出輸入、輸出、保存狀態與合法轉移；建立基準與擾動兩種假想情境，寫下可被反駁的預測。以「標出最後可恢復提交點。」設計下一步驗證。記錄版本、單位、未知參數與模型外的行為。
steps.instructionEn: Watch the mentor and identify data, control and timing relationships for rpo. Tolerable loss needs time/event boundaries. Draw components/data flows offline; specify inputs, outputs, retained state and legal transitions. Build baseline and perturbed hypothetical cases and make a falsifiable prediction. Plan validation using: Mark the last recoverable commit. Record versions, units, unknowns and out-of-model behavior.
steps.observation: 標出最後可恢復提交點。
steps.observationEn: Mark the last recoverable commit.
steps.failure: 常見誤判：備份工作成功就證明 RTO 已達成。 本步需分開功能正確、資源上界與證據範圍，不可把假想結果當作真實平臺保證。
steps.failureEn: Common mistake: Successful backup jobs prove RTO compliance. Separate correctness, resource bounds and evidence scope; hypothetical results are not real-platform guarantees.
steps.check: 提交「RPO」的兩情境架構／狀態圖、參數表與可反駁預測；標出哪些資料支援「可容忍資料損失需用時間或事件界定。」。
steps.checkEn: Submit rpo two-case architecture/state diagrams, parameter table and falsifiable prediction; identify evidence supporting the principle.

knowledge.title: RPO的原理與邊界
knowledge.text: 可容忍資料損失需用時間或事件界定。
knowledge.textEn: Tolerable loss needs time/event boundaries.

knowledge.title: RPO的驗證設計
knowledge.text: 標出最後可恢復提交點。 保留基準與擾動的完整輸入／輸出，以語義、容量或時間條件檢查，並明列假想模型未涵蓋的現實因素。
knowledge.textEn: Mark the last recoverable commit. Retain complete inputs/outputs for baseline and perturbation, check semantic/capacity/timing criteria and state real-world factors omitted from the hypothetical model.

knowledge.title: 本課原創量化算例
knowledge.text: 假設 2 TB 十進位基底以持續 400 MB/s 還原，純資料搬移下界=5000 s≈83.3 min；需重播 120 GB 日誌、200 MB/s 約 10 min，串列合計至少 93.3 min，未含驗證、配置及索引。
knowledge.textEn: Restoring assumed 2 decimal TB at sustained 400 MB/s takes at least 5000 s≈83.3 min. Replaying 120 GB logs at 200 MB/s adds 10 min serially, for at least 93.3 min excluding checks, setup and indexes.

steps.instruction: 重播師傅對「RPO」的示範，在自己的隔離模型或試算表執行：標出最後可恢復提交點。 核對「可容忍資料損失需用時間或事件界定。」是否成立；保留輸入、預期、實際結果與差異。至少提出兩個競爭原因，選擇一項能區分它們的新增觀察。依事前定義的語義、容量或延遲條件判斷通過／保留，未執行的真實平臺項目不得標為實測。
steps.instructionEn: Replay the mentor for rpo and execute in your own isolated model or worksheet: Mark the last recoverable commit. Check the principle: Tolerable loss needs time/event boundaries. Preserve input, expected output, observed output and differences. Propose two competing causes and a discriminating observation. Apply predefined semantic, capacity or latency criteria and mark untested real-platform claims unresolved.

knowledge.textEn: Build a modeled issue tracker. Retain complete inputs/outputs for baseline and perturbation, check semantic/capacity/timing criteria and state real-world factors omitted from the hypothetical model.

knowledge.title: 本課原創量化算例
knowledge.text: 假設 2 TB 十進位基底以持續 400 MB/s 還原，純資料搬移下界=5000 s≈83.3 min；需重播 120 GB 日誌、200 MB/s 約 10 min，串列合計至少 93.3 min，未含驗證、配置及索引。
knowledge.textEn: Restoring assumed 2 decimal TB at sustained 400 MB/s takes at least 5000 s≈83.3 min. Replaying 120 GB logs at 200 MB/s adds 10 min serially, for at least 93.3 min excluding checks, setup and indexes.

quiz.question: 本步審查「修正閉環」與整體「災難復原與備份演練」時，哪項陳述或驗證有依據？
quiz.questionEn: When reviewing remediation loop within disaster recovery and backup exercises, which statement or check is supported?
options: 演練缺口需責任、期限及再測。
備份工作成功就證明 RTO 已達成。
資料有副本就不需保存解密金鑰。
optionsEn: Gaps need owners, deadlines and retests.
Successful backup jobs prove RTO compliance.
Data replicas remove the need to retain decryption keys.
quiz.explanation: 演練缺口需責任、期限及再測。 建立假想問題追蹤表。 其餘選項混淆不同架構或證據的適用邊界。
quiz.explanationEn: Gaps need owners, deadlines and retests. Build a modeled issue tracker. The alternatives confuse architectural or evidence boundaries.

steps.title: 修正閉環：實驗與驗證
steps.objective: 用「建立假想問題追蹤表。」檢查「修正閉環」的假設、結果及失效邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Validate assumptions, outcomes and failure boundaries for remediation loop using the specified experiment.
steps.instruction: 重播師傅對「修正閉環」的示範，在自己的隔離模型或試算表執行：建立假想問題追蹤表。 核對「演練缺口需責任、期限及再測。」是否成立；保留輸入、預期、實際結果與差異。至少提出兩個競爭原因，選擇一項能區分它們的新增觀察。依事前定義的語義、容量或延遲條件判斷通過／保留，未執行的真實平臺項目不得標為實測。
steps.instructionEn: Replay the mentor for remediation loop and execute in your own isolated model or worksheet: Build a modeled issue tracker. Check the principle: Gaps need owners, deadlines and retests. Preserve input, expected output, observed output and differences. Propose two competing causes and a discriminating observation. Apply predefined semantic, capacity or latency criteria and mark untested real-platform claims unresolved.
steps.observation: 建立假想問題追蹤表。
steps.observationEn: Build a modeled issue tracker.
steps.failure: 常見誤判：資料有副本就不需保存解密金鑰。 本步需分開功能正確、資源上界與證據範圍，不可把假想結果當作真實平臺保證。
steps.failureEn: Common mistake: Data replicas remove the need to retain decryption keys. Separate correctness, resource bounds and evidence scope; hypothetical results are not real-platform guarantees.
steps.check: 提交「修正閉環」的輸入與結果對照、競爭原因、接受／保留理由；逐項說明「建立假想問題追蹤表。」的證據與尚未驗證範圍。
steps.checkEn: Submit remediation loop input/output comparisons, competing causes and pass/hold rationale; state evidence and untested scope for the experiment.

scope: 公開原理的雙語工程教育；工作臺是概念模擬，不是特定廠商產品的完整模擬器。數值為自行設定的教學假設。實驗僅限離線模型、自己的隔離環境或明確授權的測試資料；不掃描或改動真實第三方系統，未測平臺保留未決。
scopeEn: Bilingual engineering education from public principles; the workbench is a conceptual simulation, not a complete simulator of any vendor product. Inputs are original teaching assumptions. Experiments use offline models, owned isolated environments or explicitly authorized test data, never scan/modify third-party systems and leave untested platforms unresolved.

workedExample.title: 原創可重算假想案例
workedExample.titleEn: Original reproducible hypothetical case
workedExample.text: 假設 2 TB 十進位基底以持續 400 MB/s 還原，純資料搬移下界=5000 s≈83.3 min；需重播 120 GB 日誌、200 MB/s 約 10 min，串列合計至少 93.3 min，未含驗證、配置及索引。
workedExample.textEn: Restoring assumed 2 decimal TB at sustained 400 MB/s takes at least 5000 s≈83.3 min. Replaying 120 GB logs at 200 MB/s adds 10 min serially, for at least 93.3 min excluding checks, setup and indexes.
workedExample.assumptions: 使用算例明列的單位、邊界與理想化前提；改變版本、工作負載、故障模型或資源條件後重算。
workedExample.assumptionsEn: Use the stated units, boundaries and idealizations; recalculate after version, workload, fault-model or resource changes.
workedExample.sourceScope: 作者原創算例；官方來源支援原理與背景，不是這組數字的實測來源。
workedExample.sourceScopeEn: Original assumed example; official sources support principles/context, not measurements of these numbers.

title: 高可用網站架構
summary: 以SLO、失效域與有限容量網站連結 16 個技術單元，新增 32 步原理、架構、假想算例、實驗設計與失效驗證。
summaryEn: Sixteen technical units connect slos, failure domains and finite-capacity websites through 32 new tasks covering principles, architecture, assumed calculations, experiment design and failure validation.

stages.title: 服務與失效契約
stages.description: 四個技術單元以原理／架構與實驗／驗證兩步完成「服務與失效契約」；每步獨立保存進度與知識測驗。
stages.descriptionEn: Four technical units develop service and failure contracts through separate principle/architecture and experiment/validation tasks with saved progress and knowledge checks.

steps.title: 使用者路徑：原理與架構
steps.objective: 以「使用者路徑」建立可檢查的架構、原理與驗證依據。
steps.objectiveEn: Establish reviewable architecture, principles and evidence for user paths.
steps.instruction: 先觀看師傅示意，辨識「使用者路徑」的資料、控制與時間關係。首頁存活不代表所有關鍵操作成功。 在離線工作臺畫出元件／資料流，列出輸入、輸出、保存狀態與合法轉移；建立基準與擾動兩種假想情境，寫下可被反駁的預測。以「畫登入、讀取與寫入路徑。」設計下一步驗證。記錄版本、單位、未知參數與模型外的行為。
steps.instructionEn: Watch the mentor and identify data, control and timing relationships for user paths. A live homepage does not establish critical-operation success. Draw components/data flows offline; specify inputs, outputs, retained state and legal transitions. Build baseline and perturbed hypothetical cases and make a falsifiable prediction. Plan validation using: Draw login, read and write paths. Record versions, units, unknowns and out-of-model behavior.
steps.observation: 畫登入、讀取與寫入路徑。
steps.observationEn: Draw login, read and write paths.
steps.failure: 常見誤判：兩個 99.9% 元件串列仍是 99.9%。 本步需分開功能正確、資源上界與證據範圍，不可把假想結果當作真實平臺保證。
steps.failureEn: Common mistake: Two 99.9% components in series still yield 99.9%. Separate correctness, resource bounds and evidence scope; hypothetical results are not real-platform guarantees.
steps.check: 提交「使用者路徑」的兩情境架構／狀態圖、參數表與可反駁預測；標出哪些資料支援「首頁存活不代表所有關鍵操作成功。」。
steps.checkEn: Submit user paths two-case architecture/state diagrams, parameter table and falsifiable prediction; identify evidence supporting the principle.

knowledge.title: 使用者路徑的驗證設計
knowledge.text: 畫登入、讀取與寫入路徑。 保留基準與擾動的完整輸入／輸出，以語義、容量或時間條件檢查，並明列假想模型未涵蓋的現實因素。
knowledge.textEn: Draw login, read and write paths. Retain complete inputs/outputs for baseline and perturbation, check semantic/capacity/timing criteria and state real-world factors omitted from the hypothetical model.

knowledge.title: 本課原創量化算例
knowledge.text: 30 天共 43,200 min，99.9% 可用率的時間型錯誤預算=43.2 min。假設兩元件獨立且皆 99.9%，串列 A=0.999²=99.8001%；備援才可用 1−(1−A)²，獨立假設常不成立。
knowledge.textEn: Thirty days contain 43,200 min; 99.9% time availability permits 43.2 min. Two independent 99.9% components in series yield 99.8001%; redundancy uses 1−(1−A)² only when independence assumptions apply.

scope: 公開原理的雙語工程教育；工作臺是概念模擬，不是特定廠商產品的完整模擬器。數值為自行設定的教學假設。實驗僅限離線模型、自己的隔離環境或明確授權的測試資料；不掃描或改動真實第三方系統，未測平臺保留未決。
scopeEn: Bilingual engineering education from public principles; the workbench is a conceptual simulation, not a complete simulator of any vendor product. Inputs are original teaching assumptions. Experiments use offline models, owned isolated environments or explicitly authorized test data, never scan/modify third-party systems and leave untested platforms unresolved.

title: 乙太網路交換器
summary: 以L2 學習、VLAN 與有限交換容量連結 16 個技術單元，新增 32 步原理、架構、假想算例、實驗設計與失效驗證。
summaryEn: Sixteen technical units connect l2 learning, vlans and finite switching capacity through 32 new tasks covering principles, architecture, assumed calculations, experiment design and failure validation.

stages.title: 框架與學習
stages.description: 四個技術單元以原理／架構與實驗／驗證兩步完成「框架與學習」；每步獨立保存進度與知識測驗。
stages.descriptionEn: Four technical units develop frames and learning through separate principle/architecture and experiment/validation tasks with saved progress and knowledge checks.

steps.title: 框架欄位：原理與架構
steps.objective: 以「框架欄位」建立可檢查的架構、原理與驗證依據。

steps.instruction: 先觀看師傅示意，辨識「框架欄位」的資料、控制與時間關係。來源與目的 MAC 屬於框架而非 IP 路由。 在離線工作臺畫出元件／資料流，列出輸入、輸出、保存狀態與合法轉移；建立基準與擾動兩種假想情境，寫下可被反駁的預測。以「分類 L2 與 L3 位址。」設計下一步驗證。記錄版本、單位、未知參數與模型外的行為。
steps.instructionEn: Watch the mentor and identify data, control and timing relationships for frame fields. Source/destination MACs belong to frames, not IP routes. Draw components/data flows offline; specify inputs, outputs, retained state and legal transitions. Build baseline and perturbed hypothetical cases and make a falsifiable prediction. Plan validation using: Classify L2 and L3 addresses. Record versions, units, unknowns and out-of-model behavior.
steps.observation: 分類 L2 與 L3 位址。

knowledge.title: 本課原創量化算例
knowledge.text: 假設 10 Gb/s Ethernet 最小框架 64 B，另計 8 B preamble/SFD 與 12 B IFG，每框架線路佔用 84 B，理想為 10¹⁰/(84×8)≈14.881 Mframes/s；VLAN 與不同框架長度需重算。
knowledge.textEn: At assumed 10 Gb/s, a 64 B minimum frame plus 8 B preamble/SFD and 12 B IFG occupies 84 B: about 14.881 Mframes/s ideal. VLAN and other frame sizes need recalculation.

steps.instructionEn: Watch the mentor and identify data, control and timing relationships for link aggregation. One flow may not fill all aggregated links. Draw components/data flows offline; specify inputs, outputs, retained state and legal transitions. Build baseline and perturbed hypothetical cases and make a falsifiable prediction. Plan validation using: Compare single/multiflow hashing. Record versions, units, unknowns and out-of-model behavior.
steps.observation: 比較多流與單流 hash。

steps.title: Link 聚合：實驗與驗證

steps.instructionEn: Replay the mentor for link aggregation and execute in your own isolated model or worksheet: Compare single/multiflow hashing. Check the principle: One flow may not fill all aggregated links. Preserve input, expected output, observed output and differences. Propose two competing causes and a discriminating observation. Apply predefined semantic, capacity or latency criteria and mark untested real-platform claims unresolved.

scope: 公開原理的雙語工程教育；工作臺是概念模擬，不是特定廠商產品的完整模擬器。數值為自行設定的教學假設。實驗僅限離線模型、自己的隔離環境或明確授權的測試資料；不掃描或改動真實第三方系統，未測平臺保留未決。
scopeEn: Bilingual engineering education from public principles; the workbench is a conceptual simulation, not a complete simulator of any vendor product. Inputs are original teaching assumptions. Experiments use offline models, owned isolated environments or explicitly authorized test data, never scan/modify third-party systems and leave untested platforms unresolved.

workedExample.title: 原創可重算假想案例
workedExample.titleEn: Original reproducible hypothetical case
workedExample.text: 假設 10 Gb/s Ethernet 最小框架 64 B，另計 8 B preamble/SFD 與 12 B IFG，每框架線路佔用 84 B，理想為 10¹⁰/(84×8)≈14.881 Mframes/s；VLAN 與不同框架長度需重算。
workedExample.textEn: At assumed 10 Gb/s, a 64 B minimum frame plus 8 B preamble/SFD and 12 B IFG occupies 84 B: about 14.881 Mframes/s ideal. VLAN and other frame sizes need recalculation.
workedExample.assumptions: 使用算例明列的單位、邊界與理想化前提；改變版本、工作負載、故障模型或資源條件後重算。
workedExample.assumptionsEn: Use the stated units, boundaries and idealizations; recalculate after version, workload, fault-model or resource changes.
workedExample.sourceScope: 作者原創算例；官方來源支援原理與背景，不是這組數字的實測來源。
workedExample.sourceScopeEn: Original assumed example; official sources support principles/context, not measurements of these numbers.

title: 路由器封包轉送平面
summary: 以最長前綴、轉送管線與流量計量連結 16 個技術單元，新增 32 步原理、架構、假想算例、實驗設計與失效驗證。
summaryEn: Sixteen technical units connect longest prefixes, forwarding pipelines and traffic accounting through 32 new tasks covering principles, architecture, assumed calculations, experiment design and failure validation.

stages.title: 封包與查表
stages.description: 四個技術單元以原理／架構與實驗／驗證兩步完成「封包與查表」；每步獨立保存進度與知識測驗。
stages.descriptionEn: Four technical units develop packets and lookup through separate principle/architecture and experiment/validation tasks with saved progress and knowledge checks.

steps.title: RIB 與 FIB：原理與架構
steps.titleEn: RIB and FIB: principles and architecture
steps.objective: 以「RIB 與 FIB」建立可檢查的架構、原理與驗證依據。

steps.instruction: 先觀看師傅示意，辨識「RIB 與 FIB」的資料、控制與時間關係。控制路由資料與實際轉送表不同。 在離線工作臺畫出元件／資料流，列出輸入、輸出、保存狀態與合法轉移；建立基準與擾動兩種假想情境，寫下可被反駁的預測。以「核對路由選擇到 FIB 安裝。」設計下一步驗證。記錄版本、單位、未知參數與模型外的行為。
steps.instructionEn: Watch the mentor and identify data, control and timing relationships for rib and fib. Control routes differ from actual forwarding tables. Draw components/data flows offline; specify inputs, outputs, retained state and legal transitions. Build baseline and perturbed hypothetical cases and make a falsifiable prediction. Plan validation using: Audit route selection to FIB installation. Record versions, units, unknowns and out-of-model behavior.
steps.observation: 核對路由選擇到 FIB 安裝。
steps.observationEn: Audit route selection to FIB installation.
steps.failure: 常見誤判：路由選擇在所有匹配前綴中只看最小 metric。 本步需分開功能正確、資源上界與證據範圍，不可把假想結果當作真實平臺保證。
steps.failureEn: Common mistake: Routing chooses only the smallest metric across matching prefixes. Separate correctness, resource bounds and evidence scope; hypothetical results are not real-platform guarantees.
steps.check: 提交「RIB 與 FIB」的兩情境架構／狀態圖、參數表與可反駁預測；標出哪些資料支援「控制路由資料與實際轉送表不同。」。

knowledge.textEn: Control routes differ from actual forwarding tables.

knowledge.title: RIB 與 FIB的驗證設計
knowledge.text: 核對路由選擇到 FIB 安裝。 保留基準與擾動的完整輸入／輸出，以語義、容量或時間條件檢查，並明列假想模型未涵蓋的現實因素。
knowledge.textEn: Audit route selection to FIB installation. Retain complete inputs/outputs for baseline and perturbation, check semantic/capacity/timing criteria and state real-world factors omitted from the hypothetical model.

knowledge.title: 本課原創量化算例
knowledge.text: 假設路由有 10.0.0.0/8 → A、10.1.0.0/16 → B、10.1.2.0/24 → C；10.1.2.3 選 C（最長前綴），不是 metric 最小跨所有前綴。1 Gb/s 發送 1500 B 封包的純 serialization 為 12 µs，未含 L2 overhead。
knowledge.textEn: Routes 10.0.0.0/8→A, 10.1.0.0/16→B and 10.1.2.0/24→C send 10.1.2.3 to C by longest prefix, not a global metric minimum. Serializing 1500 B at 1 Gb/s takes 12 µs excluding L2 overhead.

steps.title: TTL：原理與架構

steps.objectiveEn: Establish reviewable architecture, principles and evidence for ttl.
steps.instruction: 先觀看師傅示意，辨識「TTL」的資料、控制與時間關係。轉送需更新存活限制並處理到期。 在離線工作臺畫出元件／資料流，列出輸入、輸出、保存狀態與合法轉移；建立基準與擾動兩種假想情境，寫下可被反駁的預測。以「模擬 TTL=1 與 TTL=2。」設計下一步驗證。記錄版本、單位、未知參數與模型外的行為。
steps.instructionEn: Watch the mentor and identify data, control and timing relationships for ttl. Forwarding updates lifetime and handles expiry. Draw components/data flows offline; specify inputs, outputs, retained state and legal transitions. Build baseline and perturbed hypothetical cases and make a falsifiable prediction. Plan validation using: Model TTL=1 and TTL=2. Record versions, units, unknowns and out-of-model behavior.
steps.observation: 模擬 TTL=1 與 TTL=2。

steps.check: 提交「TTL」的兩情境架構／狀態圖、參數表與可反駁預測；標出哪些資料支援「轉送需更新存活限制並處理到期。」。

steps.instructionEn: Watch the mentor and identify data, control and timing relationships for neighbor resolution. Next-hop IP needs usable link information. Draw components/data flows offline; specify inputs, outputs, retained state and legal transitions. Build baseline and perturbed hypothetical cases and make a falsifiable prediction. Plan validation using: Model a route with an unknown neighbor. Record versions, units, unknowns and out-of-model behavior.
steps.observation: 比較路由存在但鄰居未知。
steps.observationEn: Model a route with an unknown neighbor.
steps.failure: 常見誤判：查表成功證明封包已送到最終目的地。 本步需分開功能正確、資源上界與證據範圍，不可把假想結果當作真實平臺保證。

steps.check: 提交「Neighbor 解決」的兩情境架構／狀態圖、參數表與可反駁預測；標出哪些資料支援「下一跳 IP 需對應可用鏈路資訊。」。

steps.check: 提交「ACL 順序」的輸入與結果對照、競爭原因、接受／保留理由；逐項說明「核對接受與拒絕順序。」的證據與尚未驗證範圍。

scope: 公開原理的雙語工程教育；工作臺是概念模擬，不是特定廠商產品的完整模擬器。數值為自行設定的教學假設。實驗僅限離線模型、自己的隔離環境或明確授權的測試資料；不掃描或改動真實第三方系統，未測平臺保留未決。
scopeEn: Bilingual engineering education from public principles; the workbench is a conceptual simulation, not a complete simulator of any vendor product. Inputs are original teaching assumptions. Experiments use offline models, owned isolated environments or explicitly authorized test data, never scan/modify third-party systems and leave untested platforms unresolved.

workedExample.assumptionsEn: Use the stated units, boundaries and idealizations; recalculate after version, workload, fault-model or resource changes.

title: IPv6 網路部署
summary: 以位址規劃、鄰居探索與雙棧驗收連結 16 個技術單元，新增 32 步原理、架構、假想算例、實驗設計與失效驗證。
summaryEn: Sixteen technical units connect address planning, neighbor discovery and dual-stack acceptance through 32 new tasks covering principles, architecture, assumed calculations, experiment design and failure validation.

stages.title: 位址與範圍
stages.description: 四個技術單元以原理／架構與實驗／驗證兩步完成「位址與範圍」；每步獨立保存進度與知識測驗。
stages.descriptionEn: Four technical units develop addresses and scope through separate principle/architecture and experiment/validation tasks with saved progress and knowledge checks.

steps.title: 位址長度：原理與架構
steps.objective: 以「位址長度」建立可檢查的架構、原理與驗證依據。
steps.objectiveEn: Establish reviewable architecture, principles and evidence for address length.
steps.instruction: 先觀看師傅示意，辨識「位址長度」的資料、控制與時間關係。IPv6 位址為 128-bit 且前綴定義網路。 在離線工作臺畫出元件／資料流，列出輸入、輸出、保存狀態與合法轉移；建立基準與擾動兩種假想情境，寫下可被反駁的預測。以「展開壓縮表示並核對位數。」設計下一步驗證。記錄版本、單位、未知參數與模型外的行為。
steps.instructionEn: Watch the mentor and identify data, control and timing relationships for address length. IPv6 addresses have 128 bits and network prefixes. Draw components/data flows offline; specify inputs, outputs, retained state and legal transitions. Build baseline and perturbed hypothetical cases and make a falsifiable prediction. Plan validation using: Expand compressed notation and check width. Record versions, units, unknowns and out-of-model behavior.
steps.observation: 展開壓縮表示並核對位數。
steps.observationEn: Expand compressed notation and check width.
steps.failure: 常見誤判：IPv4 ACL 自動覆蓋相同服務的 IPv6。 本步需分開功能正確、資源上界與證據範圍，不可把假想結果當作真實平臺保證。
steps.failureEn: Common mistake: IPv4 ACLs automatically cover the same IPv6 services. Separate correctness, resource bounds and evidence scope; hypothetical results are not real-platform guarantees.
steps.check: 提交「位址長度」的兩情境架構／狀態圖、參數表與可反駁預測；標出哪些資料支援「IPv6 位址為 128-bit 且前綴定義網路。」。
steps.checkEn: Submit address length two-case architecture/state diagrams, parameter table and falsifiable prediction; identify evidence supporting the principle.

knowledge.title: 本課原創量化算例
knowledge.text: 假設分配 /48，每子網 /64，可有 2^(64−48)=65,536 個 /64 子網；不是主機數。單一 /64 理論含 2^64 個位址，但可用與配置受保留、介面及政策限制。IPv6 最小鏈路 MTU=1280 B，不能與 TCP payload 混同。
knowledge.textEn: A /48 split into /64 yields 65,536 subnets, not hosts. A /64 contains 2^64 theoretical addresses, with use constrained by reservations/interfaces/policy. IPv6 minimum link MTU is 1280 B, not TCP payload.

/48 分成 /64 的 65,536 數字是主機數。
optionsEn: IPv6 addresses have 128 bits and network prefixes.

65,536 from /48-to-/64 subdivision counts hosts.

steps.instructionEn: Replay the mentor for address length and execute in your own isolated model or worksheet: Expand compressed notation and check width. Check the principle: IPv6 addresses have 128 bits and network prefixes. Preserve input, expected output, observed output and differences. Propose two competing causes and a discriminating observation. Apply predefined semantic, capacity or latency criteria and mark untested real-platform claims unresolved.

steps.check: 提交「位址長度」的輸入與結果對照、競爭原因、接受／保留理由；逐項說明「展開壓縮表示並核對位數。」的證據與尚未驗證範圍。
steps.checkEn: Submit address length input/output comparisons, competing causes and pass/hold rationale; state evidence and untested scope for the experiment.

steps.instructionEn: Watch the mentor and identify data, control and timing relationships for dual-stack policies. IPv4 defenses do not automatically cover IPv6. Draw components/data flows offline; specify inputs, outputs, retained state and legal transitions. Build baseline and perturbed hypothetical cases and make a falsifiable prediction. Plan validation using: Build a two-stack permission matrix. Record versions, units, unknowns and out-of-model behavior.
steps.observation: 建立兩棧一致允許矩陣。
steps.observationEn: Build a two-stack permission matrix.
steps.failure: 常見誤判：IPv4 ACL 自動覆蓋相同服務的 IPv6。 本步需分開功能正確、資源上界與證據範圍，不可把假想結果當作真實平臺保證。

steps.check: 提交「雙棧政策」的兩情境架構／狀態圖、參數表與可反駁預測；標出哪些資料支援「IPv4 防禦規則不自動涵蓋 IPv6。」。

steps.title: 驗收矩陣：實驗與驗證
steps.objective: 用「用純離線範例建立測試表。」檢查「驗收矩陣」的假設、結果及失效邊界。

steps.instructionEn: Replay the mentor for acceptance matrix and execute in your own isolated model or worksheet: Build checks from offline-only examples. Check the principle: Addresses, MTUs, policies and failures need separate checks. Preserve input, expected output, observed output and differences. Propose two competing causes and a discriminating observation. Apply predefined semantic, capacity or latency criteria and mark untested real-platform claims unresolved.

scope: 公開原理的雙語工程教育；工作臺是概念模擬，不是特定廠商產品的完整模擬器。數值為自行設定的教學假設。實驗僅限離線模型、自己的隔離環境或明確授權的測試資料；不掃描或改動真實第三方系統，未測平臺保留未決。
scopeEn: Bilingual engineering education from public principles; the workbench is a conceptual simulation, not a complete simulator of any vendor product. Inputs are original teaching assumptions. Experiments use offline models, owned isolated environments or explicitly authorized test data, never scan/modify third-party systems and leave untested platforms unresolved.

workedExample.title: 原創可重算假想案例
workedExample.titleEn: Original reproducible hypothetical case
workedExample.text: 假設分配 /48，每子網 /64，可有 2^(64−48)=65,536 個 /64 子網；不是主機數。單一 /64 理論含 2^64 個位址，但可用與配置受保留、介面及政策限制。IPv6 最小鏈路 MTU=1280 B，不能與 TCP payload 混同。

workedExample.assumptionsEn: Use the stated units, boundaries and idealizations; recalculate after version, workload, fault-model or resource changes.
workedExample.sourceScope: 作者原創算例；官方來源支援原理與背景，不是這組數字的實測來源。
workedExample.sourceScopeEn: Original assumed example; official sources support principles/context, not measurements of these numbers.

title: 網域名稱系統架構
summary: 以分散式命名、快取一致性與驗證鏈串連 16 個領域技術單元、32 個保存步驟；分析架構、原理、介面、故障、量化案例與防禦證據。
summaryEn: Sixteen domain-specific technical units and 32 saved steps connect distributed naming, cache consistency and validation chains through architecture, principles, interfaces, faults, quantitative cases and defensive evidence.

stages.title: 需求、元件與基本模型
stages.description: 四個領域技術單元各完成原理建模與對照證據，共八項可個別保存的作業。
stages.descriptionEn: Four domain units each pair principle modeling with controlled evidence, producing eight separately saved tasks.

steps.title: 樹狀命名空間：架構與原理
steps.objective: 針對「樹狀命名空間」建立有邊界、可反駁的系統模型。
steps.objectiveEn: For hierarchical namespace, construct a bounded falsifiable system model.
steps.instruction: 觀看師傅的功能示意後，以「樹狀命名空間」為中心標出輸入、輸出、信任或資源邊界，並在學徒工作台排列資料流或元件。原理是：域名是標籤路徑，管理區域不必等於整個子樹。 使用自行編寫的兩組小型資料或試算表，建立基準與一次只改一項的對照：只改 TTL，比較更新後舊值最長保留時間。 先寫出可被反駁的預測；把「解析器責任」視為相鄰問題，說明它如何影響模型而不能混同。數值只採本課假想算例或自訂並列明單位；本步保存架構圖、假設表與預測。
steps.instructionEn: After the mentor functional diagram, mark inputs, outputs and trust/resource boundaries around hierarchical namespace, then arrange components or data flows in the apprentice workspace. Principle: Names are label paths; a managed zone need not cover its whole subtree. Create two small authored datasets or spreadsheet cases: a baseline and a one-variable change. Change only TTL and compare maximum stale-answer duration. Predict a falsifiable outcome before evaluating it. Treat resolver responsibilities as a neighboring issue and explain its influence without conflating them. Use only the stated hypothetical case or declared assumed inputs/units. Save the architecture, assumptions and prediction.
steps.observation: 只改 TTL，比較更新後舊值最長保留時間。 比較「樹狀命名空間」與「解析器責任」的證據是否支持相同推論。
steps.observationEn: Change only TTL and compare maximum stale-answer duration. Compare whether evidence for hierarchical namespace and resolver responsibilities supports the same inference.
steps.failure: DNSSEC 會加密所有名稱查詢。 這是本課要排除的誤判；先核對模型邊界、來源版本及缺失證據。
steps.failureEn: DNSSEC encrypts every name query. This is a misconception to reject; check boundaries, source versions and missing evidence.
steps.check: 提交「樹狀命名空間」的功能草圖、基準／擾動表、單位或欄位定義、可反駁預測及接受／保留理由。需能重算本課假想例，並說明相鄰機制不可取代的驗證。
steps.checkEn: Submit a functional sketch, baseline/perturbation table, unit/field definitions, falsifiable prediction and accept/hold rationale for hierarchical namespace. Recompute the course case and explain verification that the neighboring mechanism cannot replace.

knowledge.title: 原理、架構與適用邊界
knowledge.text: 域名是標籤路徑，管理區域不必等於整個子樹。
knowledge.textEn: Names are label paths; a managed zone need not cover its whole subtree.

knowledge.title: 相鄰機制與不可混同處
knowledge.text: 相鄰的「解析器責任」：遞迴解析器代客追查，權威伺服器提供其區域資料。 必須另列其證據，不能把這項機制的通過當作「樹狀命名空間」已通過。
knowledge.textEn: Neighboring resolver responsibilities: Recursive resolvers pursue answers; authoritative servers publish their zones. Record its evidence separately; its success does not prove hierarchical namespace passes.

knowledge.title: 受控對照與證據品質
knowledge.text: 只改 TTL，比較更新後舊值最長保留時間。 只變一個條件，保留相同資料格式、時間範圍及分母；模型估計與實測證據要分別標記。
knowledge.textEn: Change only TTL and compare maximum stale-answer duration. Change one condition and retain comparable formats, intervals and denominators; label estimates separately from measured evidence.

knowledge.title: 可重算的原創假想例
knowledge.text: 假設 80% 查詢命中 2 ms 快取，其餘需 50 ms，平均為 0.8×2+0.2×50=11.6 ms；這不表示 p99 為 11.6 ms，也未計排隊。
knowledge.textEn: Assume 80% cache hits at 2 ms and misses at 50 ms: mean latency is 11.6 ms; p99 is not 11.6 ms and queuing is excluded.

quiz.question: 針對「樹狀命名空間」的原理與可觀測性，哪項最直接成立？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement most directly explains the principle/observability of hierarchical namespace?
options: 域名是標籤路徑，管理區域不必等於整個子樹。
DNSSEC 會加密所有名稱查詢。
只檢查「解析器責任」，便可取代「樹狀命名空間」的專屬驗證。
optionsEn: Names are label paths; a managed zone need not cover its whole subtree.
DNSSEC encrypts every name query.
Checking resolver responsibilities alone replaces verification specific to hierarchical namespace.
quiz.explanation: 域名是標籤路徑，管理區域不必等於整個子樹。 相鄰的「解析器責任」有不同責任：遞迴解析器代客追查，權威伺服器提供其區域資料。因此不能用該項通過或課內誤判取代本單元證據。
quiz.explanationEn: Names are label paths; a managed zone need not cover its whole subtree. Neighboring resolver responsibilities has a different role: Recursive resolvers pursue answers; authoritative servers publish their zones. Its success or the stated misconception cannot replace unit-specific evidence.

steps.title: 樹狀命名空間：對照試驗與證據
steps.titleEn: Hierarchical namespace: controlled experiment and evidence
steps.objective: 針對「樹狀命名空間」完成含競爭原因及不確定度的驗收紀錄。
steps.objectiveEn: For hierarchical namespace, complete acceptance evidence with competing causes and uncertainty.
steps.instruction: 重播本單元示意，讀取自製的基準與擾動紀錄，不接觸未授權目標。對照「域名是標籤路徑，管理區域不必等於整個子樹。」，執行下列紙上或本地合成資料試驗：只改 TTL，比較更新後舊值最長保留時間。 分開記錄預測、觀察與不確定度，再提出至少兩個可能原因；利用「解析器責任」的獨立證據排除一個原因。若結果只來自模型，標記為模擬，不能當作真實設備量測。最後說明目前應接受、保留或拒絕哪一項要求，並保存可重算資料。
steps.instructionEn: Replay the unit diagram and inspect your authored baseline/perturbed records without accessing unauthorized targets. Evaluate the principle: Names are label paths; a managed zone need not cover its whole subtree. Conduct this paper or local synthetic-data experiment: Change only TTL and compare maximum stale-answer duration. Record prediction, observation and uncertainty separately, propose two competing causes and use independent evidence from resolver responsibilities to exclude one. Model outputs must remain labeled simulation, not physical measurements. Explain which requirement to accept, hold or reject and retain recomputable records.
steps.observation: 只改 TTL，比較更新後舊值最長保留時間。 比較「樹狀命名空間」與「解析器責任」的證據是否支持相同推論。
steps.observationEn: Change only TTL and compare maximum stale-answer duration. Compare whether evidence for hierarchical namespace and resolver responsibilities supports the same inference.
steps.failure: DNSSEC 會加密所有名稱查詢。 這是本課要排除的誤判；先核對模型邊界、來源版本及缺失證據。
steps.failureEn: DNSSEC encrypts every name query. This is a misconception to reject; check boundaries, source versions and missing evidence.
steps.check: 提交「樹狀命名空間」的功能草圖、基準／擾動表、單位或欄位定義、可反駁預測及接受／保留理由。需能重算本課假想例，並說明相鄰機制不可取代的驗證。
steps.checkEn: Submit a functional sketch, baseline/perturbation table, unit/field definitions, falsifiable prediction and accept/hold rationale for hierarchical namespace. Recompute the course case and explain verification that the neighboring mechanism cannot replace.

steps.instruction: 重播本單元示意，讀取自製的基準與擾動紀錄，不接觸未授權目標。對照「遞迴解析器代客追查，權威伺服器提供其區域資料。」，執行下列紙上或本地合成資料試驗：只改 TTL，比較更新後舊值最長保留時間。 分開記錄預測、觀察與不確定度，再提出至少兩個可能原因；利用「資源紀錄型別」的獨立證據排除一個原因。若結果只來自模型，標記為模擬，不能當作真實設備量測。最後說明目前應接受、保留或拒絕哪一項要求，並保存可重算資料。

Record prediction, observation and uncertainty separately, propose two competing causes and use independent evidence from resource-record types to exclude one. Model outputs must remain labeled simulation, not physical measurements. Explain which requirement to accept, hold or reject and retain recomputable records.

steps.failureEn: Shorter TTL necessarily reduces every query latency. This is a misconception to reject; check boundaries, source versions and missing evidence.
steps.check: 提交「解析器責任」的功能草圖、基準／擾動表、單位或欄位定義、可反駁預測及接受／保留理由。需能重算本課假想例，並說明相鄰機制不可取代的驗證。

steps.instruction: 觀看師傅的功能示意後，以「證據交接」為中心標出輸入、輸出、信任或資源邊界，並在學徒工作台排列資料流或元件。原理是：可重現查詢需保留名稱、型別、視圖、時間及驗證狀態。 使用自行編寫的兩組小型資料或試算表，建立基準與一次只改一項的對照：固定負載，只改失去一台權威伺服器的情境。 先寫出可被反駁的預測；把「樹狀命名空間」視為相鄰問題，說明它如何影響模型而不能混同。數值只採本課假想算例或自訂並列明單位；本步保存架構圖、假設表與預測。
steps.instructionEn: After the mentor functional diagram, mark inputs, outputs and trust/resource boundaries around evidence handoff, then arrange components or data flows in the apprentice workspace. Principle: Reproducible queries record name, type, view, time and validation status. Create two small authored datasets or spreadsheet cases: a baseline and a one-variable change. Hold load fixed and model one authoritative-server outage. Predict a falsifiable outcome before evaluating it. Treat hierarchical namespace as a neighboring issue and explain its influence without conflating them. Use only the stated hypothetical case or declared assumed inputs/units. Save the architecture, assumptions and prediction.
steps.observation: 固定負載，只改失去一台權威伺服器的情境。 比較「證據交接」與「樹狀命名空間」的證據是否支持相同推論。
steps.observationEn: Hold load fixed and model one authoritative-server outage. Compare whether evidence for evidence handoff and hierarchical namespace supports the same inference.
steps.failure: 縮短 TTL 必然降低所有查詢延遲。 這是本課要排除的誤判；先核對模型邊界、來源版本及缺失證據。
steps.failureEn: Shorter TTL necessarily reduces every query latency. This is a misconception to reject; check boundaries, source versions and missing evidence.
steps.check: 提交「證據交接」的功能草圖、基準／擾動表、單位或欄位定義、可反駁預測及接受／保留理由。需能重算本課假想例，並說明相鄰機制不可取代的驗證。
steps.checkEn: Submit a functional sketch, baseline/perturbation table, unit/field definitions, falsifiable prediction and accept/hold rationale for evidence handoff. Recompute the course case and explain verification that the neighboring mechanism cannot replace.

knowledge.text: 可重現查詢需保留名稱、型別、視圖、時間及驗證狀態。

knowledge.title: 相鄰機制與不可混同處
knowledge.text: 相鄰的「樹狀命名空間」：域名是標籤路徑，管理區域不必等於整個子樹。 必須另列其證據，不能把這項機制的通過當作「證據交接」已通過。
knowledge.textEn: Neighboring hierarchical namespace: Names are label paths; a managed zone need not cover its whole subtree. Record its evidence separately; its success does not prove evidence handoff passes.

knowledge.title: 受控對照與證據品質
knowledge.text: 固定負載，只改失去一台權威伺服器的情境。 只變一個條件，保留相同資料格式、時間範圍及分母；模型估計與實測證據要分別標記。
knowledge.textEn: Hold load fixed and model one authoritative-server outage. Change one condition and retain comparable formats, intervals and denominators; label estimates separately from measured evidence.

knowledge.title: 可重算的原創假想例
knowledge.text: 假設 80% 查詢命中 2 ms 快取，其餘需 50 ms，平均為 0.8×2+0.2×50=11.6 ms；這不表示 p99 為 11.6 ms，也未計排隊。
knowledge.textEn: Assume 80% cache hits at 2 ms and misses at 50 ms: mean latency is 11.6 ms; p99 is not 11.6 ms and queuing is excluded.

只檢查「樹狀命名空間」，便可取代「證據交接」的專屬驗證。

steps.failureEn: Shorter TTL necessarily reduces every query latency. This is a misconception to reject; check boundaries, source versions and missing evidence.

scope: 公開原理的離線／本地合成資料工程教育。只使用自行生成資料或明確獲授權的測試環境；不提供真實目標掃描、漏洞利用、惡意程式、車輛／工控注入或實際射頻發射程序。數值為原創假設，非供應商保證或現場驗收標準。
scopeEn: Offline/local synthetic-data engineering education from public principles. Use authored data or explicitly authorized test environments only. No real-target scanning, exploitation, malware, vehicle/OT injection or live RF procedures. Numerical cases are original assumptions, not supplier guarantees or field acceptance criteria.

workedExample.text: 假設 80% 查詢命中 2 ms 快取，其餘需 50 ms，平均為 0.8×2+0.2×50=11.6 ms；這不表示 p99 為 11.6 ms，也未計排隊。

workedExample.assumptions: 只採算例中明列的教學條件；效能與安全估計須依拓撲、分布、開銷、版本與不確定度重算。
workedExample.assumptionsEn: Use only the stated teaching assumptions; recalculate for topology, distribution, overhead, versions and uncertainty.

workedExample.sourceScopeEn: Independently chosen teaching inputs; official sources support principles and specified material sizes, not measurements of this hypothetical platform.

title: 時間同步 PTP 網路
summary: 以時戳、路徑不對稱與時鐘伺服串連 16 個領域技術單元、32 個保存步驟；分析架構、原理、介面、故障、量化案例與防禦證據。
summaryEn: Sixteen domain-specific technical units and 32 saved steps connect timestamps, path asymmetry and clock servos through architecture, principles, interfaces, faults, quantitative cases and defensive evidence.

stages.title: 需求、元件與基本模型
stages.description: 四個領域技術單元各完成原理建模與對照證據，共八項可個別保存的作業。
stages.descriptionEn: Four domain units each pair principle modeling with controlled evidence, producing eight separately saved tasks.

steps.title: 時鐘域：架構與原理
steps.objective: 針對「時鐘域」建立有邊界、可反駁的系統模型。
steps.objectiveEn: For clock domains, construct a bounded falsifiable system model.
steps.instruction: 觀看師傅的功能示意後，以「時鐘域」為中心標出輸入、輸出、信任或資源邊界，並在學徒工作台排列資料流或元件。原理是：時鐘域是同步邊界，不是把所有裝置時間自動合併。 使用自行編寫的兩組小型資料或試算表，建立基準與一次只改一項的對照：改去程延遲而保留回程，辨識 offset 與 path delay 的混合。 先寫出可被反駁的預測；把「四時戳模型」視為相鄰問題，說明它如何影響模型而不能混同。數值只採本課假想算例或自訂並列明單位；本步保存架構圖、假設表與預測。
steps.instructionEn: After the mentor functional diagram, mark inputs, outputs and trust/resource boundaries around clock domains, then arrange components or data flows in the apprentice workspace. Principle: A clock domain defines a synchronization boundary, not automatic universal agreement. Create two small authored datasets or spreadsheet cases: a baseline and a one-variable change. Change forward delay only and identify offset/path-delay mixing. Predict a falsifiable outcome before evaluating it. Treat four-timestamp model as a neighboring issue and explain its influence without conflating them. Use only the stated hypothetical case or declared assumed inputs/units. Save the architecture, assumptions and prediction.
steps.observation: 改去程延遲而保留回程，辨識 offset 與 path delay 的混合。 比較「時鐘域」與「四時戳模型」的證據是否支持相同推論。
steps.observationEn: Change forward delay only and identify offset/path-delay mixing. Compare whether evidence for clock domains and four-timestamp model supports the same inference.
steps.failure: 雙向平均延遲可以自動消除不對稱。 這是本課要排除的誤判；先核對模型邊界、來源版本及缺失證據。
steps.failureEn: Averaging bidirectional delay automatically removes asymmetry. This is a misconception to reject; check boundaries, source versions and missing evidence.
steps.check: 提交「時鐘域」的功能草圖、基準／擾動表、單位或欄位定義、可反駁預測及接受／保留理由。需能重算本課假想例，並說明相鄰機制不可取代的驗證。
steps.checkEn: Submit a functional sketch, baseline/perturbation table, unit/field definitions, falsifiable prediction and accept/hold rationale for clock domains. Recompute the course case and explain verification that the neighboring mechanism cannot replace.

knowledge.title: 原理、架構與適用邊界
knowledge.text: 時鐘域是同步邊界，不是把所有裝置時間自動合併。
knowledge.textEn: A clock domain defines a synchronization boundary, not automatic universal agreement.

knowledge.title: 相鄰機制與不可混同處
knowledge.text: 相鄰的「四時戳模型」：offset 與延遲的分離需要雙向延遲對稱假設。 必須另列其證據，不能把這項機制的通過當作「時鐘域」已通過。
knowledge.textEn: Neighboring four-timestamp model: Separating offset and delay requires a bidirectional symmetry assumption. Record its evidence separately; its success does not prove clock domains passes.

knowledge.title: 受控對照與證據品質
knowledge.text: 改去程延遲而保留回程，辨識 offset 與 path delay 的混合。 只變一個條件，保留相同資料格式、時間範圍及分母；模型估計與實測證據要分別標記。
knowledge.textEn: Change forward delay only and identify offset/path-delay mixing. Change one condition and retain comparable formats, intervals and denominators; label estimates separately from measured evidence.

knowledge.title: 可重算的原創假想例
knowledge.text: 假設 t2−t1=120 ns、t4−t3=80 ns，對稱模型估 offset=(120−80)/2=20 ns、delay=100 ns；若去程多 40 ns，不對稱造成 20 ns 偏差。
knowledge.textEn: With t2−t1=120 ns and t4−t3=80 ns, the symmetric model gives offset=20 ns and delay=100 ns; 40 ns forward-path asymmetry biases offset by 20 ns.

Checking four-timestamp model alone replaces verification specific to clock domains.

steps.title: E2E 與 P2P：架構與原理
steps.titleEn: E2E versus P2P: architecture and principle
steps.objective: 針對「E2E 與 P2P」建立有邊界、可反駁的系統模型。
steps.objectiveEn: For e2e versus p2p, construct a bounded falsifiable system model.
steps.instruction: 觀看師傅的功能示意後，以「E2E 與 P2P」為中心標出輸入、輸出、信任或資源邊界，並在學徒工作台排列資料流或元件。原理是：端對端及鄰接延遲量測所估的路徑不同。 使用自行編寫的兩組小型資料或試算表，建立基準與一次只改一項的對照：固定同步週期，只改伺服器積分增益的假想響應。 先寫出可被反駁的預測；把「雙步時戳」視為相鄰問題，說明它如何影響模型而不能混同。數值只採本課假想算例或自訂並列明單位；本步保存架構圖、假設表與預測。
steps.instructionEn: After the mentor functional diagram, mark inputs, outputs and trust/resource boundaries around e2e versus p2p, then arrange components or data flows in the apprentice workspace. Principle: End-to-end and peer-delay methods estimate different path segments. Create two small authored datasets or spreadsheet cases: a baseline and a one-variable change. Fix sync interval and compare hypothetical integral gains. Predict a falsifiable outcome before evaluating it. Treat two-step timestamps as a neighboring issue and explain its influence without conflating them. Use only the stated hypothetical case or declared assumed inputs/units. Save the architecture, assumptions and prediction.
steps.observation: 固定同步週期，只改伺服器積分增益的假想響應。 比較「E2E 與 P2P」與「雙步時戳」的證據是否支持相同推論。
steps.observationEn: Fix sync interval and compare hypothetical integral gains. Compare whether evidence for e2e versus p2p and two-step timestamps supports the same inference.
steps.failure: 雙向平均延遲可以自動消除不對稱。 這是本課要排除的誤判；先核對模型邊界、來源版本及缺失證據。
steps.failureEn: Averaging bidirectional delay automatically removes asymmetry. This is a misconception to reject; check boundaries, source versions and missing evidence.
steps.check: 提交「E2E 與 P2P」的功能草圖、基準／擾動表、單位或欄位定義、可反駁預測及接受／保留理由。需能重算本課假想例，並說明相鄰機制不可取代的驗證。
steps.checkEn: Submit a functional sketch, baseline/perturbation table, unit/field definitions, falsifiable prediction and accept/hold rationale for e2e versus p2p. Recompute the course case and explain verification that the neighboring mechanism cannot replace.

knowledge.title: 原理、架構與適用邊界
knowledge.text: 端對端及鄰接延遲量測所估的路徑不同。
knowledge.textEn: End-to-end and peer-delay methods estimate different path segments.

knowledge.title: 相鄰機制與不可混同處
knowledge.text: 相鄰的「雙步時戳」：Follow_Up 補送精確發送時間，需要正確關聯 Sync。 必須另列其證據，不能把這項機制的通過當作「E2E 與 P2P」已通過。
knowledge.textEn: Neighboring two-step timestamps: Follow_Up supplies precise send time and must match its Sync. Record its evidence separately; its success does not prove e2e versus p2p passes.

knowledge.title: 受控對照與證據品質
knowledge.text: 固定同步週期，只改伺服器積分增益的假想響應。 只變一個條件，保留相同資料格式、時間範圍及分母；模型估計與實測證據要分別標記。
knowledge.textEn: Fix sync interval and compare hypothetical integral gains. Change one condition and retain comparable formats, intervals and denominators; label estimates separately from measured evidence.

quiz.question: 針對「E2E 與 P2P」的原理與可觀測性，哪項最直接成立？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement most directly explains the principle/observability of e2e versus p2p?
options: 雙向平均延遲可以自動消除不對稱。
只檢查「雙步時戳」，便可取代「E2E 與 P2P」的專屬驗證。
端對端及鄰接延遲量測所估的路徑不同。
optionsEn: Averaging bidirectional delay automatically removes asymmetry.
Checking two-step timestamps alone replaces verification specific to e2e versus p2p.
End-to-end and peer-delay methods estimate different path segments.
quiz.explanation: 端對端及鄰接延遲量測所估的路徑不同。 相鄰的「雙步時戳」有不同責任：Follow_Up 補送精確發送時間，需要正確關聯 Sync。因此不能用該項通過或課內誤判取代本單元證據。
quiz.explanationEn: End-to-end and peer-delay methods estimate different path segments. Neighboring two-step timestamps has a different role: Follow_Up supplies precise send time and must match its Sync. Its success or the stated misconception cannot replace unit-specific evidence.

steps.title: E2E 與 P2P：對照試驗與證據
steps.titleEn: E2E versus P2P: controlled experiment and evidence
steps.objective: 針對「E2E 與 P2P」完成含競爭原因及不確定度的驗收紀錄。
steps.objectiveEn: For e2e versus p2p, complete acceptance evidence with competing causes and uncertainty.
steps.instruction: 重播本單元示意，讀取自製的基準與擾動紀錄，不接觸未授權目標。對照「端對端及鄰接延遲量測所估的路徑不同。」，執行下列紙上或本地合成資料試驗：固定同步週期，只改伺服器積分增益的假想響應。 分開記錄預測、觀察與不確定度，再提出至少兩個可能原因；利用「雙步時戳」的獨立證據排除一個原因。若結果只來自模型，標記為模擬，不能當作真實設備量測。最後說明目前應接受、保留或拒絕哪一項要求，並保存可重算資料。
steps.instructionEn: Replay the unit diagram and inspect your authored baseline/perturbed records without accessing unauthorized targets. Evaluate the principle: End-to-end and peer-delay methods estimate different path segments. Conduct this paper or local synthetic-data experiment: Fix sync interval and compare hypothetical integral gains. Record prediction, observation and uncertainty separately, propose two competing causes and use independent evidence from two-step timestamps to exclude one. Model outputs must remain labeled simulation, not physical measurements. Explain which requirement to accept, hold or reject and retain recomputable records.
steps.observation: 固定同步週期，只改伺服器積分增益的假想響應。 比較「E2E 與 P2P」與「雙步時戳」的證據是否支持相同推論。
steps.observationEn: Fix sync interval and compare hypothetical integral gains. Compare whether evidence for e2e versus p2p and two-step timestamps supports the same inference.
steps.failure: 雙向平均延遲可以自動消除不對稱。 這是本課要排除的誤判；先核對模型邊界、來源版本及缺失證據。
steps.failureEn: Averaging bidirectional delay automatically removes asymmetry. This is a misconception to reject; check boundaries, source versions and missing evidence.
steps.check: 提交「E2E 與 P2P」的功能草圖、基準／擾動表、單位或欄位定義、可反駁預測及接受／保留理由。需能重算本課假想例，並說明相鄰機制不可取代的驗證。
steps.checkEn: Submit a functional sketch, baseline/perturbation table, unit/field definitions, falsifiable prediction and accept/hold rationale for e2e versus p2p. Recompute the course case and explain verification that the neighboring mechanism cannot replace.

steps.instruction: 觀看師傅的功能示意後，以「時間證據預算」為中心標出輸入、輸出、信任或資源邊界，並在學徒工作台排列資料流或元件。原理是：端到端誤差應涵蓋參考、時戳、路徑與校準不確定度。 使用自行編寫的兩組小型資料或試算表，建立基準與一次只改一項的對照：模擬 grandmaster 切換與失鎖的時間序列。 先寫出可被反駁的預測；把「時鐘域」視為相鄰問題，說明它如何影響模型而不能混同。數值只採本課假想算例或自訂並列明單位；本步保存架構圖、假設表與預測。
steps.instructionEn: After the mentor functional diagram, mark inputs, outputs and trust/resource boundaries around time evidence budget, then arrange components or data flows in the apprentice workspace. Principle: The error budget includes reference, timestamps, path and calibration uncertainty. Create two small authored datasets or spreadsheet cases: a baseline and a one-variable change. Model grandmaster transitions and loss-of-lock sequences. Predict a falsifiable outcome before evaluating it. Treat clock domains as a neighboring issue and explain its influence without conflating them. Use only the stated hypothetical case or declared assumed inputs/units. Save the architecture, assumptions and prediction.
steps.observation: 模擬 grandmaster 切換與失鎖的時間序列。 比較「時間證據預算」與「時鐘域」的證據是否支持相同推論。
steps.observationEn: Model grandmaster transitions and loss-of-lock sequences. Compare whether evidence for time evidence budget and clock domains supports the same inference.
steps.failure: 所有 PTP profile 都具有相同訊息間隔。 這是本課要排除的誤判；先核對模型邊界、來源版本及缺失證據。
steps.failureEn: Every PTP profile uses identical message intervals. This is a misconception to reject; check boundaries, source versions and missing evidence.
steps.check: 提交「時間證據預算」的功能草圖、基準／擾動表、單位或欄位定義、可反駁預測及接受／保留理由。需能重算本課假想例，並說明相鄰機制不可取代的驗證。
steps.checkEn: Submit a functional sketch, baseline/perturbation table, unit/field definitions, falsifiable prediction and accept/hold rationale for time evidence budget. Recompute the course case and explain verification that the neighboring mechanism cannot replace.

knowledge.title: 原理、架構與適用邊界
knowledge.text: 端到端誤差應涵蓋參考、時戳、路徑與校準不確定度。
knowledge.textEn: The error budget includes reference, timestamps, path and calibration uncertainty.

knowledge.title: 相鄰機制與不可混同處
knowledge.text: 相鄰的「時鐘域」：時鐘域是同步邊界，不是把所有裝置時間自動合併。 必須另列其證據，不能把這項機制的通過當作「時間證據預算」已通過。
knowledge.textEn: Neighboring clock domains: A clock domain defines a synchronization boundary, not automatic universal agreement. Record its evidence separately; its success does not prove time evidence budget passes.

knowledge.title: 受控對照與證據品質
knowledge.text: 模擬 grandmaster 切換與失鎖的時間序列。 只變一個條件，保留相同資料格式、時間範圍及分母；模型估計與實測證據要分別標記。
knowledge.textEn: Model grandmaster transitions and loss-of-lock sequences. Change one condition and retain comparable formats, intervals and denominators; label estimates separately from measured evidence.

knowledge.title: 可重算的原創假想例
knowledge.text: 假設 t2−t1=120 ns、t4−t3=80 ns，對稱模型估 offset=(120−80)/2=20 ns、delay=100 ns；若去程多 40 ns，不對稱造成 20 ns 偏差。
knowledge.textEn: With t2−t1=120 ns and t4−t3=80 ns, the symmetric model gives offset=20 ns and delay=100 ns; 40 ns forward-path asymmetry biases offset by 20 ns.

quiz.question: 針對「時間證據預算」的原理與可觀測性，哪項最直接成立？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement most directly explains the principle/observability of time evidence budget?
options: 端到端誤差應涵蓋參考、時戳、路徑與校準不確定度。
所有 PTP profile 都具有相同訊息間隔。
只檢查「時鐘域」，便可取代「時間證據預算」的專屬驗證。
optionsEn: The error budget includes reference, timestamps, path and calibration uncertainty.
Every PTP profile uses identical message intervals.
Checking clock domains alone replaces verification specific to time evidence budget.
quiz.explanation: 端到端誤差應涵蓋參考、時戳、路徑與校準不確定度。 相鄰的「時鐘域」有不同責任：時鐘域是同步邊界，不是把所有裝置時間自動合併。因此不能用該項通過或課內誤判取代本單元證據。
quiz.explanationEn: The error budget includes reference, timestamps, path and calibration uncertainty. Neighboring clock domains has a different role: A clock domain defines a synchronization boundary, not automatic universal agreement. Its success or the stated misconception cannot replace unit-specific evidence.

steps.observationEn: Model grandmaster transitions and loss-of-lock sequences. Compare whether evidence for time evidence budget and clock domains supports the same inference.
steps.failure: 所有 PTP profile 都具有相同訊息間隔。 這是本課要排除的誤判；先核對模型邊界、來源版本及缺失證據。
steps.failureEn: Every PTP profile uses identical message intervals. This is a misconception to reject; check boundaries, source versions and missing evidence.

scope: 公開原理的離線／本地合成資料工程教育。只使用自行生成資料或明確獲授權的測試環境；不提供真實目標掃描、漏洞利用、惡意程式、車輛／工控注入或實際射頻發射程序。數值為原創假設，非供應商保證或現場驗收標準。
scopeEn: Offline/local synthetic-data engineering education from public principles. Use authored data or explicitly authorized test environments only. No real-target scanning, exploitation, malware, vehicle/OT injection or live RF procedures. Numerical cases are original assumptions, not supplier guarantees or field acceptance criteria.

workedExample.title: 原創假想量化例與限制
workedExample.titleEn: Original hypothetical quantitative case and limits
workedExample.text: 假設 t2−t1=120 ns、t4−t3=80 ns，對稱模型估 offset=(120−80)/2=20 ns、delay=100 ns；若去程多 40 ns，不對稱造成 20 ns 偏差。
workedExample.textEn: With t2−t1=120 ns and t4−t3=80 ns, the symmetric model gives offset=20 ns and delay=100 ns; 40 ns forward-path asymmetry biases offset by 20 ns.
workedExample.assumptions: 只採算例中明列的教學條件；效能與安全估計須依拓撲、分布、開銷、版本與不確定度重算。
workedExample.assumptionsEn: Use only the stated teaching assumptions; recalculate for topology, distribution, overhead, versions and uncertainty.
workedExample.sourceScope: 作者自行設定的教學數值；官方來源支援原理與尺寸規格，未聲稱量測此假想平台。
workedExample.sourceScopeEn: Independently chosen teaching inputs; official sources support principles and specified material sizes, not measurements of this hypothetical platform.

title: 時間敏感網路
summary: 以排程閘門、時間同步與可界定延遲串連 16 個領域技術單元、32 個保存步驟；分析架構、原理、介面、故障、量化案例與防禦證據。
summaryEn: Sixteen domain-specific technical units and 32 saved steps connect scheduled gates, synchronization and bounded latency through architecture, principles, interfaces, faults, quantitative cases and defensive evidence.

stages.title: 需求、元件與基本模型
stages.description: 四個領域技術單元各完成原理建模與對照證據，共八項可個別保存的作業。
stages.descriptionEn: Four domain units each pair principle modeling with controlled evidence, producing eight separately saved tasks.

steps.title: 流量需求合約：架構與原理
steps.objective: 針對「流量需求合約」建立有邊界、可反駁的系統模型。
steps.objectiveEn: For traffic contracts, construct a bounded falsifiable system model.
steps.instruction: 觀看師傅的功能示意後，以「流量需求合約」為中心標出輸入、輸出、信任或資源邊界，並在學徒工作台排列資料流或元件。原理是：到達率、突發量與截止時間一起限定可接受負載。 使用自行編寫的兩組小型資料或試算表，建立基準與一次只改一項的對照：只改閘門開啟時間，觀察臨界流量等待。 先寫出可被反駁的預測；把「時間基準」視為相鄰問題，說明它如何影響模型而不能混同。數值只採本課假想算例或自訂並列明單位；本步保存架構圖、假設表與預測。
steps.instructionEn: After the mentor functional diagram, mark inputs, outputs and trust/resource boundaries around traffic contracts, then arrange components or data flows in the apprentice workspace. Principle: Rate, bursts and deadlines jointly define admissible traffic. Create two small authored datasets or spreadsheet cases: a baseline and a one-variable change. Change gate-open time only and observe critical-flow waiting. Predict a falsifiable outcome before evaluating it. Treat time reference as a neighboring issue and explain its influence without conflating them. Use only the stated hypothetical case or declared assumed inputs/units. Save the architecture, assumptions and prediction.
steps.observation: 只改閘門開啟時間，觀察臨界流量等待。 比較「流量需求合約」與「時間基準」的證據是否支持相同推論。
steps.observationEn: Change gate-open time only and observe critical-flow waiting. Compare whether evidence for traffic contracts and time reference supports the same inference.
steps.failure: 優先權高便保證任何負載下零延遲。 這是本課要排除的誤判；先核對模型邊界、來源版本及缺失證據。
steps.failureEn: High priority guarantees zero delay at every load. This is a misconception to reject; check boundaries, source versions and missing evidence.
steps.check: 提交「流量需求合約」的功能草圖、基準／擾動表、單位或欄位定義、可反駁預測及接受／保留理由。需能重算本課假想例，並說明相鄰機制不可取代的驗證。
steps.checkEn: Submit a functional sketch, baseline/perturbation table, unit/field definitions, falsifiable prediction and accept/hold rationale for traffic contracts. Recompute the course case and explain verification that the neighboring mechanism cannot replace.

knowledge.title: 原理、架構與適用邊界
knowledge.text: 到達率、突發量與截止時間一起限定可接受負載。
knowledge.textEn: Rate, bursts and deadlines jointly define admissible traffic.

knowledge.title: 相鄰機制與不可混同處
knowledge.text: 相鄰的「時間基準」：跨橋排程需要共享時基及有限同步誤差。 必須另列其證據，不能把這項機制的通過當作「流量需求合約」已通過。
knowledge.textEn: Neighboring time reference: Cross-bridge schedules need a shared timebase and bounded synchronization error. Record its evidence separately; its success does not prove traffic contracts passes.

knowledge.title: 受控對照與證據品質
knowledge.text: 只改閘門開啟時間，觀察臨界流量等待。 只變一個條件，保留相同資料格式、時間範圍及分母；模型估計與實測證據要分別標記。
knowledge.textEn: Change gate-open time only and observe critical-flow waiting. Change one condition and retain comparable formats, intervals and denominators; label estimates separately from measured evidence.

knowledge.title: 可重算的原創假想例
knowledge.text: 假設 1 Gbit/s 上傳送 1500 byte 訊框，純內容序列化為 12 μs；1 ms 週期留 100 μs，忽略 overhead 可容納 8 框，實際須再扣 guard band 與開銷。
knowledge.textEn: At 1 Gbit/s, 1500-byte payload serialization is 12 μs; a 100 μs window in a 1 ms cycle fits at most eight such payloads before overhead and guard bands.

knowledge.textEn: Change gate-open time only and observe critical-flow waiting. Change one condition and retain comparable formats, intervals and denominators; label estimates separately from measured evidence.

quiz.question: 針對「佇列映射」的原理與可觀測性，哪項最直接成立？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement most directly explains the principle/observability of queue mapping?
options: 分類將流映射至佇列；分類錯誤會破壞排程假設。
TSN 不需要知道鏈路速率或封包大小。
只檢查「時間感知閘門」，便可取代「佇列映射」的專屬驗證。
optionsEn: Classification maps streams to queues; mistakes break scheduling assumptions.
TSN needs neither link rate nor frame size.
Checking time-aware gates alone replaces verification specific to queue mapping.
quiz.explanation: 分類將流映射至佇列；分類錯誤會破壞排程假設。 相鄰的「時間感知閘門」有不同責任：閘門限制何時可發送，不會讓資料瞬間穿過鏈路。因此不能用該項通過或課內誤判取代本單元證據。
quiz.explanationEn: Classification maps streams to queues; mistakes break scheduling assumptions. Neighboring time-aware gates has a different role: Gates constrain send times; they do not make transmission instantaneous. Its success or the stated misconception cannot replace unit-specific evidence.

steps.title: 佇列映射：對照試驗與證據
steps.titleEn: Queue mapping: controlled experiment and evidence
steps.objective: 針對「佇列映射」完成含競爭原因及不確定度的驗收紀錄。
steps.objectiveEn: For queue mapping, complete acceptance evidence with competing causes and uncertainty.
steps.instruction: 重播本單元示意，讀取自製的基準與擾動紀錄，不接觸未授權目標。對照「分類將流映射至佇列；分類錯誤會破壞排程假設。」，執行下列紙上或本地合成資料試驗：只改閘門開啟時間，觀察臨界流量等待。 分開記錄預測、觀察與不確定度，再提出至少兩個可能原因；利用「時間感知閘門」的獨立證據排除一個原因。若結果只來自模型，標記為模擬，不能當作真實設備量測。最後說明目前應接受、保留或拒絕哪一項要求，並保存可重算資料。
steps.instructionEn: Replay the unit diagram and inspect your authored baseline/perturbed records without accessing unauthorized targets. Evaluate the principle: Classification maps streams to queues; mistakes break scheduling assumptions. Conduct this paper or local synthetic-data experiment: Change gate-open time only and observe critical-flow waiting. Record prediction, observation and uncertainty separately, propose two competing causes and use independent evidence from time-aware gates to exclude one. Model outputs must remain labeled simulation, not physical measurements. Explain which requirement to accept, hold or reject and retain recomputable records.
steps.observation: 只改閘門開啟時間，觀察臨界流量等待。 比較「佇列映射」與「時間感知閘門」的證據是否支持相同推論。
steps.observationEn: Change gate-open time only and observe critical-flow waiting. Compare whether evidence for queue mapping and time-aware gates supports the same inference.
steps.failure: TSN 不需要知道鏈路速率或封包大小。 這是本課要排除的誤判；先核對模型邊界、來源版本及缺失證據。
steps.failureEn: TSN needs neither link rate nor frame size. This is a misconception to reject; check boundaries, source versions and missing evidence.
steps.check: 提交「佇列映射」的功能草圖、基準／擾動表、單位或欄位定義、可反駁預測及接受／保留理由。需能重算本課假想例，並說明相鄰機制不可取代的驗證。
steps.checkEn: Submit a functional sketch, baseline/perturbation table, unit/field definitions, falsifiable prediction and accept/hold rationale for queue mapping. Recompute the course case and explain verification that the neighboring mechanism cannot replace.

stages.description: 四個領域技術單元各完成原理建模與對照證據，共八項可個別保存的作業。
stages.descriptionEn: Four domain units each pair principle modeling with controlled evidence, producing eight separately saved tasks.

steps.title: 時間感知閘門：架構與原理
steps.objective: 針對「時間感知閘門」建立有邊界、可反駁的系統模型。
steps.objectiveEn: For time-aware gates, construct a bounded falsifiable system model.
steps.instruction: 觀看師傅的功能示意後，以「時間感知閘門」為中心標出輸入、輸出、信任或資源邊界，並在學徒工作台排列資料流或元件。原理是：閘門限制何時可發送，不會讓資料瞬間穿過鏈路。 使用自行編寫的兩組小型資料或試算表，建立基準與一次只改一項的對照：固定流量，只改同步誤差對 guard band 的需求。 先寫出可被反駁的預測；把「Guard band」視為相鄰問題，說明它如何影響模型而不能混同。數值只採本課假想算例或自訂並列明單位；本步保存架構圖、假設表與預測。
steps.instructionEn: After the mentor functional diagram, mark inputs, outputs and trust/resource boundaries around time-aware gates, then arrange components or data flows in the apprentice workspace. Principle: Gates constrain send times; they do not make transmission instantaneous. Create two small authored datasets or spreadsheet cases: a baseline and a one-variable change. Fix traffic and vary synchronization error in the guard-band budget. Predict a falsifiable outcome before evaluating it. Treat guard bands as a neighboring issue and explain its influence without conflating them. Use only the stated hypothetical case or declared assumed inputs/units. Save the architecture, assumptions and prediction.
steps.observation: 固定流量，只改同步誤差對 guard band 的需求。 比較「時間感知閘門」與「Guard band」的證據是否支持相同推論。
steps.observationEn: Fix traffic and vary synchronization error in the guard-band budget. Compare whether evidence for time-aware gates and guard bands supports the same inference.
steps.failure: 優先權高便保證任何負載下零延遲。 這是本課要排除的誤判；先核對模型邊界、來源版本及缺失證據。
steps.failureEn: High priority guarantees zero delay at every load. This is a misconception to reject; check boundaries, source versions and missing evidence.
steps.check: 提交「時間感知閘門」的功能草圖、基準／擾動表、單位或欄位定義、可反駁預測及接受／保留理由。需能重算本課假想例，並說明相鄰機制不可取代的驗證。
steps.checkEn: Submit a functional sketch, baseline/perturbation table, unit/field definitions, falsifiable prediction and accept/hold rationale for time-aware gates. Recompute the course case and explain verification that the neighboring mechanism cannot replace.

steps.instruction: 觀看師傅的功能示意後，以「互通驗證」為中心標出輸入、輸出、信任或資源邊界，並在學徒工作台排列資料流或元件。原理是：採用哪些 TSN 功能應列明，不能只以支援 TSN 代替。 使用自行編寫的兩組小型資料或試算表，建立基準與一次只改一項的對照：模擬單一路徑中斷，檢查重複消除及交付延遲。 先寫出可被反駁的預測；把「流量需求合約」視為相鄰問題，說明它如何影響模型而不能混同。數值只採本課假想算例或自訂並列明單位；本步保存架構圖、假設表與預測。
steps.instructionEn: After the mentor functional diagram, mark inputs, outputs and trust/resource boundaries around interoperability evidence, then arrange components or data flows in the apprentice workspace. Principle: Enumerate adopted TSN features rather than relying on a generic support claim. Create two small authored datasets or spreadsheet cases: a baseline and a one-variable change. Model one path outage; check duplicate elimination and delivery latency. Predict a falsifiable outcome before evaluating it. Treat traffic contracts as a neighboring issue and explain its influence without conflating them. Use only the stated hypothetical case or declared assumed inputs/units. Save the architecture, assumptions and prediction.
steps.observation: 模擬單一路徑中斷，檢查重複消除及交付延遲。 比較「互通驗證」與「流量需求合約」的證據是否支持相同推論。
steps.observationEn: Model one path outage; check duplicate elimination and delivery latency. Compare whether evidence for interoperability evidence and traffic contracts supports the same inference.
steps.failure: TSN 不需要知道鏈路速率或封包大小。 這是本課要排除的誤判；先核對模型邊界、來源版本及缺失證據。
steps.failureEn: TSN needs neither link rate nor frame size. This is a misconception to reject; check boundaries, source versions and missing evidence.
steps.check: 提交「互通驗證」的功能草圖、基準／擾動表、單位或欄位定義、可反駁預測及接受／保留理由。需能重算本課假想例，並說明相鄰機制不可取代的驗證。
steps.checkEn: Submit a functional sketch, baseline/perturbation table, unit/field definitions, falsifiable prediction and accept/hold rationale for interoperability evidence. Recompute the course case and explain verification that the neighboring mechanism cannot replace.

knowledge.title: 原理、架構與適用邊界
knowledge.text: 採用哪些 TSN 功能應列明，不能只以支援 TSN 代替。
knowledge.textEn: Enumerate adopted TSN features rather than relying on a generic support claim.

knowledge.title: 相鄰機制與不可混同處
knowledge.text: 相鄰的「流量需求合約」：到達率、突發量與截止時間一起限定可接受負載。 必須另列其證據，不能把這項機制的通過當作「互通驗證」已通過。
knowledge.textEn: Neighboring traffic contracts: Rate, bursts and deadlines jointly define admissible traffic. Record its evidence separately; its success does not prove interoperability evidence passes.

knowledge.title: 受控對照與證據品質
knowledge.text: 模擬單一路徑中斷，檢查重複消除及交付延遲。 只變一個條件，保留相同資料格式、時間範圍及分母；模型估計與實測證據要分別標記。
knowledge.textEn: Model one path outage; check duplicate elimination and delivery latency. Change one condition and retain comparable formats, intervals and denominators; label estimates separately from measured evidence.

knowledge.title: 可重算的原創假想例
knowledge.text: 假設 1 Gbit/s 上傳送 1500 byte 訊框，純內容序列化為 12 μs；1 ms 週期留 100 μs，忽略 overhead 可容納 8 框，實際須再扣 guard band 與開銷。
knowledge.textEn: At 1 Gbit/s, 1500-byte payload serialization is 12 μs; a 100 μs window in a 1 ms cycle fits at most eight such payloads before overhead and guard bands.

quiz.question: 針對「互通驗證」的原理與可觀測性，哪項最直接成立？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement most directly explains the principle/observability of interoperability evidence?
options: 採用哪些 TSN 功能應列明，不能只以支援 TSN 代替。
TSN 不需要知道鏈路速率或封包大小。
只檢查「流量需求合約」，便可取代「互通驗證」的專屬驗證。
optionsEn: Enumerate adopted TSN features rather than relying on a generic support claim.
TSN needs neither link rate nor frame size.
Checking traffic contracts alone replaces verification specific to interoperability evidence.
quiz.explanation: 採用哪些 TSN 功能應列明，不能只以支援 TSN 代替。 相鄰的「流量需求合約」有不同責任：到達率、突發量與截止時間一起限定可接受負載。因此不能用該項通過或課內誤判取代本單元證據。
quiz.explanationEn: Enumerate adopted TSN features rather than relying on a generic support claim. Neighboring traffic contracts has a different role: Rate, bursts and deadlines jointly define admissible traffic. Its success or the stated misconception cannot replace unit-specific evidence.

steps.objective: 針對「互通驗證」完成含競爭原因及不確定度的驗收紀錄。

steps.instruction: 重播本單元示意，讀取自製的基準與擾動紀錄，不接觸未授權目標。對照「採用哪些 TSN 功能應列明，不能只以支援 TSN 代替。」，執行下列紙上或本地合成資料試驗：模擬單一路徑中斷，檢查重複消除及交付延遲。 分開記錄預測、觀察與不確定度，再提出至少兩個可能原因；利用「流量需求合約」的獨立證據排除一個原因。若結果只來自模型，標記為模擬，不能當作真實設備量測。最後說明目前應接受、保留或拒絕哪一項要求，並保存可重算資料。

Record prediction, observation and uncertainty separately, propose two competing causes and use independent evidence from traffic contracts to exclude one. Model outputs must remain labeled simulation, not physical measurements. Explain which requirement to accept, hold or reject and retain recomputable records.

steps.observationEn: Model one path outage; check duplicate elimination and delivery latency. Compare whether evidence for interoperability evidence and traffic contracts supports the same inference.
steps.failure: TSN 不需要知道鏈路速率或封包大小。 這是本課要排除的誤判；先核對模型邊界、來源版本及缺失證據。
steps.failureEn: TSN needs neither link rate nor frame size. This is a misconception to reject; check boundaries, source versions and missing evidence.
steps.check: 提交「互通驗證」的功能草圖、基準／擾動表、單位或欄位定義、可反駁預測及接受／保留理由。需能重算本課假想例，並說明相鄰機制不可取代的驗證。
steps.checkEn: Submit a functional sketch, baseline/perturbation table, unit/field definitions, falsifiable prediction and accept/hold rationale for interoperability evidence. Recompute the course case and explain verification that the neighboring mechanism cannot replace.

scope: 公開原理的離線／本地合成資料工程教育。只使用自行生成資料或明確獲授權的測試環境；不提供真實目標掃描、漏洞利用、惡意程式、車輛／工控注入或實際射頻發射程序。數值為原創假設，非供應商保證或現場驗收標準。
scopeEn: Offline/local synthetic-data engineering education from public principles. Use authored data or explicitly authorized test environments only. No real-target scanning, exploitation, malware, vehicle/OT injection or live RF procedures. Numerical cases are original assumptions, not supplier guarantees or field acceptance criteria.

workedExample.title: 原創假想量化例與限制
workedExample.titleEn: Original hypothetical quantitative case and limits
workedExample.text: 假設 1 Gbit/s 上傳送 1500 byte 訊框，純內容序列化為 12 μs；1 ms 週期留 100 μs，忽略 overhead 可容納 8 框，實際須再扣 guard band 與開銷。
workedExample.textEn: At 1 Gbit/s, 1500-byte payload serialization is 12 μs; a 100 μs window in a 1 ms cycle fits at most eight such payloads before overhead and guard bands.
workedExample.assumptions: 只採算例中明列的教學條件；效能與安全估計須依拓撲、分布、開銷、版本與不確定度重算。
workedExample.assumptionsEn: Use only the stated teaching assumptions; recalculate for topology, distribution, overhead, versions and uncertainty.
workedExample.sourceScope: 作者自行設定的教學數值；官方來源支援原理與尺寸規格，未聲稱量測此假想平台。
workedExample.sourceScopeEn: Independently chosen teaching inputs; official sources support principles and specified material sizes, not measurements of this hypothetical platform.

title: 無線區域網路企業部署
summary: 以射頻容量、漫遊與企業身分驗證串連 16 個領域技術單元、32 個保存步驟；分析架構、原理、介面、故障、量化案例與防禦證據。
summaryEn: Sixteen domain-specific technical units and 32 saved steps connect rf capacity, roaming and enterprise authentication through architecture, principles, interfaces, faults, quantitative cases and defensive evidence.

stages.title: 需求、元件與基本模型
stages.description: 四個領域技術單元各完成原理建模與對照證據，共八項可個別保存的作業。
stages.descriptionEn: Four domain units each pair principle modeling with controlled evidence, producing eight separately saved tasks.

steps.title: 需求與並行數：架構與原理
steps.titleEn: Demand and concurrency: architecture and principle
steps.objective: 針對「需求與並行數」建立有邊界、可反駁的系統模型。
steps.objectiveEn: For demand and concurrency, construct a bounded falsifiable system model.
steps.instruction: 觀看師傅的功能示意後，以「需求與並行數」為中心標出輸入、輸出、信任或資源邊界，並在學徒工作台排列資料流或元件。原理是：使用者數量與同時傳輸的用戶數不同。 使用自行編寫的兩組小型資料或試算表，建立基準與一次只改一項的對照：保留客戶數，只改同頻 AP 數，分析共享 airtime。 先寫出可被反駁的預測；把「鏈路預算」視為相鄰問題，說明它如何影響模型而不能混同。數值只採本課假想算例或自訂並列明單位；本步保存架構圖、假設表與預測。
steps.instructionEn: After the mentor functional diagram, mark inputs, outputs and trust/resource boundaries around demand and concurrency, then arrange components or data flows in the apprentice workspace. Principle: Total users and simultaneously transmitting clients are different counts. Create two small authored datasets or spreadsheet cases: a baseline and a one-variable change. Keep client count and vary co-channel APs to analyze shared airtime. Predict a falsifiable outcome before evaluating it. Treat link budget as a neighboring issue and explain its influence without conflating them. Use only the stated hypothetical case or declared assumed inputs/units. Save the architecture, assumptions and prediction.
steps.observation: 保留客戶數，只改同頻 AP 數，分析共享 airtime。 比較「需求與並行數」與「鏈路預算」的證據是否支持相同推論。
steps.observationEn: Keep client count and vary co-channel APs to analyze shared airtime. Compare whether evidence for demand and concurrency and link budget supports the same inference.
steps.failure: 增加 AP 數一定線性增加同頻容量。 這是本課要排除的誤判；先核對模型邊界、來源版本及缺失證據。
steps.failureEn: Adding APs always increases co-channel capacity linearly. This is a misconception to reject; check boundaries, source versions and missing evidence.
steps.check: 提交「需求與並行數」的功能草圖、基準／擾動表、單位或欄位定義、可反駁預測及接受／保留理由。需能重算本課假想例，並說明相鄰機制不可取代的驗證。
steps.checkEn: Submit a functional sketch, baseline/perturbation table, unit/field definitions, falsifiable prediction and accept/hold rationale for demand and concurrency. Recompute the course case and explain verification that the neighboring mechanism cannot replace.

knowledge.title: 原理、架構與適用邊界
knowledge.text: 使用者數量與同時傳輸的用戶數不同。
knowledge.textEn: Total users and simultaneously transmitting clients are different counts.

knowledge.title: 相鄰機制與不可混同處
knowledge.text: 相鄰的「鏈路預算」：接收功率由發射、天線增益及路徑損耗共同決定。 必須另列其證據，不能把這項機制的通過當作「需求與並行數」已通過。

knowledge.title: 可重算的原創假想例
knowledge.text: 假想同頻域 20 台客戶端各需 2 Mbit/s，共 40 Mbit/s；有效吞吐 80 Mbit/s 的負載約 50%。此為平均容量假設，未保證碰撞、漫遊或 p99。
knowledge.textEn: Twenty clients each needing 2 Mbit/s demand 40 Mbit/s; with assumed usable throughput of 80 Mbit/s, load is 50%, without guarantees for collisions, roaming or p99.

steps.title: 頻道重用：架構與原理
steps.objective: 針對「頻道重用」建立有邊界、可反駁的系統模型。

steps.instruction: 觀看師傅的功能示意後，以「頻道重用」為中心標出輸入、輸出、信任或資源邊界，並在學徒工作台排列資料流或元件。原理是：同頻 AP 彼此爭用，重用需考慮空間隔離。 使用自行編寫的兩組小型資料或試算表，建立基準與一次只改一項的對照：固定發射功率，只改訊號衰減與 SNR。 先寫出可被反駁的預測；把「頻寬取捨」視為相鄰問題，說明它如何影響模型而不能混同。數值只採本課假想算例或自訂並列明單位；本步保存架構圖、假設表與預測。

Fix transmit power and change attenuation/SNR. Predict a falsifiable outcome before evaluating it. Save the architecture, assumptions and prediction.
