steps.instructionEn: After the mentor functional diagram, mark inputs, outputs and trust/resource boundaries around change rollback, then arrange components or data flows in the apprentice workspace. Principle: Channel and authentication changes need recoverable prior configurations. Create two small authored datasets or spreadsheet cases: a baseline and a one-variable change. Model reauthentication latency and packet interruption during roaming. Predict a falsifiable outcome before evaluating it. Treat demand and concurrency as a neighboring issue and explain its influence without conflating them. Use only the stated hypothetical case or declared assumed inputs/units. Save the architecture, assumptions and prediction.
steps.observation: 模擬漫遊時重驗證延遲與封包中斷。 比較「變更回滾」與「需求與並行數」的證據是否支持相同推論。
steps.observationEn: Model reauthentication latency and packet interruption during roaming. Compare whether evidence for change rollback and demand and concurrency supports the same inference.
steps.failure: RSSI 高即證明 SNR、吞吐及驗證都合格。 這是本課要排除的誤判；先核對模型邊界、來源版本及缺失證據。
steps.failureEn: High RSSI proves SNR, throughput and authentication are all acceptable. This is a misconception to reject; check boundaries, source versions and missing evidence.
steps.check: 提交「變更回滾」的功能草圖、基準／擾動表、單位或欄位定義、可反駁預測及接受／保留理由。需能重算本課假想例，並說明相鄰機制不可取代的驗證。
steps.checkEn: Submit a functional sketch, baseline/perturbation table, unit/field definitions, falsifiable prediction and accept/hold rationale for change rollback. Recompute the course case and explain verification that the neighboring mechanism cannot replace.

knowledge.title: 原理、架構與適用邊界
knowledge.text: 頻道與認證變更需預先保留可恢復的配置。
knowledge.textEn: Channel and authentication changes need recoverable prior configurations.

knowledge.title: 相鄰機制與不可混同處
knowledge.text: 相鄰的「需求與並行數」：使用者數量與同時傳輸的用戶數不同。 必須另列其證據，不能把這項機制的通過當作「變更回滾」已通過。
knowledge.textEn: Neighboring demand and concurrency: Total users and simultaneously transmitting clients are different counts. Record its evidence separately; its success does not prove change rollback passes.

knowledge.title: 受控對照與證據品質
knowledge.text: 模擬漫遊時重驗證延遲與封包中斷。 只變一個條件，保留相同資料格式、時間範圍及分母；模型估計與實測證據要分別標記。
knowledge.textEn: Model reauthentication latency and packet interruption during roaming. Change one condition and retain comparable formats, intervals and denominators; label estimates separately from measured evidence.

knowledge.title: 可重算的原創假想例
knowledge.text: 假想同頻域 20 台客戶端各需 2 Mbit/s，共 40 Mbit/s；有效吞吐 80 Mbit/s 的負載約 50%。此為平均容量假設，未保證碰撞、漫遊或 p99。
knowledge.textEn: Twenty clients each needing 2 Mbit/s demand 40 Mbit/s; with assumed usable throughput of 80 Mbit/s, load is 50%, without guarantees for collisions, roaming or p99.

quiz.question: 針對「變更回滾」的原理與可觀測性，哪項最直接成立？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement most directly explains the principle/observability of change rollback?
options: 頻道與認證變更需預先保留可恢復的配置。
RSSI 高即證明 SNR、吞吐及驗證都合格。
只檢查「需求與並行數」，便可取代「變更回滾」的專屬驗證。
optionsEn: Channel and authentication changes need recoverable prior configurations.
High RSSI proves SNR, throughput and authentication are all acceptable.
Checking demand and concurrency alone replaces verification specific to change rollback.
quiz.explanation: 頻道與認證變更需預先保留可恢復的配置。 相鄰的「需求與並行數」有不同責任：使用者數量與同時傳輸的用戶數不同。因此不能用該項通過或課內誤判取代本單元證據。
quiz.explanationEn: Channel and authentication changes need recoverable prior configurations. Neighboring demand and concurrency has a different role: Total users and simultaneously transmitting clients are different counts. Its success or the stated misconception cannot replace unit-specific evidence.

steps.title: 變更回滾：對照試驗與證據
steps.titleEn: Change rollback: controlled experiment and evidence
steps.objective: 針對「變更回滾」完成含競爭原因及不確定度的驗收紀錄。
steps.objectiveEn: For change rollback, complete acceptance evidence with competing causes and uncertainty.
steps.instruction: 重播本單元示意，讀取自製的基準與擾動紀錄，不接觸未授權目標。對照「頻道與認證變更需預先保留可恢復的配置。」，執行下列紙上或本地合成資料試驗：模擬漫遊時重驗證延遲與封包中斷。 分開記錄預測、觀察與不確定度，再提出至少兩個可能原因；利用「需求與並行數」的獨立證據排除一個原因。若結果只來自模型，標記為模擬，不能當作真實設備量測。最後說明目前應接受、保留或拒絕哪一項要求，並保存可重算資料。
steps.instructionEn: Replay the unit diagram and inspect your authored baseline/perturbed records without accessing unauthorized targets. Evaluate the principle: Channel and authentication changes need recoverable prior configurations. Conduct this paper or local synthetic-data experiment: Model reauthentication latency and packet interruption during roaming. Record prediction, observation and uncertainty separately, propose two competing causes and use independent evidence from demand and concurrency to exclude one. Model outputs must remain labeled simulation, not physical measurements. Explain which requirement to accept, hold or reject and retain recomputable records.
steps.observation: 模擬漫遊時重驗證延遲與封包中斷。 比較「變更回滾」與「需求與並行數」的證據是否支持相同推論。
steps.observationEn: Model reauthentication latency and packet interruption during roaming. Compare whether evidence for change rollback and demand and concurrency supports the same inference.
steps.failure: RSSI 高即證明 SNR、吞吐及驗證都合格。 這是本課要排除的誤判；先核對模型邊界、來源版本及缺失證據。
steps.failureEn: High RSSI proves SNR, throughput and authentication are all acceptable. This is a misconception to reject; check boundaries, source versions and missing evidence.
steps.check: 提交「變更回滾」的功能草圖、基準／擾動表、單位或欄位定義、可反駁預測及接受／保留理由。需能重算本課假想例，並說明相鄰機制不可取代的驗證。
steps.checkEn: Submit a functional sketch, baseline/perturbation table, unit/field definitions, falsifiable prediction and accept/hold rationale for change rollback. Recompute the course case and explain verification that the neighboring mechanism cannot replace.

scope: 公開原理的離線／本地合成資料工程教育。只使用自行生成資料或明確獲授權的測試環境；不提供真實目標掃描、漏洞利用、惡意程式、車輛／工控注入或實際射頻發射程序。數值為原創假設，非供應商保證或現場驗收標準。
scopeEn: Offline/local synthetic-data engineering education from public principles. Use authored data or explicitly authorized test environments only. No real-target scanning, exploitation, malware, vehicle/OT injection or live RF procedures. Numerical cases are original assumptions, not supplier guarantees or field acceptance criteria.

workedExample.title: 原創假想量化例與限制
workedExample.titleEn: Original hypothetical quantitative case and limits
workedExample.text: 假想同頻域 20 台客戶端各需 2 Mbit/s，共 40 Mbit/s；有效吞吐 80 Mbit/s 的負載約 50%。此為平均容量假設，未保證碰撞、漫遊或 p99。
workedExample.textEn: Twenty clients each needing 2 Mbit/s demand 40 Mbit/s; with assumed usable throughput of 80 Mbit/s, load is 50%, without guarantees for collisions, roaming or p99.
workedExample.assumptions: 只採算例中明列的教學條件；效能與安全估計須依拓撲、分布、開銷、版本與不確定度重算。
workedExample.assumptionsEn: Use only the stated teaching assumptions; recalculate for topology, distribution, overhead, versions and uncertainty.
workedExample.sourceScope: 作者自行設定的教學數值；官方來源支援原理與尺寸規格，未聲稱量測此假想平台。
workedExample.sourceScopeEn: Independently chosen teaching inputs; official sources support principles and specified material sizes, not measurements of this hypothetical platform.

title: 行動核心網路
summary: 以5G 核心服務、控制／用戶平面與狀態串連 16 個領域技術單元、32 個保存步驟；分析架構、原理、介面、故障、量化案例與防禦證據。
summaryEn: Sixteen domain-specific technical units and 32 saved steps connect 5g core services, control/user planes and state through architecture, principles, interfaces, faults, quantitative cases and defensive evidence.

stages.title: 需求、元件與基本模型
stages.description: 四個領域技術單元各完成原理建模與對照證據，共八項可個別保存的作業。
stages.descriptionEn: Four domain units each pair principle modeling with controlled evidence, producing eight separately saved tasks.

steps.title: 控制與用戶平面：架構與原理
steps.titleEn: Control and user planes: architecture and principle
steps.objective: 針對「控制與用戶平面」建立有邊界、可反駁的系統模型。
steps.objectiveEn: For control and user planes, construct a bounded falsifiable system model.
steps.instruction: 觀看師傅的功能示意後，以「控制與用戶平面」為中心標出輸入、輸出、信任或資源邊界，並在學徒工作台排列資料流或元件。原理是：控制訊息建立狀態，用戶平面承載應用資料。 使用自行編寫的兩組小型資料或試算表，建立基準與一次只改一項的對照：固定用戶數，只改 session 建立率。 先寫出可被反駁的預測；把「AMF 責任」視為相鄰問題，說明它如何影響模型而不能混同。數值只採本課假想算例或自訂並列明單位；本步保存架構圖、假設表與預測。
steps.instructionEn: After the mentor functional diagram, mark inputs, outputs and trust/resource boundaries around control and user planes, then arrange components or data flows in the apprentice workspace. Principle: Control messages establish state; the user plane carries application data. Create two small authored datasets or spreadsheet cases: a baseline and a one-variable change. Keep users fixed and vary session-setup arrival rate. Predict a falsifiable outcome before evaluating it. Treat amf responsibilities as a neighboring issue and explain its influence without conflating them. Use only the stated hypothetical case or declared assumed inputs/units. Save the architecture, assumptions and prediction.
steps.observation: 固定用戶數，只改 session 建立率。 比較「控制與用戶平面」與「AMF 責任」的證據是否支持相同推論。
steps.observationEn: Keep users fixed and vary session-setup arrival rate. Compare whether evidence for control and user planes and amf responsibilities supports the same inference.
steps.failure: UPF 承載資料流，因此可取代所有 AMF 控制功能。 這是本課要排除的誤判；先核對模型邊界、來源版本及缺失證據。
steps.failureEn: UPF data forwarding can replace all AMF control functions. This is a misconception to reject; check boundaries, source versions and missing evidence.
steps.check: 提交「控制與用戶平面」的功能草圖、基準／擾動表、單位或欄位定義、可反駁預測及接受／保留理由。需能重算本課假想例，並說明相鄰機制不可取代的驗證。
steps.checkEn: Submit a functional sketch, baseline/perturbation table, unit/field definitions, falsifiable prediction and accept/hold rationale for control and user planes. Recompute the course case and explain verification that the neighboring mechanism cannot replace.

knowledge.title: 原理、架構與適用邊界
knowledge.text: 控制訊息建立狀態，用戶平面承載應用資料。
knowledge.textEn: Control messages establish state; the user plane carries application data.

knowledge.title: 相鄰機制與不可混同處
knowledge.text: 相鄰的「AMF 責任」：存取與移動管理和 session 管理分開。 必須另列其證據，不能把這項機制的通過當作「控制與用戶平面」已通過。
knowledge.textEn: Neighboring amf responsibilities: Access/mobility management is separate from session management. Record its evidence separately; its success does not prove control and user planes passes.

knowledge.title: 受控對照與證據品質
knowledge.text: 固定用戶數，只改 session 建立率。 只變一個條件，保留相同資料格式、時間範圍及分母；模型估計與實測證據要分別標記。
knowledge.textEn: Keep users fixed and vary session-setup arrival rate. Change one condition and retain comparable formats, intervals and denominators; label estimates separately from measured evidence.

knowledge.title: 可重算的原創假想例
knowledge.text: 假設 10,000 用戶各平均 100 kbit/s，UPF 總量為 1 Gbit/s；加 20% 餘裕取 1.2 Gbit/s，未計封裝或尖峰，不能以此推算控制平面容量。
knowledge.textEn: 10,000 users averaging 100 kbit/s require 1 Gbit/s through the UPF; 20% headroom gives 1.2 Gbit/s, excluding encapsulation, peaks and control-plane capacity.

options: 控制訊息建立狀態，用戶平面承載應用資料。
UPF 承載資料流，因此可取代所有 AMF 控制功能。
只檢查「AMF 責任」，便可取代「控制與用戶平面」的專屬驗證。
optionsEn: Control messages establish state; the user plane carries application data.
UPF data forwarding can replace all AMF control functions.
Checking amf responsibilities alone replaces verification specific to control and user planes.

quiz.explanationEn: Control messages establish state; the user plane carries application data. Neighboring amf responsibilities has a different role: Access/mobility management is separate from session management. Its success or the stated misconception cannot replace unit-specific evidence.

knowledge.textEn: Neighboring fault retries: Retries must prevent duplicate inconsistent state creation. Record its evidence separately; its success does not prove capacity models passes.

knowledge.title: 受控對照與證據品質
knowledge.text: 模擬 SMF 重啟後有與沒有狀態恢復。 只變一個條件，保留相同資料格式、時間範圍及分母；模型估計與實測證據要分別標記。
knowledge.textEn: Model SMF restart with and without state recovery. Change one condition and retain comparable formats, intervals and denominators; label estimates separately from measured evidence.

quiz.question: 針對「容量模型」的原理與可觀測性，哪項最直接成立？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement most directly explains the principle/observability of capacity models?
options: 註冊率、session 率及資料吞吐要分別估計。
UPF 承載資料流，因此可取代所有 AMF 控制功能。
只檢查「容錯重試」，便可取代「容量模型」的專屬驗證。
optionsEn: Estimate registration rate, session rate and data throughput separately.
UPF data forwarding can replace all AMF control functions.
Checking fault retries alone replaces verification specific to capacity models.
quiz.explanation: 註冊率、session 率及資料吞吐要分別估計。 相鄰的「容錯重試」有不同責任：重試須避免同一請求重複建立不一致狀態。因此不能用該項通過或課內誤判取代本單元證據。
quiz.explanationEn: Estimate registration rate, session rate and data throughput separately. Neighboring fault retries has a different role: Retries must prevent duplicate inconsistent state creation. Its success or the stated misconception cannot replace unit-specific evidence.

steps.title: 容錯重試：架構與原理
steps.objective: 針對「容錯重試」建立有邊界、可反駁的系統模型。
steps.objectiveEn: For fault retries, construct a bounded falsifiable system model.
steps.instruction: 觀看師傅的功能示意後，以「容錯重試」為中心標出輸入、輸出、信任或資源邊界，並在學徒工作台排列資料流或元件。原理是：重試須避免同一請求重複建立不一致狀態。 使用自行編寫的兩組小型資料或試算表，建立基準與一次只改一項的對照：模擬 SMF 重啟後有與沒有狀態恢復。 先寫出可被反駁的預測；把「互通矩陣」視為相鄰問題，說明它如何影響模型而不能混同。數值只採本課假想算例或自訂並列明單位；本步保存架構圖、假設表與預測。
steps.instructionEn: After the mentor functional diagram, mark inputs, outputs and trust/resource boundaries around fault retries, then arrange components or data flows in the apprentice workspace. Principle: Retries must prevent duplicate inconsistent state creation. Create two small authored datasets or spreadsheet cases: a baseline and a one-variable change. Model SMF restart with and without state recovery. Predict a falsifiable outcome before evaluating it. Treat interoperability matrix as a neighboring issue and explain its influence without conflating them. Use only the stated hypothetical case or declared assumed inputs/units. Save the architecture, assumptions and prediction.
steps.observation: 模擬 SMF 重啟後有與沒有狀態恢復。 比較「容錯重試」與「互通矩陣」的證據是否支持相同推論。
steps.observationEn: Model SMF restart with and without state recovery. Compare whether evidence for fault retries and interoperability matrix supports the same inference.
steps.failure: 容器數量加倍必然讓有狀態核心容量加倍。 這是本課要排除的誤判；先核對模型邊界、來源版本及缺失證據。
steps.failureEn: Doubling containers necessarily doubles stateful-core capacity. This is a misconception to reject; check boundaries, source versions and missing evidence.
steps.check: 提交「容錯重試」的功能草圖、基準／擾動表、單位或欄位定義、可反駁預測及接受／保留理由。需能重算本課假想例，並說明相鄰機制不可取代的驗證。
steps.checkEn: Submit a functional sketch, baseline/perturbation table, unit/field definitions, falsifiable prediction and accept/hold rationale for fault retries. Recompute the course case and explain verification that the neighboring mechanism cannot replace.

Model outputs must remain labeled simulation, not physical measurements. Explain which requirement to accept, hold or reject and retain recomputable records.

steps.check: 提交「容錯重試」的功能草圖、基準／擾動表、單位或欄位定義、可反駁預測及接受／保留理由。需能重算本課假想例，並說明相鄰機制不可取代的驗證。

scopeEn: Offline/local synthetic-data engineering education from public principles. Use authored data or explicitly authorized test environments only. title: 開放式無線接取網路
summary: 以解耦無線元件、開放介面與閉迴路控制串連 16 個領域技術單元、32 個保存步驟；分析架構、原理、介面、故障、量化案例與防禦證據。
summaryEn: Sixteen domain-specific technical units and 32 saved steps connect disaggregated radio components, open interfaces and closed-loop control through architecture, principles, interfaces, faults, quantitative cases and defensive evidence.

stages.title: 需求、元件與基本模型
stages.description: 四個領域技術單元各完成原理建模與對照證據，共八項可個別保存的作業。
stages.descriptionEn: Four domain units each pair principle modeling with controlled evidence, producing eight separately saved tasks.

steps.title: 解耦邊界：架構與原理
steps.objective: 針對「解耦邊界」建立有邊界、可反駁的系統模型。
steps.objectiveEn: For disaggregation boundaries, construct a bounded falsifiable system model.
steps.instruction: 觀看師傅的功能示意後，以「解耦邊界」為中心標出輸入、輸出、信任或資源邊界，並在學徒工作台排列資料流或元件。原理是：元件解耦增加介面驗證與版本管理責任。 使用自行編寫的兩組小型資料或試算表，建立基準與一次只改一項的對照：保留功能切分，只改 fronthaul 延遲。 先寫出可被反駁的預測；把「O-RU 與 O-DU」視為相鄰問題，說明它如何影響模型而不能混同。數值只採本課假想算例或自訂並列明單位；本步保存架構圖、假設表與預測。
steps.instructionEn: After the mentor functional diagram, mark inputs, outputs and trust/resource boundaries around disaggregation boundaries, then arrange components or data flows in the apprentice workspace. Principle: Disaggregation adds interface-verification and version-management responsibilities. Create two small authored datasets or spreadsheet cases: a baseline and a one-variable change. Keep the split and vary fronthaul delay. Predict a falsifiable outcome before evaluating it. Treat o-ru and o-du as a neighboring issue and explain its influence without conflating them. Use only the stated hypothetical case or declared assumed inputs/units. Save the architecture, assumptions and prediction.
steps.observation: 保留功能切分，只改 fronthaul 延遲。 比較「解耦邊界」與「O-RU 與 O-DU」的證據是否支持相同推論。
steps.observationEn: Keep the split and vary fronthaul delay. Compare whether evidence for disaggregation boundaries and o-ru and o-du supports the same inference.
steps.failure: 開放介面保證所有供應商產品即插即用。 這是本課要排除的誤判；先核對模型邊界、來源版本及缺失證據。
steps.failureEn: Open interfaces guarantee universal vendor plug-and-play. This is a misconception to reject; check boundaries, source versions and missing evidence.
steps.check: 提交「解耦邊界」的功能草圖、基準／擾動表、單位或欄位定義、可反駁預測及接受／保留理由。需能重算本課假想例，並說明相鄰機制不可取代的驗證。
steps.checkEn: Submit a functional sketch, baseline/perturbation table, unit/field definitions, falsifiable prediction and accept/hold rationale for disaggregation boundaries. Recompute the course case and explain verification that the neighboring mechanism cannot replace.

options: 前傳資料與時基需協同，容量足夠不代表同步足夠。
所有 RIC 控制迴路均適合逐 OFDM 符號控制。
只檢查「管理平面」，便可取代「前傳同步」的專屬驗證。
optionsEn: Fronthaul data and timing must cooperate; capacity does not prove synchronization.
Every RIC loop is suitable for per-OFDM-symbol control.
Checking management plane alone replaces verification specific to fronthaul synchronization.
quiz.explanation: 前傳資料與時基需協同，容量足夠不代表同步足夠。 相鄰的「管理平面」有不同責任：管理配置須與運行資料路徑的權限分離。因此不能用該項通過或課內誤判取代本單元證據。
quiz.explanationEn: Fronthaul data and timing must cooperate; capacity does not prove synchronization. Neighboring management plane has a different role: Management configuration needs permissions separate from runtime data paths. Its success or the stated misconception cannot replace unit-specific evidence.

steps.title: 前傳同步：對照試驗與證據
steps.titleEn: Fronthaul synchronization: controlled experiment and evidence
steps.objective: 針對「前傳同步」完成含競爭原因及不確定度的驗收紀錄。
steps.objectiveEn: For fronthaul synchronization, complete acceptance evidence with competing causes and uncertainty.
steps.instruction: 重播本單元示意，讀取自製的基準與擾動紀錄，不接觸未授權目標。對照「前傳資料與時基需協同，容量足夠不代表同步足夠。」，執行下列紙上或本地合成資料試驗：保留功能切分，只改 fronthaul 延遲。 分開記錄預測、觀察與不確定度，再提出至少兩個可能原因；利用「管理平面」的獨立證據排除一個原因。若結果只來自模型，標記為模擬，不能當作真實設備量測。最後說明目前應接受、保留或拒絕哪一項要求，並保存可重算資料。
steps.instructionEn: Replay the unit diagram and inspect your authored baseline/perturbed records without accessing unauthorized targets. Evaluate the principle: Fronthaul data and timing must cooperate; capacity does not prove synchronization. Conduct this paper or local synthetic-data experiment: Keep the split and vary fronthaul delay. Record prediction, observation and uncertainty separately, propose two competing causes and use independent evidence from management plane to exclude one. Model outputs must remain labeled simulation, not physical measurements. Explain which requirement to accept, hold or reject and retain recomputable records.
steps.observation: 保留功能切分，只改 fronthaul 延遲。 比較「前傳同步」與「管理平面」的證據是否支持相同推論。
steps.observationEn: Keep the split and vary fronthaul delay. Compare whether evidence for fronthaul synchronization and management plane supports the same inference.
steps.failure: 所有 RIC 控制迴路均適合逐 OFDM 符號控制。 這是本課要排除的誤判；先核對模型邊界、來源版本及缺失證據。
steps.failureEn: Every RIC loop is suitable for per-OFDM-symbol control. This is a misconception to reject; check boundaries, source versions and missing evidence.
steps.check: 提交「前傳同步」的功能草圖、基準／擾動表、單位或欄位定義、可反駁預測及接受／保留理由。需能重算本課假想例，並說明相鄰機制不可取代的驗證。
steps.checkEn: Submit a functional sketch, baseline/perturbation table, unit/field definitions, falsifiable prediction and accept/hold rationale for fronthaul synchronization. Recompute the course case and explain verification that the neighboring mechanism cannot replace.

knowledge.textEn: Keep the split and vary fronthaul delay. Change one condition and retain comparable formats, intervals and denominators; label estimates separately from measured evidence.

stages.descriptionEn: Four domain units each pair principle modeling with controlled evidence, producing eight separately saved tasks.

steps.title: 管理平面：架構與原理
steps.objective: 針對「管理平面」建立有邊界、可反駁的系統模型。
steps.objectiveEn: For management plane, construct a bounded falsifiable system model.
steps.instruction: 觀看師傅的功能示意後，以「管理平面」為中心標出輸入、輸出、信任或資源邊界，並在學徒工作台排列資料流或元件。原理是：管理配置須與運行資料路徑的權限分離。 使用自行編寫的兩組小型資料或試算表，建立基準與一次只改一項的對照：固定 xApp 輸入，只改控制更新週期。 先寫出可被反駁的預測；把「Near-RT RIC」視為相鄰問題，說明它如何影響模型而不能混同。數值只採本課假想算例或自訂並列明單位；本步保存架構圖、假設表與預測。
steps.instructionEn: After the mentor functional diagram, mark inputs, outputs and trust/resource boundaries around management plane, then arrange components or data flows in the apprentice workspace. Principle: Management configuration needs permissions separate from runtime data paths. Create two small authored datasets or spreadsheet cases: a baseline and a one-variable change. Fix xApp inputs and vary control update interval. Predict a falsifiable outcome before evaluating it. Treat near-real-time ric as a neighboring issue and explain its influence without conflating them. Use only the stated hypothetical case or declared assumed inputs/units. Save the architecture, assumptions and prediction.

steps.title: Non-RT RIC：架構與原理
steps.objective: 針對「Non-RT RIC」建立有邊界、可反駁的系統模型。

steps.instructionEn: After the mentor functional diagram, mark inputs, outputs and trust/resource boundaries around non-real-time ric, then arrange components or data flows in the apprentice workspace. Principle: Slow-timescale policy/learning cannot replace low-layer real-time processing. Create two small authored datasets or spreadsheet cases: a baseline and a one-variable change. Fix xApp inputs and vary control update interval. Predict a falsifiable outcome before evaluating it. Treat xapps and rapps as a neighboring issue and explain its influence without conflating them. Use only the stated hypothetical case or declared assumed inputs/units. Save the architecture, assumptions and prediction.
steps.observation: 固定 xApp 輸入，只改控制更新週期。 比較「Non-RT RIC」與「xApp/rApp」的證據是否支持相同推論。
steps.observationEn: Fix xApp inputs and vary control update interval. Compare whether evidence for non-real-time ric and xapps and rapps supports the same inference.

steps.failureEn: Open interfaces guarantee universal vendor plug-and-play. This is a misconception to reject; check boundaries, source versions and missing evidence.
steps.check: 提交「Non-RT RIC」的功能草圖、基準／擾動表、單位或欄位定義、可反駁預測及接受／保留理由。需能重算本課假想例，並說明相鄰機制不可取代的驗證。

Principle: Sampling and reporting delay affect control observability. Create two small authored datasets or spreadsheet cases: a baseline and a one-variable change. Compare overlaps and omissions in two vendor capability declarations. Predict a falsifiable outcome before evaluating it. Treat a1 policies as a neighboring issue and explain its influence without conflating them. Use only the stated hypothetical case or declared assumed inputs/units. Save the architecture, assumptions and prediction.

knowledge.textEn: Model controller loss and verify degradation rather than uncontrolled action. Change one condition and retain comparable formats, intervals and denominators; label estimates separately from measured evidence.

quiz.question: 針對「安全邊界」的原理與可觀測性，哪項最直接成立？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement most directly explains the principle/observability of security boundaries?
options: 開放介面仍需相互驗證與最小權限。
開放介面保證所有供應商產品即插即用。
只檢查「互通能力」，便可取代「安全邊界」的專屬驗證。
optionsEn: Open interfaces still need mutual authentication and least privilege.
Open interfaces guarantee universal vendor plug-and-play.
Checking interoperability capabilities alone replaces verification specific to security boundaries.
quiz.explanation: 開放介面仍需相互驗證與最小權限。 相鄰的「互通能力」有不同責任：支援同一規格不表示支援相同選用功能。因此不能用該項通過或課內誤判取代本單元證據。
quiz.explanationEn: Open interfaces still need mutual authentication and least privilege. Neighboring interoperability capabilities has a different role: Sharing a specification does not imply identical optional capabilities. Its success or the stated misconception cannot replace unit-specific evidence.

steps.title: 互通能力：架構與原理
steps.objective: 針對「互通能力」建立有邊界、可反駁的系統模型。
steps.objectiveEn: For interoperability capabilities, construct a bounded falsifiable system model.
steps.instruction: 觀看師傅的功能示意後，以「互通能力」為中心標出輸入、輸出、信任或資源邊界，並在學徒工作台排列資料流或元件。原理是：支援同一規格不表示支援相同選用功能。 使用自行編寫的兩組小型資料或試算表，建立基準與一次只改一項的對照：模擬控制器斷線，觀察降階而非失控。 先寫出可被反駁的預測；把「閉迴路穩定」視為相鄰問題，說明它如何影響模型而不能混同。數值只採本課假想算例或自訂並列明單位；本步保存架構圖、假設表與預測。
steps.instructionEn: After the mentor functional diagram, mark inputs, outputs and trust/resource boundaries around interoperability capabilities, then arrange components or data flows in the apprentice workspace. Principle: Sharing a specification does not imply identical optional capabilities. Create two small authored datasets or spreadsheet cases: a baseline and a one-variable change. Model controller loss and verify degradation rather than uncontrolled action. Predict a falsifiable outcome before evaluating it. Treat closed-loop stability as a neighboring issue and explain its influence without conflating them. Use only the stated hypothetical case or declared assumed inputs/units. Save the architecture, assumptions and prediction.
steps.observation: 模擬控制器斷線，觀察降階而非失控。 比較「互通能力」與「閉迴路穩定」的證據是否支持相同推論。
steps.observationEn: Model controller loss and verify degradation rather than uncontrolled action. Compare whether evidence for interoperability capabilities and closed-loop stability supports the same inference.
steps.failure: 所有 RIC 控制迴路均適合逐 OFDM 符號控制。 這是本課要排除的誤判；先核對模型邊界、來源版本及缺失證據。
steps.failureEn: Every RIC loop is suitable for per-OFDM-symbol control. This is a misconception to reject; check boundaries, source versions and missing evidence.
steps.check: 提交「互通能力」的功能草圖、基準／擾動表、單位或欄位定義、可反駁預測及接受／保留理由。需能重算本課假想例，並說明相鄰機制不可取代的驗證。
steps.checkEn: Submit a functional sketch, baseline/perturbation table, unit/field definitions, falsifiable prediction and accept/hold rationale for interoperability capabilities. Recompute the course case and explain verification that the neighboring mechanism cannot replace.

knowledge.title: 原理、架構與適用邊界
knowledge.text: 支援同一規格不表示支援相同選用功能。
knowledge.textEn: Sharing a specification does not imply identical optional capabilities.

knowledge.title: 相鄰機制與不可混同處
knowledge.text: 相鄰的「閉迴路穩定」：延遲與增益會使看似良好策略震盪。 必須另列其證據，不能把這項機制的通過當作「互通能力」已通過。
knowledge.textEn: Neighboring closed-loop stability: Delay and gain can destabilize an apparently good policy. Record its evidence separately; its success does not prove interoperability capabilities passes.

steps.title: 互通能力：對照試驗與證據
steps.titleEn: Interoperability capabilities: controlled experiment and evidence
steps.objective: 針對「互通能力」完成含競爭原因及不確定度的驗收紀錄。
steps.objectiveEn: For interoperability capabilities, complete acceptance evidence with competing causes and uncertainty.
steps.instruction: 重播本單元示意，讀取自製的基準與擾動紀錄，不接觸未授權目標。對照「支援同一規格不表示支援相同選用功能。」，執行下列紙上或本地合成資料試驗：模擬控制器斷線，觀察降階而非失控。 分開記錄預測、觀察與不確定度，再提出至少兩個可能原因；利用「閉迴路穩定」的獨立證據排除一個原因。若結果只來自模型，標記為模擬，不能當作真實設備量測。最後說明目前應接受、保留或拒絕哪一項要求，並保存可重算資料。
steps.instructionEn: Replay the unit diagram and inspect your authored baseline/perturbed records without accessing unauthorized targets. Evaluate the principle: Sharing a specification does not imply identical optional capabilities. Conduct this paper or local synthetic-data experiment: Model controller loss and verify degradation rather than uncontrolled action. Record prediction, observation and uncertainty separately, propose two competing causes and use independent evidence from closed-loop stability to exclude one. Model outputs must remain labeled simulation, not physical measurements. Explain which requirement to accept, hold or reject and retain recomputable records.

steps.check: 提交「互通能力」的功能草圖、基準／擾動表、單位或欄位定義、可反駁預測及接受／保留理由。需能重算本課假想例，並說明相鄰機制不可取代的驗證。

title: 5G 網路切片
summary: 以切片識別、資源合約與隔離證據串連 16 個領域技術單元、32 個保存步驟；分析架構、原理、介面、故障、量化案例與防禦證據。
summaryEn: Sixteen domain-specific technical units and 32 saved steps connect slice identity, resource contracts and isolation evidence through architecture, principles, interfaces, faults, quantitative cases and defensive evidence.

stages.title: 需求、元件與基本模型
stages.description: 四個領域技術單元各完成原理建模與對照證據，共八項可個別保存的作業。
stages.descriptionEn: Four domain units each pair principle modeling with controlled evidence, producing eight separately saved tasks.

steps.title: 服務合約：架構與原理
steps.objective: 針對「服務合約」建立有邊界、可反駁的系統模型。
steps.objectiveEn: For service contracts, construct a bounded falsifiable system model.
steps.instruction: 觀看師傅的功能示意後，以「服務合約」為中心標出輸入、輸出、信任或資源邊界，並在學徒工作台排列資料流或元件。原理是：吞吐、延遲與可靠性需要分開且可測的要求。 使用自行編寫的兩組小型資料或試算表，建立基準與一次只改一項的對照：改單一切片突發量而固定其他需求。 先寫出可被反駁的預測；把「切片識別」視為相鄰問題，說明它如何影響模型而不能混同。數值只採本課假想算例或自訂並列明單位；本步保存架構圖、假設表與預測。
steps.instructionEn: After the mentor functional diagram, mark inputs, outputs and trust/resource boundaries around service contracts, then arrange components or data flows in the apprentice workspace. Principle: Throughput, latency and reliability need separate measurable requirements. Create two small authored datasets or spreadsheet cases: a baseline and a one-variable change. Vary one slice burst while fixing other demands. Predict a falsifiable outcome before evaluating it. Treat slice identifiers as a neighboring issue and explain its influence without conflating them. Use only the stated hypothetical case or declared assumed inputs/units. Save the architecture, assumptions and prediction.
steps.observation: 改單一切片突發量而固定其他需求。 比較「服務合約」與「切片識別」的證據是否支持相同推論。
steps.observationEn: Vary one slice burst while fixing other demands. Compare whether evidence for service contracts and slice identifiers supports the same inference.
steps.failure: 切片名稱不同便具有物理資源隔離。 這是本課要排除的誤判；先核對模型邊界、來源版本及缺失證據。
steps.failureEn: Different slice names prove physical resource isolation. This is a misconception to reject; check boundaries, source versions and missing evidence.

steps.checkEn: Submit a functional sketch, baseline/perturbation table, unit/field definitions, falsifiable prediction and accept/hold rationale for service contracts. Recompute the course case and explain verification that the neighboring mechanism cannot replace.

steps.instruction: 重播本單元示意，讀取自製的基準與擾動紀錄，不接觸未授權目標。對照「端到端切片需要協調無線、傳輸與核心資源。」，執行下列紙上或本地合成資料試驗：改單一切片突發量而固定其他需求。 分開記錄預測、觀察與不確定度，再提出至少兩個可能原因；利用「網路功能共用」的獨立證據排除一個原因。若結果只來自模型，標記為模擬，不能當作真實設備量測。最後說明目前應接受、保留或拒絕哪一項要求，並保存可重算資料。
steps.instructionEn: Replay the unit diagram and inspect your authored baseline/perturbed records without accessing unauthorized targets. Evaluate the principle: End-to-end slicing coordinates radio, transport and core resources. Conduct this paper or local synthetic-data experiment: Vary one slice burst while fixing other demands. Record prediction, observation and uncertainty separately, propose two competing causes and use independent evidence from shared network functions to exclude one. Model outputs must remain labeled simulation, not physical measurements. Explain which requirement to accept, hold or reject and retain recomputable records.
steps.observation: 改單一切片突發量而固定其他需求。 比較「接取與核心」與「網路功能共用」的證據是否支持相同推論。
steps.observationEn: Vary one slice burst while fixing other demands. Compare whether evidence for access and core and shared network functions supports the same inference.
steps.failure: 同一切片的平均吞吐可證明所有用戶 SLA。 這是本課要排除的誤判；先核對模型邊界、來源版本及缺失證據。
steps.failureEn: A slice mean throughput proves every user’s SLA. This is a misconception to reject; check boundaries, source versions and missing evidence.
steps.check: 提交「接取與核心」的功能草圖、基準／擾動表、單位或欄位定義、可反駁預測及接受／保留理由。需能重算本課假想例，並說明相鄰機制不可取代的驗證。
steps.checkEn: Submit a functional sketch, baseline/perturbation table, unit/field definitions, falsifiable prediction and accept/hold rationale for access and core. Recompute the course case and explain verification that the neighboring mechanism cannot replace.

knowledge.textEn: Vary one slice burst while fixing other demands. Change one condition and retain comparable formats, intervals and denominators; label estimates separately from measured evidence.

stages.descriptionEn: Four domain units each pair principle modeling with controlled evidence, producing eight separately saved tasks.

steps.title: 網路功能共用：架構與原理
steps.titleEn: Shared network functions: architecture and principle
steps.objective: 針對「網路功能共用」建立有邊界、可反駁的系統模型。

Compare shared and separated UPF failure domains. Predict a falsifiable outcome before evaluating it. Treat resource budgets as a neighboring issue and explain its influence without conflating them. Use only the stated hypothetical case or declared assumed inputs/units. Save the architecture, assumptions and prediction.

steps.observationEn: Compare shared and separated UPF failure domains. Compare whether evidence for shared network functions and resource budgets supports the same inference.

steps.objective: 針對「量測可歸屬性」建立有邊界、可反駁的系統模型。

Keep resources fixed and change admission demand. Predict a falsifiable outcome before evaluating it. Treat policy authorization as a neighboring issue and explain its influence without conflating them. Use only the stated hypothetical case or declared assumed inputs/units. Save the architecture, assumptions and prediction.

steps.check: 提交「量測可歸屬性」的功能草圖、基準／擾動表、單位或欄位定義、可反駁預測及接受／保留理由。需能重算本課假想例，並說明相鄰機制不可取代的驗證。

steps.instruction: 重播本單元示意，讀取自製的基準與擾動紀錄，不接觸未授權目標。對照「撤除後需確認路由、憑據及資源都已清理。」，執行下列紙上或本地合成資料試驗：模擬授權失效是否影響其他切片。 分開記錄預測、觀察與不確定度，再提出至少兩個可能原因；利用「服務合約」的獨立證據排除一個原因。若結果只來自模型，標記為模擬，不能當作真實設備量測。最後說明目前應接受、保留或拒絕哪一項要求，並保存可重算資料。
steps.instructionEn: Replay the unit diagram and inspect your authored baseline/perturbed records without accessing unauthorized targets. Evaluate the principle: After removal, verify cleanup of routes, credentials and resources. Conduct this paper or local synthetic-data experiment: Model whether one authorization failure affects other slices. Record prediction, observation and uncertainty separately, propose two competing causes and use independent evidence from service contracts to exclude one. Model outputs must remain labeled simulation, not physical measurements. Explain which requirement to accept, hold or reject and retain recomputable records.
steps.observation: 模擬授權失效是否影響其他切片。 比較「解配置證據」與「服務合約」的證據是否支持相同推論。
steps.observationEn: Model whether one authorization failure affects other slices. Compare whether evidence for deprovisioning evidence and service contracts supports the same inference.
steps.failure: 同一切片的平均吞吐可證明所有用戶 SLA。 這是本課要排除的誤判；先核對模型邊界、來源版本及缺失證據。
steps.failureEn: A slice mean throughput proves every user’s SLA. This is a misconception to reject; check boundaries, source versions and missing evidence.
steps.check: 提交「解配置證據」的功能草圖、基準／擾動表、單位或欄位定義、可反駁預測及接受／保留理由。需能重算本課假想例，並說明相鄰機制不可取代的驗證。
steps.checkEn: Submit a functional sketch, baseline/perturbation table, unit/field definitions, falsifiable prediction and accept/hold rationale for deprovisioning evidence. Recompute the course case and explain verification that the neighboring mechanism cannot replace.

knowledge.title: 原理、架構與適用邊界
knowledge.text: 撤除後需確認路由、憑據及資源都已清理。
knowledge.textEn: After removal, verify cleanup of routes, credentials and resources.

knowledge.title: 相鄰機制與不可混同處
knowledge.text: 相鄰的「服務合約」：吞吐、延遲與可靠性需要分開且可測的要求。 必須另列其證據，不能把這項機制的通過當作「解配置證據」已通過。
knowledge.textEn: Neighboring service contracts: Throughput, latency and reliability need separate measurable requirements. Record its evidence separately; its success does not prove deprovisioning evidence passes.

knowledge.title: 受控對照與證據品質
knowledge.text: 模擬授權失效是否影響其他切片。 只變一個條件，保留相同資料格式、時間範圍及分母；模型估計與實測證據要分別標記。
knowledge.textEn: Model whether one authorization failure affects other slices. Change one condition and retain comparable formats, intervals and denominators; label estimates separately from measured evidence.

knowledge.title: 可重算的原創假想例
knowledge.text: 假想 1 Gbit/s 鏈路分 40%、30%、20% 給三片，共 900 Mbit/s，保留 100 Mbit/s；共享排隊與 CPU 未隔離時，分配比例不能單獨保證延遲。
knowledge.textEn: A hypothetical 1 Gbit/s link allocates 40%, 30% and 20% to three slices, totaling 900 Mbit/s and leaving 100 Mbit/s; shares alone do not guarantee latency with shared queues/CPU.

quiz.question: 針對「解配置證據」的原理與可觀測性，哪項最直接成立？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement most directly explains the principle/observability of deprovisioning evidence?
options: 撤除後需確認路由、憑據及資源都已清理。
同一切片的平均吞吐可證明所有用戶 SLA。
只檢查「服務合約」，便可取代「解配置證據」的專屬驗證。
optionsEn: After removal, verify cleanup of routes, credentials and resources.
A slice mean throughput proves every user’s SLA.
Checking service contracts alone replaces verification specific to deprovisioning evidence.
quiz.explanation: 撤除後需確認路由、憑據及資源都已清理。 相鄰的「服務合約」有不同責任：吞吐、延遲與可靠性需要分開且可測的要求。因此不能用該項通過或課內誤判取代本單元證據。
quiz.explanationEn: After removal, verify cleanup of routes, credentials and resources. Neighboring service contracts has a different role: Throughput, latency and reliability need separate measurable requirements. Its success or the stated misconception cannot replace unit-specific evidence.

scope: 公開原理的離線／本地合成資料工程教育。只使用自行生成資料或明確獲授權的測試環境；不提供真實目標掃描、漏洞利用、惡意程式、車輛／工控注入或實際射頻發射程序。數值為原創假設，非供應商保證或現場驗收標準。
scopeEn: Offline/local synthetic-data engineering education from public principles. Use authored data or explicitly authorized test environments only. No real-target scanning, exploitation, malware, vehicle/OT injection or live RF procedures. Numerical cases are original assumptions, not supplier guarantees or field acceptance criteria.

workedExample.title: 原創假想量化例與限制
workedExample.titleEn: Original hypothetical quantitative case and limits
workedExample.text: 假想 1 Gbit/s 鏈路分 40%、30%、20% 給三片，共 900 Mbit/s，保留 100 Mbit/s；共享排隊與 CPU 未隔離時，分配比例不能單獨保證延遲。
workedExample.textEn: A hypothetical 1 Gbit/s link allocates 40%, 30% and 20% to three slices, totaling 900 Mbit/s and leaving 100 Mbit/s; shares alone do not guarantee latency with shared queues/CPU.
workedExample.assumptions: 只採算例中明列的教學條件；效能與安全估計須依拓撲、分布、開銷、版本與不確定度重算。
workedExample.assumptionsEn: Use only the stated teaching assumptions; recalculate for topology, distribution, overhead, versions and uncertainty.
workedExample.sourceScope: 作者自行設定的教學數值；官方來源支援原理與尺寸規格，未聲稱量測此假想平台。
workedExample.sourceScopeEn: Independently chosen teaching inputs; official sources support principles and specified material sizes, not measurements of this hypothetical platform.

title: 蜂巢式基地台整合
summary: 以基地台功能切分、射頻指標與同步串連 16 個領域技術單元、32 個保存步驟；分析架構、原理、介面、故障、量化案例與防禦證據。
summaryEn: Sixteen domain-specific technical units and 32 saved steps connect base-station splits, rf metrics and synchronization through architecture, principles, interfaces, faults, quantitative cases and defensive evidence.

stages.title: 需求、元件與基本模型
stages.description: 四個領域技術單元各完成原理建模與對照證據，共八項可個別保存的作業。
stages.descriptionEn: Four domain units each pair principle modeling with controlled evidence, producing eight separately saved tasks.

steps.title: 系統功能圖：架構與原理
steps.titleEn: System functional map: architecture and principle
steps.objective: 針對「系統功能圖」建立有邊界、可反駁的系統模型。
steps.objectiveEn: For system functional map, construct a bounded falsifiable system model.
steps.instruction: 觀看師傅的功能示意後，以「系統功能圖」為中心標出輸入、輸出、信任或資源邊界，並在學徒工作台排列資料流或元件。原理是：射頻、基頻、傳輸及管理是相連但不同子系統。 使用自行編寫的兩組小型資料或試算表，建立基準與一次只改一項的對照：固定頻寬，只改可用空間層數。 先寫出可被反駁的預測；把「功能切分」視為相鄰問題，說明它如何影響模型而不能混同。數值只採本課假想算例或自訂並列明單位；本步保存架構圖、假設表與預測。
steps.instructionEn: After the mentor functional diagram, mark inputs, outputs and trust/resource boundaries around system functional map, then arrange components or data flows in the apprentice workspace. Principle: RF, baseband, transport and management are connected but distinct subsystems. Create two small authored datasets or spreadsheet cases: a baseline and a one-variable change. Fix bandwidth and vary usable spatial layers. Predict a falsifiable outcome before evaluating it. Treat functional splits as a neighboring issue and explain its influence without conflating them. Use only the stated hypothetical case or declared assumed inputs/units. Save the architecture, assumptions and prediction.
steps.observation: 固定頻寬，只改可用空間層數。 比較「系統功能圖」與「功能切分」的證據是否支持相同推論。
steps.observationEn: Fix bandwidth and vary usable spatial layers. Compare whether evidence for system functional map and functional splits supports the same inference.
steps.failure: 天線數直接等於任何位置的可用 MIMO 層數。 這是本課要排除的誤判；先核對模型邊界、來源版本及缺失證據。
steps.failureEn: Antenna count equals usable MIMO layers at every location. This is a misconception to reject; check boundaries, source versions and missing evidence.
steps.check: 提交「系統功能圖」的功能草圖、基準／擾動表、單位或欄位定義、可反駁預測及接受／保留理由。需能重算本課假想例，並說明相鄰機制不可取代的驗證。
steps.checkEn: Submit a functional sketch, baseline/perturbation table, unit/field definitions, falsifiable prediction and accept/hold rationale for system functional map. Recompute the course case and explain verification that the neighboring mechanism cannot replace.

knowledge.textEn: Fix bandwidth and vary usable spatial layers. Change one condition and retain comparable formats, intervals and denominators; label estimates separately from measured evidence.

knowledge.title: 可重算的原創假想例
knowledge.text: 假設 20 MHz 教學頻寬與 4 bit/s/Hz 有效效率，單層吞吐 80 Mbit/s；假定四層可獨立利用為 320 Mbit/s，此為理想上界，未計協議開銷與實際通道秩。
knowledge.textEn: A hypothetical 20 MHz channel at 4 bit/s/Hz yields 80 Mbit/s per layer; four independent layers imply 320 Mbit/s as an ideal upper bound, excluding overhead and actual channel rank.

steps.title: 射頻鏈路：架構與原理
steps.objective: 針對「射頻鏈路」建立有邊界、可反駁的系統模型。

steps.instruction: 觀看師傅的功能示意後，以「射頻鏈路」為中心標出輸入、輸出、信任或資源邊界，並在學徒工作台排列資料流或元件。原理是：混頻、濾波與放大共同影響輸出品質。 使用自行編寫的兩組小型資料或試算表，建立基準與一次只改一項的對照：固定射頻訊號，只改取樣時鐘偏差。 先寫出可被反駁的預測；把「EVM」視為相鄰問題，說明它如何影響模型而不能混同。數值只採本課假想算例或自訂並列明單位；本步保存架構圖、假設表與預測。

Fix RF signals and vary sampling-clock error. Predict a falsifiable outcome before evaluating it. Treat error-vector magnitude as a neighboring issue and explain its influence without conflating them. Use only the stated hypothetical case or declared assumed inputs/units. Save the architecture, assumptions and prediction.

steps.checkEn: Submit a functional sketch, baseline/perturbation table, unit/field definitions, falsifiable prediction and accept/hold rationale for rf chain. Recompute the course case and explain verification that the neighboring mechanism cannot replace.

量測傳播差異用於調整上行到達時刻。
optionsEn: A splitter provides an independent full-rate link to every household.
Checking bandwidth allocation alone replaces verification specific to ranging compensation.
Measured propagation differences adjust upstream arrival timing.
quiz.explanation: 量測傳播差異用於調整上行到達時刻。 相鄰的「帶寬配置」有不同責任：需求分配影響共享流量公平性與等待時間。因此不能用該項通過或課內誤判取代本單元證據。
quiz.explanationEn: Measured propagation differences adjust upstream arrival timing. Neighboring bandwidth allocation has a different role: Demand allocation affects fairness and waiting on shared capacity. Its success or the stated misconception cannot replace unit-specific evidence.

steps.title: 帶寬配置：架構與原理
steps.objective: 針對「帶寬配置」建立有邊界、可反駁的系統模型。

steps.instruction: 觀看師傅的功能示意後，以「帶寬配置」為中心標出輸入、輸出、信任或資源邊界，並在學徒工作台排列資料流或元件。原理是：需求分配影響共享流量公平性與等待時間。 使用自行編寫的兩組小型資料或試算表，建立基準與一次只改一項的對照：比較同步與突發住戶負載。 先寫出可被反駁的預測；把「住戶服務映射」視為相鄰問題，說明它如何影響模型而不能混同。數值只採本課假想算例或自訂並列明單位；本步保存架構圖、假設表與預測。

Use only the stated hypothetical case or declared assumed inputs/units. Save the architecture, assumptions and prediction.

workedExample.title: 原創假想量化例與限制
workedExample.titleEn: Original hypothetical quantitative case and limits
workedExample.text: 假設 20 km 光纖損耗 0.25 dB/km、1:32 理想分光 15.05 dB、接頭 2 dB、餘裕 3 dB，總需 25.05 dB；須再核對實際分光器附加損耗。
workedExample.textEn: Assume 20 km fiber at 0.25 dB/km, ideal 1:32 splitting at 15.05 dB, 2 dB connectors and 3 dB margin: budget=25.05 dB, before real splitter excess loss.
workedExample.assumptions: 只採算例中明列的教學條件；效能與安全估計須依拓撲、分布、開銷、版本與不確定度重算。
workedExample.assumptionsEn: Use only the stated teaching assumptions; recalculate for topology, distribution, overhead, versions and uncertainty.
workedExample.sourceScope: 作者自行設定的教學數值；官方來源支援原理與尺寸規格，未聲稱量測此假想平台。
workedExample.sourceScopeEn: Independently chosen teaching inputs; official sources support principles and specified material sizes, not measurements of this hypothetical platform.

title: 被動光網路設備
summary: 以PON 收發機、突發模式與協議封裝串連 16 個領域技術單元、32 個保存步驟；分析架構、原理、介面、故障、量化案例與防禦證據。
summaryEn: Sixteen domain-specific technical units and 32 saved steps connect pon transceivers, burst modes and protocol framing through architecture, principles, interfaces, faults, quantitative cases and defensive evidence.

stages.title: 需求、元件與基本模型
stages.description: 四個領域技術單元各完成原理建模與對照證據，共八項可個別保存的作業。
stages.descriptionEn: Four domain units each pair principle modeling with controlled evidence, producing eight separately saved tasks.

steps.title: 設備邊界：架構與原理
steps.objective: 針對「設備邊界」建立有邊界、可反駁的系統模型。
steps.objectiveEn: For equipment boundaries, construct a bounded falsifiable system model.
steps.instruction: 觀看師傅的功能示意後，以「設備邊界」為中心標出輸入、輸出、信任或資源邊界，並在學徒工作台排列資料流或元件。原理是：OLT 與 ONT 擁有不同的發送及接收責任。 使用自行編寫的兩組小型資料或試算表，建立基準與一次只改一項的對照：改單一 ONT 光功率，觀察突發動態範圍。 先寫出可被反駁的預測；把「光模組規格」視為相鄰問題，說明它如何影響模型而不能混同。數值只採本課假想算例或自訂並列明單位；本步保存架構圖、假設表與預測。
steps.instructionEn: After the mentor functional diagram, mark inputs, outputs and trust/resource boundaries around equipment boundaries, then arrange components or data flows in the apprentice workspace. Principle: OLTs and ONTs have different transmission/reception responsibilities. Create two small authored datasets or spreadsheet cases: a baseline and a one-variable change. Vary one ONT power and observe burst dynamic range. Predict a falsifiable outcome before evaluating it. Treat optics specifications as a neighboring issue and explain its influence without conflating them. Use only the stated hypothetical case or declared assumed inputs/units. Save the architecture, assumptions and prediction.
steps.observation: 改單一 ONT 光功率，觀察突發動態範圍。 比較「設備邊界」與「光模組規格」的證據是否支持相同推論。
steps.observationEn: Vary one ONT power and observe burst dynamic range. Compare whether evidence for equipment boundaries and optics specifications supports the same inference.
steps.failure: PON 接收端只需處理連續同功率資料。 這是本課要排除的誤判；先核對模型邊界、來源版本及缺失證據。
steps.failureEn: PON receivers only handle continuous constant-power data. This is a misconception to reject; check boundaries, source versions and missing evidence.
steps.check: 提交「設備邊界」的功能草圖、基準／擾動表、單位或欄位定義、可反駁預測及接受／保留理由。需能重算本課假想例，並說明相鄰機制不可取代的驗證。
steps.checkEn: Submit a functional sketch, baseline/perturbation table, unit/field definitions, falsifiable prediction and accept/hold rationale for equipment boundaries. Recompute the course case and explain verification that the neighboring mechanism cannot replace.

knowledge.title: 原理、架構與適用邊界
knowledge.text: OLT 與 ONT 擁有不同的發送及接收責任。
knowledge.textEn: OLTs and ONTs have different transmission/reception responsibilities.

knowledge.title: 相鄰機制與不可混同處
knowledge.text: 相鄰的「光模組規格」：波段、功率級及接收範圍要一同匹配。 必須另列其證據，不能把這項機制的通過當作「設備邊界」已通過。
knowledge.textEn: Neighboring optics specifications: Match wavelength, power class and receiving range together. Record its evidence separately; its success does not prove equipment boundaries passes.

knowledge.title: 受控對照與證據品質
knowledge.text: 改單一 ONT 光功率，觀察突發動態範圍。 只變一個條件，保留相同資料格式、時間範圍及分母；模型估計與實測證據要分別標記。
knowledge.textEn: Vary one ONT power and observe burst dynamic range. Change one condition and retain comparable formats, intervals and denominators; label estimates separately from measured evidence.

knowledge.title: 可重算的原創假想例
knowledge.text: 假設 10 Gbit/s 毛速率只有 85% 可給 payload，32 住戶均分理想值為 10×0.85/32=0.265625 Gbit/s；這不是產品額定或公平演算法保證。
knowledge.textEn: With assumed 85% payload efficiency on 10 Gbit/s gross rate, equal sharing by 32 homes gives 0.265625 Gbit/s each; this is not a device rating or scheduler guarantee.

PON receivers only handle continuous constant-power data.
Checking optics specifications alone replaces verification specific to equipment boundaries.

steps.objective: 針對「載波回復」完成含競爭原因及不確定度的驗收紀錄。
steps.objectiveEn: For carrier recovery, complete acceptance evidence with competing causes and uncertainty.
steps.instruction: 重播本單元示意，讀取自製的基準與擾動紀錄，不接觸未授權目標。對照「相位雜訊與頻率偏差要求不同回復機制。」，執行下列紙上或本地合成資料試驗：固定纖長，只改色散模型參數。 分開記錄預測、觀察與不確定度，再提出至少兩個可能原因；利用「時鐘回復」的獨立證據排除一個原因。若結果只來自模型，標記為模擬，不能當作真實設備量測。最後說明目前應接受、保留或拒絕哪一項要求，並保存可重算資料。
steps.instructionEn: Replay the unit diagram and inspect your authored baseline/perturbed records without accessing unauthorized targets. Evaluate the principle: Phase noise and frequency offset need distinct recovery treatment. Conduct this paper or local synthetic-data experiment: Fix distance and vary dispersion-model parameters. Record prediction, observation and uncertainty separately, propose two competing causes and use independent evidence from timing recovery to exclude one. Model outputs must remain labeled simulation, not physical measurements. Explain which requirement to accept, hold or reject and retain recomputable records.
steps.observation: 固定纖長，只改色散模型參數。 比較「載波回復」與「時鐘回復」的證據是否支持相同推論。
steps.observationEn: Fix distance and vary dispersion-model parameters. Compare whether evidence for carrier recovery and timing recovery supports the same inference.
steps.failure: 提高調變階數一定提高每條實際光路容量。 這是本課要排除的誤判；先核對模型邊界、來源版本及缺失證據。
steps.failureEn: Higher modulation order always raises actual path capacity. This is a misconception to reject; check boundaries, source versions and missing evidence.
steps.check: 提交「載波回復」的功能草圖、基準／擾動表、單位或欄位定義、可反駁預測及接受／保留理由。需能重算本課假想例，並說明相鄰機制不可取代的驗證。
steps.checkEn: Submit a functional sketch, baseline/perturbation table, unit/field definitions, falsifiable prediction and accept/hold rationale for carrier recovery. Recompute the course case and explain verification that the neighboring mechanism cannot replace.

knowledge.title: 原理、架構與適用邊界
knowledge.text: 相位雜訊與頻率偏差要求不同回復機制。
knowledge.textEn: Phase noise and frequency offset need distinct recovery treatment.

knowledge.title: 相鄰機制與不可混同處
knowledge.text: 相鄰的「時鐘回復」：錯誤取樣時刻會擾動星座與等化。 必須另列其證據，不能把這項機制的通過當作「載波回復」已通過。
knowledge.textEn: Neighboring timing recovery: Wrong sampling instants disturb constellations and equalization. Record its evidence separately; its success does not prove carrier recovery passes.

knowledge.title: 受控對照與證據品質
knowledge.text: 固定纖長，只改色散模型參數。 只變一個條件，保留相同資料格式、時間範圍及分母；模型估計與實測證據要分別標記。
knowledge.textEn: Fix distance and vary dispersion-model parameters. Change one condition and retain comparable formats, intervals and denominators; label estimates separately from measured evidence.

knowledge.title: 可重算的原創假想例
knowledge.text: 假設 32 GBd、DP-QPSK 共 4 bit/符號，毛速率 128 Gbit/s；20% 以毛速率為分母的開銷後 payload 為 102.4 Gbit/s。忽略成形與實際 FEC。
knowledge.textEn: At assumed 32 GBd and DP-QPSK carrying four bits/symbol, gross rate=128 Gbit/s; overhead equal to 20% of gross leaves 102.4 Gbit/s, ignoring shaping and actual FEC.

quiz.question: 針對「載波回復」的原理與可觀測性，哪項最直接成立？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement most directly explains the principle/observability of carrier recovery?
options: 提高調變階數一定提高每條實際光路容量。
相位雜訊與頻率偏差要求不同回復機制。
只檢查「時鐘回復」，便可取代「載波回復」的專屬驗證。
optionsEn: Higher modulation order always raises actual path capacity.
Phase noise and frequency offset need distinct recovery treatment.
Checking timing recovery alone replaces verification specific to carrier recovery.
quiz.explanation: 相位雜訊與頻率偏差要求不同回復機制。 相鄰的「時鐘回復」有不同責任：錯誤取樣時刻會擾動星座與等化。因此不能用該項通過或課內誤判取代本單元證據。
quiz.explanationEn: Phase noise and frequency offset need distinct recovery treatment. Neighboring timing recovery has a different role: Wrong sampling instants disturb constellations and equalization. Its success or the stated misconception cannot replace unit-specific evidence.

stages.title: 驗證、故障與防禦邊界
stages.description: 四個領域技術單元各完成原理建模與對照證據，共八項可個別保存的作業。
stages.descriptionEn: Four domain units each pair principle modeling with controlled evidence, producing eight separately saved tasks.

steps.title: 時鐘回復：架構與原理
steps.objective: 針對「時鐘回復」建立有邊界、可反駁的系統模型。
steps.objectiveEn: For timing recovery, construct a bounded falsifiable system model.
steps.instruction: 觀看師傅的功能示意後，以「時鐘回復」為中心標出輸入、輸出、信任或資源邊界，並在學徒工作台排列資料流或元件。原理是：錯誤取樣時刻會擾動星座與等化。 使用自行編寫的兩組小型資料或試算表，建立基準與一次只改一項的對照：比較不同雷射相位雜訊的假想星座。 先寫出可被反駁的預測；把「非線性代價」視為相鄰問題，說明它如何影響模型而不能混同。數值只採本課假想算例或自訂並列明單位；本步保存架構圖、假設表與預測。
steps.instructionEn: After the mentor functional diagram, mark inputs, outputs and trust/resource boundaries around timing recovery, then arrange components or data flows in the apprentice workspace. Principle: Wrong sampling instants disturb constellations and equalization. Create two small authored datasets or spreadsheet cases: a baseline and a one-variable change. Compare synthetic constellations at different laser phase-noise levels. Predict a falsifiable outcome before evaluating it. Treat nonlinear penalties as a neighboring issue and explain its influence without conflating them. Use only the stated hypothetical case or declared assumed inputs/units. Save the architecture, assumptions and prediction.
steps.observation: 比較不同雷射相位雜訊的假想星座。 比較「時鐘回復」與「非線性代價」的證據是否支持相同推論。
steps.observationEn: Compare synthetic constellations at different laser phase-noise levels. Compare whether evidence for timing recovery and nonlinear penalties supports the same inference.
steps.failure: 相干 DSP 可無限恢復任何低功率訊號。 這是本課要排除的誤判；先核對模型邊界、來源版本及缺失證據。
steps.failureEn: Coherent DSP can recover arbitrarily weak signals without limit. This is a misconception to reject; check boundaries, source versions and missing evidence.
steps.check: 提交「時鐘回復」的功能草圖、基準／擾動表、單位或欄位定義、可反駁預測及接受／保留理由。需能重算本課假想例，並說明相鄰機制不可取代的驗證。
steps.checkEn: Submit a functional sketch, baseline/perturbation table, unit/field definitions, falsifiable prediction and accept/hold rationale for timing recovery. Recompute the course case and explain verification that the neighboring mechanism cannot replace.

knowledge.text: 錯誤取樣時刻會擾動星座與等化。

knowledge.title: 相鄰機制與不可混同處
knowledge.text: 相鄰的「非線性代價」：增加發送功率也會增加非線性影響。 必須另列其證據，不能把這項機制的通過當作「時鐘回復」已通過。
knowledge.textEn: Neighboring nonlinear penalties: Higher launch power can also increase nonlinear impairment. Record its evidence separately; its success does not prove timing recovery passes.

knowledge.title: 受控對照與證據品質
knowledge.text: 比較不同雷射相位雜訊的假想星座。 只變一個條件，保留相同資料格式、時間範圍及分母；模型估計與實測證據要分別標記。

options: 增加發送功率也會增加非線性影響。
提高調變階數一定提高每條實際光路容量。
只檢查「調變取捨」，便可取代「非線性代價」的專屬驗證。
optionsEn: Higher launch power can also increase nonlinear impairment.
Higher modulation order always raises actual path capacity.
Checking modulation tradeoffs alone replaces verification specific to nonlinear penalties.
quiz.explanation: 增加發送功率也會增加非線性影響。 相鄰的「調變取捨」有不同責任：高階星座增加位元數亦提高品質要求。因此不能用該項通過或課內誤判取代本單元證據。
quiz.explanationEn: Higher launch power can also increase nonlinear impairment. Neighboring modulation tradeoffs has a different role: Higher-order constellations add bits and quality requirements. Its success or the stated misconception cannot replace unit-specific evidence.

steps.title: 調變取捨：架構與原理
steps.objective: 針對「調變取捨」建立有邊界、可反駁的系統模型。
steps.objectiveEn: For modulation tradeoffs, construct a bounded falsifiable system model.
steps.instruction: 觀看師傅的功能示意後，以「調變取捨」為中心標出輸入、輸出、信任或資源邊界，並在學徒工作台排列資料流或元件。原理是：高階星座增加位元數亦提高品質要求。 使用自行編寫的兩組小型資料或試算表，建立基準與一次只改一項的對照：比較不同雷射相位雜訊的假想星座。 先寫出可被反駁的預測；把「FEC 與 payload」視為相鄰問題，說明它如何影響模型而不能混同。數值只採本課假想算例或自訂並列明單位；本步保存架構圖、假設表與預測。
steps.instructionEn: After the mentor functional diagram, mark inputs, outputs and trust/resource boundaries around modulation tradeoffs, then arrange components or data flows in the apprentice workspace. Principle: Higher-order constellations add bits and quality requirements. Create two small authored datasets or spreadsheet cases: a baseline and a one-variable change. Compare synthetic constellations at different laser phase-noise levels. Predict a falsifiable outcome before evaluating it. Treat fec and payload as a neighboring issue and explain its influence without conflating them. Use only the stated hypothetical case or declared assumed inputs/units. Save the architecture, assumptions and prediction.
steps.observation: 比較不同雷射相位雜訊的假想星座。 比較「調變取捨」與「FEC 與 payload」的證據是否支持相同推論。
steps.observationEn: Compare synthetic constellations at different laser phase-noise levels. Compare whether evidence for modulation tradeoffs and fec and payload supports the same inference.
steps.failure: 相干 DSP 可無限恢復任何低功率訊號。 這是本課要排除的誤判；先核對模型邊界、來源版本及缺失證據。
steps.failureEn: Coherent DSP can recover arbitrarily weak signals without limit. This is a misconception to reject; check boundaries, source versions and missing evidence.
steps.check: 提交「調變取捨」的功能草圖、基準／擾動表、單位或欄位定義、可反駁預測及接受／保留理由。需能重算本課假想例，並說明相鄰機制不可取代的驗證。
steps.checkEn: Submit a functional sketch, baseline/perturbation table, unit/field definitions, falsifiable prediction and accept/hold rationale for modulation tradeoffs. Recompute the course case and explain verification that the neighboring mechanism cannot replace.

knowledge.textEn: Neighboring fec and payload: Assess correction capability, overhead and net rate together. Record its evidence separately; its success does not prove modulation tradeoffs passes.

knowledge.title: 受控對照與證據品質
knowledge.text: 比較不同雷射相位雜訊的假想星座。 只變一個條件，保留相同資料格式、時間範圍及分母；模型估計與實測證據要分別標記。

Save the architecture, assumptions and prediction.

steps.instruction: 觀看師傅的功能示意後，以「通道功率」為中心標出輸入、輸出、信任或資源邊界，並在學徒工作台排列資料流或元件。原理是：通道功率分配與總放大器限制須一起考慮。 使用自行編寫的兩組小型資料或試算表，建立基準與一次只改一項的對照：只改 span 長度，觀察段數與雜訊取捨。 先寫出可被反駁的預測；把「非線性累積」視為相鄰問題，說明它如何影響模型而不能混同。數值只採本課假想算例或自訂並列明單位；本步保存架構圖、假設表與預測。
steps.instructionEn: After the mentor functional diagram, mark inputs, outputs and trust/resource boundaries around channel powers, then arrange components or data flows in the apprentice workspace. Principle: Channel power allocation must respect total amplifier constraints. Create two small authored datasets or spreadsheet cases: a baseline and a one-variable change. Vary span length and compare span-count/noise tradeoffs. Predict a falsifiable outcome before evaluating it. Treat nonlinear accumulation as a neighboring issue and explain its influence without conflating them. Use only the stated hypothetical case or declared assumed inputs/units. Save the architecture, assumptions and prediction.
steps.observation: 只改 span 長度，觀察段數與雜訊取捨。 比較「通道功率」與「非線性累積」的證據是否支持相同推論。
steps.observationEn: Vary span length and compare span-count/noise tradeoffs. Compare whether evidence for channel powers and nonlinear accumulation supports the same inference.
steps.failure: 兩條海纜名稱不同便沒有共同故障域。 這是本課要排除的誤判；先核對模型邊界、來源版本及缺失證據。
steps.failureEn: Different cable names imply no common failure domains. This is a misconception to reject; check boundaries, source versions and missing evidence.
steps.check: 提交「通道功率」的功能草圖、基準／擾動表、單位或欄位定義、可反駁預測及接受／保留理由。需能重算本課假想例，並說明相鄰機制不可取代的驗證。
steps.checkEn: Submit a functional sketch, baseline/perturbation table, unit/field definitions, falsifiable prediction and accept/hold rationale for channel powers. Recompute the course case and explain verification that the neighboring mechanism cannot replace.

knowledge.title: 受控對照與證據品質

steps.title: 岸站交接：架構與原理
steps.objective: 針對「岸站交接」建立有邊界、可反駁的系統模型。

knowledge.title: 可重算的原創假想例

scope: 公開原理的離線／本地合成資料工程教育。只使用自行生成資料或明確獲授權的測試環境；不提供真實目標掃描、漏洞利用、惡意程式、車輛／工控注入或實際射頻發射程序。數值為原創假設，非供應商保證或現場驗收標準。

workedExample.assumptionsEn: Use only the stated teaching assumptions; recalculate for topology, distribution, overhead, versions and uncertainty.

title: 衛星地面站通訊鏈路

steps.title: 接收 G/T：架構與原理

steps.instruction: 觀看師傅的功能示意後，以「編碼與調變」為中心標出輸入、輸出、信任或資源邊界，並在學徒工作台排列資料流或元件。原理是：碼率與調變共同影響 payload 及 Eb/N0 需求。 使用自行編寫的兩組小型資料或試算表，建立基準與一次只改一項的對照：比較不同仰角的假想遮蔽與大氣損失。 先寫出可被反駁的預測；把「大氣損失」視為相鄰問題，說明它如何影響模型而不能混同。數值只採本課假想算例或自訂並列明單位；本步保存架構圖、假設表與預測。
steps.instructionEn: After the mentor functional diagram, mark inputs, outputs and trust/resource boundaries around coding and modulation, then arrange components or data flows in the apprentice workspace. Principle: Code rate and modulation jointly affect payload and Eb/N0 requirements. Create two small authored datasets or spreadsheet cases: a baseline and a one-variable change. Compare synthetic blockage/atmospheric loss at different elevations. Predict a falsifiable outcome before evaluating it. Treat atmospheric loss as a neighboring issue and explain its influence without conflating them. Use only the stated hypothetical case or declared assumed inputs/units. Save the architecture, assumptions and prediction.
steps.observation: 比較不同仰角的假想遮蔽與大氣損失。 比較「編碼與調變」與「大氣損失」的證據是否支持相同推論。
steps.observationEn: Compare synthetic blockage/atmospheric loss at different elevations. Compare whether evidence for coding and modulation and atmospheric loss supports the same inference.
steps.failure: 自由空間損失只取決於頻率，與距離無關。 這是本課要排除的誤判；先核對模型邊界、來源版本及缺失證據。

options: 自由空間損失只取決於頻率，與距離無關。
可見時段不等於全段都能使用最大速率。
只檢查「緩存容量」，便可取代「接觸排程」的專屬驗證。
optionsEn: Free-space loss depends only on frequency, not distance.
Visibility does not imply maximum rate throughout a contact.
Checking buffer capacity alone replaces verification specific to contact schedules.
quiz.explanation: 可見時段不等於全段都能使用最大速率。 相鄰的「緩存容量」有不同責任：窗口外產生資料需足夠緩存或明確丟棄策略。因此不能用該項通過或課內誤判取代本單元證據。
quiz.explanationEn: Visibility does not imply maximum rate throughout a contact. Neighboring buffer capacity has a different role: Out-of-contact data needs enough buffering or a defined discard policy. Its success or the stated misconception cannot replace unit-specific evidence.

steps.title: 接觸排程：對照試驗與證據
steps.titleEn: Contact schedules: controlled experiment and evidence
steps.objective: 針對「接觸排程」完成含競爭原因及不確定度的驗收紀錄。
steps.objectiveEn: For contact schedules, complete acceptance evidence with competing causes and uncertainty.
steps.instruction: 重播本單元示意，讀取自製的基準與擾動紀錄，不接觸未授權目標。對照「可見時段不等於全段都能使用最大速率。」，執行下列紙上或本地合成資料試驗：比較不同仰角的假想遮蔽與大氣損失。 分開記錄預測、觀察與不確定度，再提出至少兩個可能原因；利用「緩存容量」的獨立證據排除一個原因。若結果只來自模型，標記為模擬，不能當作真實設備量測。最後說明目前應接受、保留或拒絕哪一項要求，並保存可重算資料。
steps.instructionEn: Replay the unit diagram and inspect your authored baseline/perturbed records without accessing unauthorized targets. Evaluate the principle: Visibility does not imply maximum rate throughout a contact. Conduct this paper or local synthetic-data experiment: Compare synthetic blockage/atmospheric loss at different elevations. Record prediction, observation and uncertainty separately, propose two competing causes and use independent evidence from buffer capacity to exclude one. Model outputs must remain labeled simulation, not physical measurements. Explain which requirement to accept, hold or reject and retain recomputable records.
steps.observation: 比較不同仰角的假想遮蔽與大氣損失。 比較「接觸排程」與「緩存容量」的證據是否支持相同推論。
steps.observationEn: Compare synthetic blockage/atmospheric loss at different elevations. Compare whether evidence for contact schedules and buffer capacity supports the same inference.
steps.failure: 自由空間損失只取決於頻率，與距離無關。 這是本課要排除的誤判；先核對模型邊界、來源版本及缺失證據。
steps.failureEn: Free-space loss depends only on frequency, not distance. This is a misconception to reject; check boundaries, source versions and missing evidence.
steps.check: 提交「接觸排程」的功能草圖、基準／擾動表、單位或欄位定義、可反駁預測及接受／保留理由。需能重算本課假想例，並說明相鄰機制不可取代的驗證。
steps.checkEn: Submit a functional sketch, baseline/perturbation table, unit/field definitions, falsifiable prediction and accept/hold rationale for contact schedules. Recompute the course case and explain verification that the neighboring mechanism cannot replace.

steps.title: 緩存容量：架構與原理
steps.objective: 針對「緩存容量」建立有邊界、可反駁的系統模型。
steps.objectiveEn: For buffer capacity, construct a bounded falsifiable system model.

Treat ground network as a neighboring issue and explain its influence without conflating them. Use only the stated hypothetical case or declared assumed inputs/units. Save the architecture, assumptions and prediction.

steps.failure: 天線增益足夠就不需追蹤都卜勒。 這是本課要排除的誤判；先核對模型邊界、來源版本及缺失證據。
steps.failureEn: Sufficient antenna gain eliminates Doppler tracking needs. This is a misconception to reject; check boundaries, source versions and missing evidence.
steps.check: 提交「緩存容量」的功能草圖、基準／擾動表、單位或欄位定義、可反駁預測及接受／保留理由。需能重算本課假想例，並說明相鄰機制不可取代的驗證。

title: 低軌衛星網路路由
summary: 以時變拓撲、交遞與星間路由串連 16 個領域技術單元、32 個保存步驟；分析架構、原理、介面、故障、量化案例與防禦證據。
summaryEn: Sixteen domain-specific technical units and 32 saved steps connect time-varying topology, handover and intersatellite routing through architecture, principles, interfaces, faults, quantitative cases and defensive evidence.

stages.title: 需求、元件與基本模型
stages.description: 四個領域技術單元各完成原理建模與對照證據，共八項可個別保存的作業。
stages.descriptionEn: Four domain units each pair principle modeling with controlled evidence, producing eight separately saved tasks.

steps.title: 星座圖：架構與原理
steps.objective: 針對「星座圖」建立有邊界、可反駁的系統模型。
steps.objectiveEn: For constellation graph, construct a bounded falsifiable system model.
steps.instruction: 觀看師傅的功能示意後，以「星座圖」為中心標出輸入、輸出、信任或資源邊界，並在學徒工作台排列資料流或元件。原理是：節點位置與鏈路可用性都隨時間變化。 使用自行編寫的兩組小型資料或試算表，建立基準與一次只改一項的對照：保留星座，只改路徑代價權重。 先寫出可被反駁的預測；把「星間與地面邊」視為相鄰問題，說明它如何影響模型而不能混同。數值只採本課假想算例或自訂並列明單位；本步保存架構圖、假設表與預測。
steps.instructionEn: After the mentor functional diagram, mark inputs, outputs and trust/resource boundaries around constellation graph, then arrange components or data flows in the apprentice workspace. Principle: Node positions and link availability both vary over time. Create two small authored datasets or spreadsheet cases: a baseline and a one-variable change. Fix constellation and change routing-cost weights. Predict a falsifiable outcome before evaluating it. Treat space and ground edges as a neighboring issue and explain its influence without conflating them. Use only the stated hypothetical case or declared assumed inputs/units. Save the architecture, assumptions and prediction.
steps.observation: 保留星座，只改路徑代價權重。 比較「星座圖」與「星間與地面邊」的證據是否支持相同推論。
steps.observationEn: Fix constellation and change routing-cost weights. Compare whether evidence for constellation graph and space and ground edges supports the same inference.
steps.failure: 最少跳數必然是最小延遲路徑。 這是本課要排除的誤判；先核對模型邊界、來源版本及缺失證據。
steps.failureEn: Fewest hops necessarily means minimum latency. This is a misconception to reject; check boundaries, source versions and missing evidence.

steps.instruction: 觀看師傅的功能示意後，以「負載分配」為中心標出輸入、輸出、信任或資源邊界，並在學徒工作台排列資料流或元件。原理是：最短路徑集中可能產生排隊壅塞。 使用自行編寫的兩組小型資料或試算表，建立基準與一次只改一項的對照：固定負載，只移除單一星間邊。 先寫出可被反駁的預測；把「分散狀態」視為相鄰問題，說明它如何影響模型而不能混同。數值只採本課假想算例或自訂並列明單位；本步保存架構圖、假設表與預測。
steps.instructionEn: After the mentor functional diagram, mark inputs, outputs and trust/resource boundaries around load distribution, then arrange components or data flows in the apprentice workspace. Principle: Shortest-path concentration can create queuing congestion. Create two small authored datasets or spreadsheet cases: a baseline and a one-variable change. Fix load and remove one intersatellite edge. Predict a falsifiable outcome before evaluating it. Treat distributed state as a neighboring issue and explain its influence without conflating them. Use only the stated hypothetical case or declared assumed inputs/units. Save the architecture, assumptions and prediction.
steps.observation: 固定負載，只移除單一星間邊。 比較「負載分配」與「分散狀態」的證據是否支持相同推論。
steps.observationEn: Fix load and remove one intersatellite edge. Compare whether evidence for load distribution and distributed state supports the same inference.
steps.failure: 最少跳數必然是最小延遲路徑。 這是本課要排除的誤判；先核對模型邊界、來源版本及缺失證據。
steps.failureEn: Fewest hops necessarily means minimum latency. This is a misconception to reject; check boundaries, source versions and missing evidence.
steps.check: 提交「負載分配」的功能草圖、基準／擾動表、單位或欄位定義、可反駁預測及接受／保留理由。需能重算本課假想例，並說明相鄰機制不可取代的驗證。
steps.checkEn: Submit a functional sketch, baseline/perturbation table, unit/field definitions, falsifiable prediction and accept/hold rationale for load distribution. Recompute the course case and explain verification that the neighboring mechanism cannot replace.

knowledge.title: 相鄰機制與不可混同處
knowledge.text: 相鄰的「分散狀態」：過時拓撲資訊可能選到已消失的鏈路。 必須另列其證據，不能把這項機制的通過當作「負載分配」已通過。

knowledge.title: 受控對照與證據品質

最少跳數必然是最小延遲路徑。
只檢查「分散狀態」，便可取代「負載分配」的專屬驗證。

Fewest hops necessarily means minimum latency.
Checking distributed state alone replaces verification specific to load distribution.

title: 深空延遲容忍網路
summary: 以儲存攜帶轉送、接觸計畫與資料壽命串連 16 個領域技術單元、32 個保存步驟；分析架構、原理、介面、故障、量化案例與防禦證據。
summaryEn: Sixteen domain-specific technical units and 32 saved steps connect store-carry-forward, contact plans and data lifetime through architecture, principles, interfaces, faults, quantitative cases and defensive evidence.

stages.title: 需求、元件與基本模型
stages.description: 四個領域技術單元各完成原理建模與對照證據，共八項可個別保存的作業。
stages.descriptionEn: Four domain units each pair principle modeling with controlled evidence, producing eight separately saved tasks.

steps.title: DTN 覆疊層：架構與原理
steps.objective: 針對「DTN 覆疊層」建立有邊界、可反駁的系統模型。
steps.objectiveEn: For dtn overlay, construct a bounded falsifiable system model.
steps.instruction: 觀看師傅的功能示意後，以「DTN 覆疊層」為中心標出輸入、輸出、信任或資源邊界，並在學徒工作台排列資料流或元件。原理是：DTN 跨連續與間歇網路建立儲存轉送服務。 使用自行編寫的兩組小型資料或試算表，建立基準與一次只改一項的對照：保留生成率，只改接觸時長。 先寫出可被反駁的預測；把「Bundle 結構」視為相鄰問題，說明它如何影響模型而不能混同。數值只採本課假想算例或自訂並列明單位；本步保存架構圖、假設表與預測。
steps.instructionEn: After the mentor functional diagram, mark inputs, outputs and trust/resource boundaries around dtn overlay, then arrange components or data flows in the apprentice workspace. Principle: DTN overlays continuous/intermittent networks with store-and-forward service. Create two small authored datasets or spreadsheet cases: a baseline and a one-variable change. Fix generation rate and vary contact duration. Predict a falsifiable outcome before evaluating it. Treat bundle structure as a neighboring issue and explain its influence without conflating them. Use only the stated hypothetical case or declared assumed inputs/units. Save the architecture, assumptions and prediction.
steps.observation: 保留生成率，只改接觸時長。 比較「DTN 覆疊層」與「Bundle 結構」的證據是否支持相同推論。
steps.observationEn: Fix generation rate and vary contact duration. Compare whether evidence for dtn overlay and bundle structure supports the same inference.
steps.failure: Bundle Protocol 7 必定提供傳統 custody transfer。 這是本課要排除的誤判；先核對模型邊界、來源版本及缺失證據。
steps.failureEn: Bundle Protocol 7 necessarily provides traditional custody transfer. This is a misconception to reject; check boundaries, source versions and missing evidence.
steps.check: 提交「DTN 覆疊層」的功能草圖、基準／擾動表、單位或欄位定義、可反駁預測及接受／保留理由。需能重算本課假想例，並說明相鄰機制不可取代的驗證。
steps.checkEn: Submit a functional sketch, baseline/perturbation table, unit/field definitions, falsifiable prediction and accept/hold rationale for dtn overlay. Recompute the course case and explain verification that the neighboring mechanism cannot replace.

options: DTN 每一跳都必須與源端同時在線。
bundle 結合資料及跨延遲處理所需 metadata。
只檢查「端點識別」，便可取代「Bundle 結構」的專屬驗證。

Bundles combine data with metadata needed across delayed handling.
Checking endpoint identifiers alone replaces verification specific to bundle structure.

quiz.explanationEn: Bundles combine data with metadata needed across delayed handling. Neighboring endpoint identifiers has a different role: DTN endpoint identifiers need not map one-to-one to current IP addresses. Its success or the stated misconception cannot replace unit-specific evidence.

steps.title: 端點識別：架構與原理

steps.checkEn: Submit a functional sketch, baseline/perturbation table, unit/field definitions, falsifiable prediction and accept/hold rationale for endpoint identifiers. Recompute the course case and explain verification that the neighboring mechanism cannot replace.

options: Bundle Protocol 7 必定提供傳統 custody transfer。
轉送前保留資料需要掉電與容量假設。
只檢查「接觸計畫」，便可取代「持久儲存」的專屬驗證。
optionsEn: Bundle Protocol 7 necessarily provides traditional custody transfer.
Retaining data before forwarding needs power-loss and capacity assumptions.
Checking contact plans alone replaces verification specific to persistent storage.
quiz.explanation: 轉送前保留資料需要掉電與容量假設。 相鄰的「接觸計畫」有不同責任：窗口的開始、結束與速率限制可搬資料量。因此不能用該項通過或課內誤判取代本單元證據。
quiz.explanationEn: Retaining data before forwarding needs power-loss and capacity assumptions. Neighboring contact plans has a different role: Window start, end and rate bound transferable volume. Its success or the stated misconception cannot replace unit-specific evidence.

steps.title: 持久儲存：對照試驗與證據
steps.titleEn: Persistent storage: controlled experiment and evidence
steps.objective: 針對「持久儲存」完成含競爭原因及不確定度的驗收紀錄。
steps.objectiveEn: For persistent storage, complete acceptance evidence with competing causes and uncertainty.
steps.instruction: 重播本單元示意，讀取自製的基準與擾動紀錄，不接觸未授權目標。對照「轉送前保留資料需要掉電與容量假設。」，執行下列紙上或本地合成資料試驗：比較資料到期時間短於與長於無接觸間隔。 分開記錄預測、觀察與不確定度，再提出至少兩個可能原因；利用「接觸計畫」的獨立證據排除一個原因。若結果只來自模型，標記為模擬，不能當作真實設備量測。最後說明目前應接受、保留或拒絕哪一項要求，並保存可重算資料。
steps.instructionEn: Replay the unit diagram and inspect your authored baseline/perturbed records without accessing unauthorized targets. Evaluate the principle: Retaining data before forwarding needs power-loss and capacity assumptions. Conduct this paper or local synthetic-data experiment: Compare lifetimes shorter/longer than contact gaps. Record prediction, observation and uncertainty separately, propose two competing causes and use independent evidence from contact plans to exclude one. Model outputs must remain labeled simulation, not physical measurements. Explain which requirement to accept, hold or reject and retain recomputable records.
steps.observation: 比較資料到期時間短於與長於無接觸間隔。 比較「持久儲存」與「接觸計畫」的證據是否支持相同推論。
steps.observationEn: Compare lifetimes shorter/longer than contact gaps. Compare whether evidence for persistent storage and contact plans supports the same inference.
steps.failure: Bundle Protocol 7 必定提供傳統 custody transfer。 這是本課要排除的誤判；先核對模型邊界、來源版本及缺失證據。
steps.failureEn: Bundle Protocol 7 necessarily provides traditional custody transfer. This is a misconception to reject; check boundaries, source versions and missing evidence.
steps.check: 提交「持久儲存」的功能草圖、基準／擾動表、單位或欄位定義、可反駁預測及接受／保留理由。需能重算本課假想例，並說明相鄰機制不可取代的驗證。
steps.checkEn: Submit a functional sketch, baseline/perturbation table, unit/field definitions, falsifiable prediction and accept/hold rationale for persistent storage. Recompute the course case and explain verification that the neighboring mechanism cannot replace.

knowledge.textEn: Compare lifetimes shorter/longer than contact gaps. Change one condition and retain comparable formats, intervals and denominators; label estimates separately from measured evidence.

steps.title: 接觸計畫：架構與原理
steps.objective: 針對「接觸計畫」建立有邊界、可反駁的系統模型。
steps.objectiveEn: For contact plans, construct a bounded falsifiable system model.
steps.instruction: 觀看師傅的功能示意後，以「接觸計畫」為中心標出輸入、輸出、信任或資源邊界，並在學徒工作台排列資料流或元件。原理是：窗口的開始、結束與速率限制可搬資料量。 使用自行編寫的兩組小型資料或試算表，建立基準與一次只改一項的對照：比較資料到期時間短於與長於無接觸間隔。 先寫出可被反駁的預測；把「資料壽命」視為相鄰問題，說明它如何影響模型而不能混同。數值只採本課假想算例或自訂並列明單位；本步保存架構圖、假設表與預測。
steps.instructionEn: After the mentor functional diagram, mark inputs, outputs and trust/resource boundaries around contact plans, then arrange components or data flows in the apprentice workspace. Principle: Window start, end and rate bound transferable volume. Create two small authored datasets or spreadsheet cases: a baseline and a one-variable change. Compare lifetimes shorter/longer than contact gaps. Predict a falsifiable outcome before evaluating it. Treat data lifetime as a neighboring issue and explain its influence without conflating them. Use only the stated hypothetical case or declared assumed inputs/units. Save the architecture, assumptions and prediction.
steps.observation: 比較資料到期時間短於與長於無接觸間隔。 比較「接觸計畫」與「資料壽命」的證據是否支持相同推論。
steps.observationEn: Compare lifetimes shorter/longer than contact gaps. Compare whether evidence for contact plans and data lifetime supports the same inference.
steps.failure: DTN 每一跳都必須與源端同時在線。 這是本課要排除的誤判；先核對模型邊界、來源版本及缺失證據。
steps.failureEn: Every DTN hop must be online simultaneously with the source. This is a misconception to reject; check boundaries, source versions and missing evidence.
steps.check: 提交「接觸計畫」的功能草圖、基準／擾動表、單位或欄位定義、可反駁預測及接受／保留理由。需能重算本課假想例，並說明相鄰機制不可取代的驗證。

knowledge.textEn: Neighboring store-carry behavior: Nodes can wait for future contacts without a simultaneous full path. Record its evidence separately; its success does not prove data lifetime passes.

knowledge.title: 受控對照與證據品質
knowledge.text: 比較資料到期時間短於與長於無接觸間隔。 只變一個條件，保留相同資料格式、時間範圍及分母；模型估計與實測證據要分別標記。
knowledge.textEn: Compare lifetimes shorter/longer than contact gaps. Change one condition and retain comparable formats, intervals and denominators; label estimates separately from measured evidence.

quiz.question: 針對「資料壽命」的原理與可觀測性，哪項最直接成立？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement most directly explains the principle/observability of data lifetime?
options: 到期後的資料不能僅因仍有儲存便視為有效。
Bundle Protocol 7 必定提供傳統 custody transfer。
只檢查「儲存攜帶」，便可取代「資料壽命」的專屬驗證。
optionsEn: Stored data is not valid merely because it remains after expiry.
Bundle Protocol 7 necessarily provides traditional custody transfer.
Checking store-carry behavior alone replaces verification specific to data lifetime.
quiz.explanation: 到期後的資料不能僅因仍有儲存便視為有效。 相鄰的「儲存攜帶」有不同責任：節點可等待未來接觸，不需全路徑同時存在。因此不能用該項通過或課內誤判取代本單元證據。
quiz.explanationEn: Stored data is not valid merely because it remains after expiry. Neighboring store-carry behavior has a different role: Nodes can wait for future contacts without a simultaneous full path. Its success or the stated misconception cannot replace unit-specific evidence.

steps.title: 儲存攜帶：架構與原理
steps.objective: 針對「儲存攜帶」建立有邊界、可反駁的系統模型。
steps.objectiveEn: For store-carry behavior, construct a bounded falsifiable system model.
steps.instruction: 觀看師傅的功能示意後，以「儲存攜帶」為中心標出輸入、輸出、信任或資源邊界，並在學徒工作台排列資料流或元件。原理是：節點可等待未來接觸，不需全路徑同時存在。 使用自行編寫的兩組小型資料或試算表，建立基準與一次只改一項的對照：比較資料到期時間短於與長於無接觸間隔。 先寫出可被反駁的預測；把「分片與重組」視為相鄰問題，說明它如何影響模型而不能混同。數值只採本課假想算例或自訂並列明單位；本步保存架構圖、假設表與預測。
steps.instructionEn: After the mentor functional diagram, mark inputs, outputs and trust/resource boundaries around store-carry behavior, then arrange components or data flows in the apprentice workspace. Principle: Nodes can wait for future contacts without a simultaneous full path. Create two small authored datasets or spreadsheet cases: a baseline and a one-variable change. Compare lifetimes shorter/longer than contact gaps. Predict a falsifiable outcome before evaluating it. Treat fragmentation/reassembly as a neighboring issue and explain its influence without conflating them. Use only the stated hypothetical case or declared assumed inputs/units. Save the architecture, assumptions and prediction.
steps.observation: 比較資料到期時間短於與長於無接觸間隔。 比較「儲存攜帶」與「分片與重組」的證據是否支持相同推論。
steps.observationEn: Compare lifetimes shorter/longer than contact gaps. Compare whether evidence for store-carry behavior and fragmentation/reassembly supports the same inference.
steps.failure: DTN 每一跳都必須與源端同時在線。 這是本課要排除的誤判；先核對模型邊界、來源版本及缺失證據。
steps.failureEn: Every DTN hop must be online simultaneously with the source. This is a misconception to reject; check boundaries, source versions and missing evidence.
steps.check: 提交「儲存攜帶」的功能草圖、基準／擾動表、單位或欄位定義、可反駁預測及接受／保留理由。需能重算本課假想例，並說明相鄰機制不可取代的驗證。
steps.checkEn: Submit a functional sketch, baseline/perturbation table, unit/field definitions, falsifiable prediction and accept/hold rationale for store-carry behavior. Recompute the course case and explain verification that the neighboring mechanism cannot replace.

knowledge.title: 可重算的原創假想例
knowledge.text: 假設 4 Mbit/s 接觸 600 s，可搬 2.4 Gbit=300 MB（十進位）；若每天產生 500 MB，且僅有一次接觸，至少累積 200 MB/日，未計開銷。

steps.objective: 針對「儲存攜帶」完成含競爭原因及不確定度的驗收紀錄。
steps.objectiveEn: For store-carry behavior, complete acceptance evidence with competing causes and uncertainty.
steps.instruction: 重播本單元示意，讀取自製的基準與擾動紀錄，不接觸未授權目標。對照「節點可等待未來接觸，不需全路徑同時存在。」，執行下列紙上或本地合成資料試驗：比較資料到期時間短於與長於無接觸間隔。 分開記錄預測、觀察與不確定度，再提出至少兩個可能原因；利用「分片與重組」的獨立證據排除一個原因。若結果只來自模型，標記為模擬，不能當作真實設備量測。最後說明目前應接受、保留或拒絕哪一項要求，並保存可重算資料。

steps.failureEn: Every DTN hop must be online simultaneously with the source. This is a misconception to reject; check boundaries, source versions and missing evidence.
steps.check: 提交「儲存攜帶」的功能草圖、基準／擾動表、單位或欄位定義、可反駁預測及接受／保留理由。需能重算本課假想例，並說明相鄰機制不可取代的驗證。

steps.instruction: 觀看師傅的功能示意後，以「重複與重試」為中心標出輸入、輸出、信任或資源邊界，並在學徒工作台排列資料流或元件。原理是：重傳可能產生重複，應用要定義冪等處理。 使用自行編寫的兩組小型資料或試算表，建立基準與一次只改一項的對照：固定接觸表，只改緩存上限。 先寫出可被反駁的預測；把「路由責任」視為相鄰問題，說明它如何影響模型而不能混同。數值只採本課假想算例或自訂並列明單位；本步保存架構圖、假設表與預測。
