Save the architecture, assumptions and prediction.

steps.title: 時基限制：架構與原理

Save the architecture, assumptions and prediction.

stages.title: 需求、元件與基本模型
stages.description: 四個領域技術單元各完成原理建模與對照證據，共八項可個別保存的作業。
stages.descriptionEn: Four domain units each pair principle modeling with controlled evidence, producing eight separately saved tasks.

steps.title: 量子與古典資源：架構與原理
steps.objective: 針對「量子與古典資源」建立有邊界、可反駁的系統模型。
steps.objectiveEn: For quantum/classical resources, construct a bounded falsifiable system model.
steps.instruction: 觀看師傅的功能示意後，以「量子與古典資源」為中心標出輸入、輸出、信任或資源邊界，並在學徒工作台排列資料流或元件。原理是：量子狀態與古典控制資訊有不同複製限制。 使用自行編寫的兩組小型資料或試算表，建立基準與一次只改一項的對照：固定光源，只改單臂光損耗。 先寫出可被反駁的預測；把「不可複製原理」視為相鄰問題，說明它如何影響模型而不能混同。數值只採本課假想算例或自訂並列明單位；本步保存架構圖、假設表與預測。
steps.instructionEn: After the mentor functional diagram, mark inputs, outputs and trust/resource boundaries around quantum/classical resources, then arrange components or data flows in the apprentice workspace. Principle: Quantum states and classical control information have different copying constraints. Create two small authored datasets or spreadsheet cases: a baseline and a one-variable change. Fix source rate and vary one-arm loss. Predict a falsifiable outcome before evaluating it. Treat no-cloning principle as a neighboring issue and explain its influence without conflating them. Use only the stated hypothetical case or declared assumed inputs/units. Save the architecture, assumptions and prediction.
steps.observation: 固定光源，只改單臂光損耗。 比較「量子與古典資源」與「不可複製原理」的證據是否支持相同推論。
steps.observationEn: Fix source rate and vary one-arm loss. Compare whether evidence for quantum/classical resources and no-cloning principle supports the same inference.
steps.failure: 量子位元可像古典封包任意複製重送。 這是本課要排除的誤判；先核對模型邊界、來源版本及缺失證據。
steps.failureEn: Qubits can be freely copied and retransmitted like classical packets. This is a misconception to reject; check boundaries, source versions and missing evidence.
steps.check: 提交「量子與古典資源」的功能草圖、基準／擾動表、單位或欄位定義、可反駁預測及接受／保留理由。需能重算本課假想例，並說明相鄰機制不可取代的驗證。
steps.checkEn: Submit a functional sketch, baseline/perturbation table, unit/field definitions, falsifiable prediction and accept/hold rationale for quantum/classical resources. Recompute the course case and explain verification that the neighboring mechanism cannot replace.

knowledge.title: 原理、架構與適用邊界
knowledge.text: 量子狀態與古典控制資訊有不同複製限制。
knowledge.textEn: Quantum states and classical control information have different copying constraints.

knowledge.title: 相鄰機制與不可混同處
knowledge.text: 相鄰的「不可複製原理」：未知量子態無法一般性完美複製。 必須另列其證據，不能把這項機制的通過當作「量子與古典資源」已通過。
knowledge.textEn: Neighboring no-cloning principle: Unknown quantum states cannot generally be copied perfectly. Record its evidence separately; its success does not prove quantum/classical resources passes.

knowledge.title: 受控對照與證據品質
knowledge.text: 固定光源，只改單臂光損耗。 只變一個條件，保留相同資料格式、時間範圍及分母；模型估計與實測證據要分別標記。
knowledge.textEn: Fix source rate and vary one-arm loss. Change one condition and retain comparable formats, intervals and denominators; label estimates separately from measured evidence.

knowledge.title: 可重算的原創假想例
knowledge.text: 假設光損耗 20 dB，傳輸率 10^(−20/10)=0.01；每秒 10000 對、雙端偵測效率各 0.8，單臂承受此損耗的理想 coincidences=10000×0.01×0.8²=64/s，未計暗計數與死時間。
knowledge.textEn: At 20 dB loss, transmission=0.01; with 10000 pairs/s and both detector efficiencies 0.8, one lossy arm gives ideal coincidences=64/s, excluding dark counts/dead time.

quiz.question: 針對「量子與古典資源」的原理與可觀測性，哪項最直接成立？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement most directly explains the principle/observability of quantum/classical resources?
options: 量子狀態與古典控制資訊有不同複製限制。
量子位元可像古典封包任意複製重送。
只檢查「不可複製原理」，便可取代「量子與古典資源」的專屬驗證。
optionsEn: Quantum states and classical control information have different copying constraints.
Qubits can be freely copied and retransmitted like classical packets.
Checking no-cloning principle alone replaces verification specific to quantum/classical resources.
quiz.explanation: 量子狀態與古典控制資訊有不同複製限制。 相鄰的「不可複製原理」有不同責任：未知量子態無法一般性完美複製。因此不能用該項通過或課內誤判取代本單元證據。
quiz.explanationEn: Quantum states and classical control information have different copying constraints. Neighboring no-cloning principle has a different role: Unknown quantum states cannot generally be copied perfectly. Its success or the stated misconception cannot replace unit-specific evidence.

steps.title: 量子與古典資源：對照試驗與證據
steps.titleEn: Quantum/classical resources: controlled experiment and evidence
steps.objective: 針對「量子與古典資源」完成含競爭原因及不確定度的驗收紀錄。
steps.objectiveEn: For quantum/classical resources, complete acceptance evidence with competing causes and uncertainty.
steps.instruction: 重播本單元示意，讀取自製的基準與擾動紀錄，不接觸未授權目標。對照「量子狀態與古典控制資訊有不同複製限制。」，執行下列紙上或本地合成資料試驗：固定光源，只改單臂光損耗。 分開記錄預測、觀察與不確定度，再提出至少兩個可能原因；利用「不可複製原理」的獨立證據排除一個原因。若結果只來自模型，標記為模擬，不能當作真實設備量測。最後說明目前應接受、保留或拒絕哪一項要求，並保存可重算資料。
steps.instructionEn: Replay the unit diagram and inspect your authored baseline/perturbed records without accessing unauthorized targets. Evaluate the principle: Quantum states and classical control information have different copying constraints. Conduct this paper or local synthetic-data experiment: Fix source rate and vary one-arm loss. Record prediction, observation and uncertainty separately, propose two competing causes and use independent evidence from no-cloning principle to exclude one. Model outputs must remain labeled simulation, not physical measurements. Explain which requirement to accept, hold or reject and retain recomputable records.
steps.observation: 固定光源，只改單臂光損耗。 比較「量子與古典資源」與「不可複製原理」的證據是否支持相同推論。
steps.observationEn: Fix source rate and vary one-arm loss. Compare whether evidence for quantum/classical resources and no-cloning principle supports the same inference.
steps.failure: 量子位元可像古典封包任意複製重送。 這是本課要排除的誤判；先核對模型邊界、來源版本及缺失證據。
steps.failureEn: Qubits can be freely copied and retransmitted like classical packets. This is a misconception to reject; check boundaries, source versions and missing evidence.
steps.check: 提交「量子與古典資源」的功能草圖、基準／擾動表、單位或欄位定義、可反駁預測及接受／保留理由。需能重算本課假想例，並說明相鄰機制不可取代的驗證。
steps.checkEn: Submit a functional sketch, baseline/perturbation table, unit/field definitions, falsifiable prediction and accept/hold rationale for quantum/classical resources. Recompute the course case and explain verification that the neighboring mechanism cannot replace.

knowledge.textEn: Neighboring coexistence noise: Classical optical channels can affect quantum channels through scattering noise. Record its evidence separately; its success does not prove fidelity passes.

knowledge.title: 受控對照與證據品質
knowledge.text: 比較有與沒有古典時間標籤的資料。 只變一個條件，保留相同資料格式、時間範圍及分母；模型估計與實測證據要分別標記。
knowledge.textEn: Compare records with/without classical time tags. Change one condition and retain comparable formats, intervals and denominators; label estimates separately from measured evidence.

quiz.question: 針對「保真度」的原理與可觀測性，哪項最直接成立？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement most directly explains the principle/observability of fidelity?
options: 產生糾纏就能省略所有古典通訊。
只檢查「共纖雜訊」，便可取代「保真度」的專屬驗證。
成功率高與狀態品質高是不同指標。
optionsEn: Entanglement generation eliminates all classical communication.
Checking coexistence noise alone replaces verification specific to fidelity.
High success rate and high state quality are different metrics.
quiz.explanation: 成功率高與狀態品質高是不同指標。 相鄰的「共纖雜訊」有不同責任：古典光通道可能以散射雜訊影響量子通道。因此不能用該項通過或課內誤判取代本單元證據。
quiz.explanationEn: High success rate and high state quality are different metrics. Neighboring coexistence noise has a different role: Classical optical channels can affect quantum channels through scattering noise. Its success or the stated misconception cannot replace unit-specific evidence.

stages.title: 效能、復原與證據交接
stages.description: 四個領域技術單元各完成原理建模與對照證據，共八項可個別保存的作業。
stages.descriptionEn: Four domain units each pair principle modeling with controlled evidence, producing eight separately saved tasks.

steps.title: 共纖雜訊：架構與原理
steps.objective: 針對「共纖雜訊」建立有邊界、可反駁的系統模型。
steps.objectiveEn: For coexistence noise, construct a bounded falsifiable system model.
steps.instruction: 觀看師傅的功能示意後，以「共纖雜訊」為中心標出輸入、輸出、信任或資源邊界，並在學徒工作台排列資料流或元件。原理是：古典光通道可能以散射雜訊影響量子通道。 使用自行編寫的兩組小型資料或試算表，建立基準與一次只改一項的對照：模擬記憶保存時間短於協議等待時間。 先寫出可被反駁的預測；把「QKD 與量子網」視為相鄰問題，說明它如何影響模型而不能混同。數值只採本課假想算例或自訂並列明單位；本步保存架構圖、假設表與預測。
steps.instructionEn: After the mentor functional diagram, mark inputs, outputs and trust/resource boundaries around coexistence noise, then arrange components or data flows in the apprentice workspace. Principle: Classical optical channels can affect quantum channels through scattering noise. Create two small authored datasets or spreadsheet cases: a baseline and a one-variable change. Model memory lifetime shorter than protocol waiting time. Predict a falsifiable outcome before evaluating it. Treat qkd versus quantum networks as a neighboring issue and explain its influence without conflating them. Use only the stated hypothetical case or declared assumed inputs/units. Save the architecture, assumptions and prediction.
steps.observation: 模擬記憶保存時間短於協議等待時間。 比較「共纖雜訊」與「QKD 與量子網」的證據是否支持相同推論。
steps.observationEn: Model memory lifetime shorter than protocol waiting time. Compare whether evidence for coexistence noise and qkd versus quantum networks supports the same inference.
steps.failure: 量子位元可像古典封包任意複製重送。 這是本課要排除的誤判；先核對模型邊界、來源版本及缺失證據。
steps.failureEn: Qubits can be freely copied and retransmitted like classical packets. This is a misconception to reject; check boundaries, source versions and missing evidence.
steps.check: 提交「共纖雜訊」的功能草圖、基準／擾動表、單位或欄位定義、可反駁預測及接受／保留理由。需能重算本課假想例，並說明相鄰機制不可取代的驗證。

steps.instruction: 重播本單元示意，讀取自製的基準與擾動紀錄，不接觸未授權目標。對照「政策決策與攔截執行應分開驗證。」，執行下列紙上或本地合成資料試驗：固定使用者，只改裝置健康證據是否新鮮。 分開記錄預測、觀察與不確定度，再提出至少兩個可能原因；利用「最小權限」的獨立證據排除一個原因。若結果只來自模型，標記為模擬，不能當作真實設備量測。最後說明目前應接受、保留或拒絕哪一項要求，並保存可重算資料。
steps.instructionEn: Replay the unit diagram and inspect your authored baseline/perturbed records without accessing unauthorized targets. Evaluate the principle: Verify policy decision and enforcement separately. Conduct this paper or local synthetic-data experiment: Fix user and vary device-health evidence freshness. Record prediction, observation and uncertainty separately, propose two competing causes and use independent evidence from least privilege to exclude one. Model outputs must remain labeled simulation, not physical measurements. Explain which requirement to accept, hold or reject and retain recomputable records.
steps.observation: 固定使用者，只改裝置健康證據是否新鮮。 比較「決策與執行」與「最小權限」的證據是否支持相同推論。
steps.observationEn: Fix user and vary device-health evidence freshness. Compare whether evidence for decision versus enforcement and least privilege supports the same inference.
steps.failure: 內網位址足以證明應授予存取。 這是本課要排除的誤判；先核對模型邊界、來源版本及缺失證據。
steps.failureEn: An internal address is sufficient proof of access entitlement. This is a misconception to reject; check boundaries, source versions and missing evidence.
steps.check: 提交「決策與執行」的功能草圖、基準／擾動表、單位或欄位定義、可反駁預測及接受／保留理由。需能重算本課假想例，並說明相鄰機制不可取代的驗證。
steps.checkEn: Submit a functional sketch, baseline/perturbation table, unit/field definitions, falsifiable prediction and accept/hold rationale for decision versus enforcement. Recompute the course case and explain verification that the neighboring mechanism cannot replace.

knowledge.title: 原理、架構與適用邊界
knowledge.text: 政策決策與攔截執行應分開驗證。

knowledge.title: 相鄰機制與不可混同處
knowledge.text: 相鄰的「最小權限」：授權範圍應對應特定任務而非長期全權。 必須另列其證據，不能把這項機制的通過當作「決策與執行」已通過。
knowledge.textEn: Neighboring least privilege: Permission scope should match tasks rather than permanent total access. Record its evidence separately; its success does not prove decision versus enforcement passes.

knowledge.title: 受控對照與證據品質
knowledge.text: 固定使用者，只改裝置健康證據是否新鮮。 只變一個條件，保留相同資料格式、時間範圍及分母；模型估計與實測證據要分別標記。
knowledge.textEn: Fix user and vary device-health evidence freshness. Change one condition and retain comparable formats, intervals and denominators; label estimates separately from measured evidence.

quiz.question: 針對「決策與執行」的原理與可觀測性，哪項最直接成立？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement most directly explains the principle/observability of decision versus enforcement?
options: 內網位址足以證明應授予存取。
只檢查「最小權限」，便可取代「決策與執行」的專屬驗證。
政策決策與攔截執行應分開驗證。
optionsEn: An internal address is sufficient proof of access entitlement.
Checking least privilege alone replaces verification specific to decision versus enforcement.
Verify policy decision and enforcement separately.

quiz.explanationEn: Verify policy decision and enforcement separately. Neighboring least privilege has a different role: Permission scope should match tasks rather than permanent total access. Its success or the stated misconception cannot replace unit-specific evidence.

steps.title: 最小權限：架構與原理
steps.objective: 針對「最小權限」建立有邊界、可反駁的系統模型。
steps.objectiveEn: For least privilege, construct a bounded falsifiable system model.

knowledge.textEn: Compare cached decisions before/after revocation. Change one condition and retain comparable formats, intervals and denominators; label estimates separately from measured evidence.

quiz.question: 針對「持續評估」的原理與可觀測性，哪項最直接成立？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement most directly explains the principle/observability of continuous evaluation?
options: 狀態變更可觸發重評估，不等於只在登入判斷。
零信任等於每個請求都要求使用者手動再登入。
只檢查「權限撤銷」，便可取代「持續評估」的專屬驗證。
optionsEn: State changes can trigger reevaluation beyond initial login.
Zero trust means manual login on every request.
Checking revocation alone replaces verification specific to continuous evaluation.
quiz.explanation: 狀態變更可觸發重評估，不等於只在登入判斷。 相鄰的「權限撤銷」有不同責任：撤銷需涵蓋既有 session、token 與快取。因此不能用該項通過或課內誤判取代本單元證據。
quiz.explanationEn: State changes can trigger reevaluation beyond initial login. Neighboring revocation has a different role: Revocation covers active sessions, tokens and caches. Its success or the stated misconception cannot replace unit-specific evidence.

steps.title: 權限撤銷：架構與原理
steps.objective: 針對「權限撤銷」建立有邊界、可反駁的系統模型。
steps.objectiveEn: For revocation, construct a bounded falsifiable system model.
steps.instruction: 觀看師傅的功能示意後，以「權限撤銷」為中心標出輸入、輸出、信任或資源邊界，並在學徒工作台排列資料流或元件。原理是：撤銷需涵蓋既有 session、token 與快取。 使用自行編寫的兩組小型資料或試算表，建立基準與一次只改一項的對照：比較撤銷前後快取授權結果。 先寫出可被反駁的預測；把「服務不可用」視為相鄰問題，說明它如何影響模型而不能混同。數值只採本課假想算例或自訂並列明單位；本步保存架構圖、假設表與預測。
steps.instructionEn: After the mentor functional diagram, mark inputs, outputs and trust/resource boundaries around revocation, then arrange components or data flows in the apprentice workspace. Principle: Revocation covers active sessions, tokens and caches. Create two small authored datasets or spreadsheet cases: a baseline and a one-variable change. Compare cached decisions before/after revocation. Predict a falsifiable outcome before evaluating it. Treat service unavailability as a neighboring issue and explain its influence without conflating them. Use only the stated hypothetical case or declared assumed inputs/units. Save the architecture, assumptions and prediction.
steps.observation: 比較撤銷前後快取授權結果。 比較「權限撤銷」與「服務不可用」的證據是否支持相同推論。
steps.observationEn: Compare cached decisions before/after revocation. Compare whether evidence for revocation and service unavailability supports the same inference.
steps.failure: 內網位址足以證明應授予存取。 這是本課要排除的誤判；先核對模型邊界、來源版本及缺失證據。
steps.failureEn: An internal address is sufficient proof of access entitlement. This is a misconception to reject; check boundaries, source versions and missing evidence.
steps.check: 提交「權限撤銷」的功能草圖、基準／擾動表、單位或欄位定義、可反駁預測及接受／保留理由。需能重算本課假想例，並說明相鄰機制不可取代的驗證。
steps.checkEn: Submit a functional sketch, baseline/perturbation table, unit/field definitions, falsifiable prediction and accept/hold rationale for revocation. Recompute the course case and explain verification that the neighboring mechanism cannot replace.

knowledge.title: 相鄰機制與不可混同處
knowledge.text: 相鄰的「審計關聯」：決策與執行日誌需可關聯同一请求。 必須另列其證據，不能把這項機制的通過當作「例外生命週期」已通過。
knowledge.textEn: Neighboring audit correlation: Decision/enforcement logs must correlate the same request. Record its evidence separately; its success does not prove exception lifecycle passes.

knowledge.title: 受控對照與證據品質
knowledge.text: 模擬政策服務不可用的 fail-closed 與受控例外。 只變一個條件，保留相同資料格式、時間範圍及分母；模型估計與實測證據要分別標記。
knowledge.textEn: Model unavailable policy service with fail-closed and governed exceptions. Change one condition and retain comparable formats, intervals and denominators; label estimates separately from measured evidence.

quiz.question: 針對「例外生命週期」的原理與可觀測性，哪項最直接成立？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement most directly explains the principle/observability of exception lifecycle?
options: 例外要有範圍、期限與審批記錄。
內網位址足以證明應授予存取。
只檢查「審計關聯」，便可取代「例外生命週期」的專屬驗證。
optionsEn: Exceptions need scope, expiry and approval records.
An internal address is sufficient proof of access entitlement.
Checking audit correlation alone replaces verification specific to exception lifecycle.
quiz.explanation: 例外要有範圍、期限與審批記錄。 相鄰的「審計關聯」有不同責任：決策與執行日誌需可關聯同一请求。因此不能用該項通過或課內誤判取代本單元證據。
quiz.explanationEn: Exceptions need scope, expiry and approval records. Neighboring audit correlation has a different role: Decision/enforcement logs must correlate the same request. Its success or the stated misconception cannot replace unit-specific evidence.

steps.title: 例外生命週期：對照試驗與證據
steps.titleEn: Exception lifecycle: controlled experiment and evidence
steps.objective: 針對「例外生命週期」完成含競爭原因及不確定度的驗收紀錄。
steps.objectiveEn: For exception lifecycle, complete acceptance evidence with competing causes and uncertainty.
steps.instruction: 重播本單元示意，讀取自製的基準與擾動紀錄，不接觸未授權目標。對照「例外要有範圍、期限與審批記錄。」，執行下列紙上或本地合成資料試驗：模擬政策服務不可用的 fail-closed 與受控例外。 分開記錄預測、觀察與不確定度，再提出至少兩個可能原因；利用「審計關聯」的獨立證據排除一個原因。若結果只來自模型，標記為模擬，不能當作真實設備量測。最後說明目前應接受、保留或拒絕哪一項要求，並保存可重算資料。
steps.instructionEn: Replay the unit diagram and inspect your authored baseline/perturbed records without accessing unauthorized targets. Evaluate the principle: Exceptions need scope, expiry and approval records. Conduct this paper or local synthetic-data experiment: Model unavailable policy service with fail-closed and governed exceptions. Record prediction, observation and uncertainty separately, propose two competing causes and use independent evidence from audit correlation to exclude one. Model outputs must remain labeled simulation, not physical measurements. Explain which requirement to accept, hold or reject and retain recomputable records.
steps.observation: 模擬政策服務不可用的 fail-closed 與受控例外。 比較「例外生命週期」與「審計關聯」的證據是否支持相同推論。
steps.observationEn: Model unavailable policy service with fail-closed and governed exceptions. Compare whether evidence for exception lifecycle and audit correlation supports the same inference.
steps.failure: 內網位址足以證明應授予存取。 這是本課要排除的誤判；先核對模型邊界、來源版本及缺失證據。
steps.failureEn: An internal address is sufficient proof of access entitlement. This is a misconception to reject; check boundaries, source versions and missing evidence.
steps.check: 提交「例外生命週期」的功能草圖、基準／擾動表、單位或欄位定義、可反駁預測及接受／保留理由。需能重算本課假想例，並說明相鄰機制不可取代的驗證。
steps.checkEn: Submit a functional sketch, baseline/perturbation table, unit/field definitions, falsifiable prediction and accept/hold rationale for exception lifecycle. Recompute the course case and explain verification that the neighboring mechanism cannot replace.

steps.title: 審計關聯：架構與原理
steps.objective: 針對「審計關聯」建立有邊界、可反駁的系統模型。
steps.objectiveEn: For audit correlation, construct a bounded falsifiable system model.
steps.instruction: 觀看師傅的功能示意後，以「審計關聯」為中心標出輸入、輸出、信任或資源邊界，並在學徒工作台排列資料流或元件。原理是：決策與執行日誌需可關聯同一请求。 使用自行編寫的兩組小型資料或試算表，建立基準與一次只改一項的對照：模擬政策服務不可用的 fail-closed 與受控例外。 先寫出可被反駁的預測；把「合成政策測試」視為相鄰問題，說明它如何影響模型而不能混同。數值只採本課假想算例或自訂並列明單位；本步保存架構圖、假設表與預測。
steps.instructionEn: After the mentor functional diagram, mark inputs, outputs and trust/resource boundaries around audit correlation, then arrange components or data flows in the apprentice workspace. Principle: Decision/enforcement logs must correlate the same request. Create two small authored datasets or spreadsheet cases: a baseline and a one-variable change. Model unavailable policy service with fail-closed and governed exceptions. Predict a falsifiable outcome before evaluating it. Treat synthetic policy tests as a neighboring issue and explain its influence without conflating them. Use only the stated hypothetical case or declared assumed inputs/units. Save the architecture, assumptions and prediction.
steps.observation: 模擬政策服務不可用的 fail-closed 與受控例外。 比較「審計關聯」與「合成政策測試」的證據是否支持相同推論。
steps.observationEn: Model unavailable policy service with fail-closed and governed exceptions. Compare whether evidence for audit correlation and synthetic policy tests supports the same inference.
steps.failure: 零信任等於每個請求都要求使用者手動再登入。 這是本課要排除的誤判；先核對模型邊界、來源版本及缺失證據。
steps.failureEn: Zero trust means manual login on every request. This is a misconception to reject; check boundaries, source versions and missing evidence.
steps.check: 提交「審計關聯」的功能草圖、基準／擾動表、單位或欄位定義、可反駁預測及接受／保留理由。需能重算本課假想例，並說明相鄰機制不可取代的驗證。
steps.checkEn: Submit a functional sketch, baseline/perturbation table, unit/field definitions, falsifiable prediction and accept/hold rationale for audit correlation. Recompute the course case and explain verification that the neighboring mechanism cannot replace.

knowledge.textEn: Neighboring stable identifiers: Immutable identifiers prevent rename-related authorization confusion. Record its evidence separately; its success does not prove identity proofing passes.

knowledge.title: 受控對照與證據品質
knowledge.text: 固定使用者，只改角色集合。 只變一個條件，保留相同資料格式、時間範圍及分母；模型估計與實測證據要分別標記。
knowledge.textEn: Fix users and vary role sets. Change one condition and retain comparable formats, intervals and denominators; label estimates separately from measured evidence.

knowledge.title: 可重算的原創假想例
knowledge.text: 假想 2000 人各 8 個直接權限關係共有 16000 邊；若 20 角色各 30 權限並每人 2 角色，需 600+4000=4600 邊，但角色設計仍可能過度授權。
knowledge.textEn: 2000 people with eight direct grants create 16000 edges; 20 roles with 30 grants plus two roles/person create 4600 edges, but role design may still overgrant.

quiz.question: 針對「身分證明」的原理與可觀測性，哪項最直接成立？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement most directly explains the principle/observability of identity proofing?
options: 聲稱身分與驗證聲稱的證據需要分開。
驗證成功自動授予所有資源權限。
只檢查「唯一識別」，便可取代「身分證明」的專屬驗證。
optionsEn: Separate claimed identity from evidence validating that claim.
Successful authentication automatically grants every resource.
Checking stable identifiers alone replaces verification specific to identity proofing.
quiz.explanation: 聲稱身分與驗證聲稱的證據需要分開。 相鄰的「唯一識別」有不同責任：不可變識別碼避免改名造成權限混淆。因此不能用該項通過或課內誤判取代本單元證據。
quiz.explanationEn: Separate claimed identity from evidence validating that claim. Neighboring stable identifiers has a different role: Immutable identifiers prevent rename-related authorization confusion. Its success or the stated misconception cannot replace unit-specific evidence.

steps.title: 唯一識別：架構與原理
steps.objective: 針對「唯一識別」建立有邊界、可反駁的系統模型。
steps.objectiveEn: For stable identifiers, construct a bounded falsifiable system model.
steps.instruction: 觀看師傅的功能示意後，以「唯一識別」為中心標出輸入、輸出、信任或資源邊界，並在學徒工作台排列資料流或元件。原理是：不可變識別碼避免改名造成權限混淆。 使用自行編寫的兩組小型資料或試算表，建立基準與一次只改一項的對照：固定使用者，只改角色集合。 先寫出可被反駁的預測；把「入轉離」視為相鄰問題，說明它如何影響模型而不能混同。數值只採本課假想算例或自訂並列明單位；本步保存架構圖、假設表與預測。
steps.instructionEn: After the mentor functional diagram, mark inputs, outputs and trust/resource boundaries around stable identifiers, then arrange components or data flows in the apprentice workspace. Principle: Immutable identifiers prevent rename-related authorization confusion. Create two small authored datasets or spreadsheet cases: a baseline and a one-variable change. Fix users and vary role sets. Predict a falsifiable outcome before evaluating it. Treat joiner-mover-leaver as a neighboring issue and explain its influence without conflating them. Use only the stated hypothetical case or declared assumed inputs/units. Save the architecture, assumptions and prediction.
steps.observation: 固定使用者，只改角色集合。 比較「唯一識別」與「入轉離」的證據是否支持相同推論。
steps.observationEn: Fix users and vary role sets. Compare whether evidence for stable identifiers and joiner-mover-leaver supports the same inference.
steps.failure: 顯示名稱可以代替不可變主體識別碼。 這是本課要排除的誤判；先核對模型邊界、來源版本及缺失證據。
steps.failureEn: Display names can replace immutable subject identifiers. This is a misconception to reject; check boundaries, source versions and missing evidence.
steps.check: 提交「唯一識別」的功能草圖、基準／擾動表、單位或欄位定義、可反駁預測及接受／保留理由。需能重算本課假想例，並說明相鄰機制不可取代的驗證。
steps.checkEn: Submit a functional sketch, baseline/perturbation table, unit/field definitions, falsifiable prediction and accept/hold rationale for stable identifiers. Recompute the course case and explain verification that the neighboring mechanism cannot replace.

steps.objectiveEn: For stable identifiers, complete acceptance evidence with competing causes and uncertainty.

Record prediction, observation and uncertainty separately, propose two competing causes and use independent evidence from joiner-mover-leaver to exclude one. Model outputs must remain labeled simulation, not physical measurements. Explain which requirement to accept, hold or reject and retain recomputable records.

steps.titleEn: Issuer and audience: architecture and principle

steps.objectiveEn: For issuer and audience, construct a bounded falsifiable system model.
steps.instruction: 觀看師傅的功能示意後，以「Issuer 與 audience」為中心標出輸入、輸出、信任或資源邊界，並在學徒工作台排列資料流或元件。原理是：token 需匹配可信簽發者與預期接收者。 使用自行編寫的兩組小型資料或試算表，建立基準與一次只改一項的對照：保留組織，只改離職撤銷時點。 先寫出可被反駁的預測；把「OAuth 範圍」視為相鄰問題，說明它如何影響模型而不能混同。數值只採本課假想算例或自訂並列明單位；本步保存架構圖、假設表與預測。
steps.instructionEn: After the mentor functional diagram, mark inputs, outputs and trust/resource boundaries around issuer and audience, then arrange components or data flows in the apprentice workspace. Principle: Tokens must match trusted issuers and intended audiences. Create two small authored datasets or spreadsheet cases: a baseline and a one-variable change. Fix organization and vary leaver-revocation timing. Predict a falsifiable outcome before evaluating it. Treat oauth scopes as a neighboring issue and explain its influence without conflating them. Use only the stated hypothetical case or declared assumed inputs/units. Save the architecture, assumptions and prediction.
steps.observation: 保留組織，只改離職撤銷時點。 比較「Issuer 與 audience」與「OAuth 範圍」的證據是否支持相同推論。
steps.observationEn: Fix organization and vary leaver-revocation timing. Compare whether evidence for issuer and audience and oauth scopes supports the same inference.
steps.failure: 驗證成功自動授予所有資源權限。 這是本課要排除的誤判；先核對模型邊界、來源版本及缺失證據。
steps.failureEn: Successful authentication automatically grants every resource. This is a misconception to reject; check boundaries, source versions and missing evidence.
steps.check: 提交「Issuer 與 audience」的功能草圖、基準／擾動表、單位或欄位定義、可反駁預測及接受／保留理由。需能重算本課假想例，並說明相鄰機制不可取代的驗證。
steps.checkEn: Submit a functional sketch, baseline/perturbation table, unit/field definitions, falsifiable prediction and accept/hold rationale for issuer and audience. Recompute the course case and explain verification that the neighboring mechanism cannot replace.

knowledge.title: 原理、架構與適用邊界
knowledge.text: token 需匹配可信簽發者與預期接收者。
knowledge.textEn: Tokens must match trusted issuers and intended audiences.

knowledge.title: 相鄰機制與不可混同處
knowledge.text: 相鄰的「OAuth 範圍」：scope 限制授權範圍，不是使用者全部身份證明。 必須另列其證據，不能把這項機制的通過當作「Issuer 與 audience」已通過。
knowledge.textEn: Neighboring oauth scopes: Scopes constrain delegated access, not complete identity proof. Record its evidence separately; its success does not prove issuer and audience passes.

knowledge.title: 受控對照與證據品質
knowledge.text: 保留組織，只改離職撤銷時點。 只變一個條件，保留相同資料格式、時間範圍及分母；模型估計與實測證據要分別標記。
knowledge.textEn: Fix organization and vary leaver-revocation timing. Change one condition and retain comparable formats, intervals and denominators; label estimates separately from measured evidence.

quiz.question: 針對「Issuer 與 audience」的原理與可觀測性，哪項最直接成立？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement most directly explains the principle/observability of issuer and audience?
options: 驗證成功自動授予所有資源權限。
只檢查「OAuth 範圍」，便可取代「Issuer 與 audience」的專屬驗證。
token 需匹配可信簽發者與預期接收者。
optionsEn: Successful authentication automatically grants every resource.
Checking oauth scopes alone replaces verification specific to issuer and audience.
Tokens must match trusted issuers and intended audiences.
quiz.explanation: token 需匹配可信簽發者與預期接收者。 相鄰的「OAuth 範圍」有不同責任：scope 限制授權範圍，不是使用者全部身份證明。因此不能用該項通過或課內誤判取代本單元證據。
quiz.explanationEn: Tokens must match trusted issuers and intended audiences. Neighboring oauth scopes has a different role: Scopes constrain delegated access, not complete identity proof. Its success or the stated misconception cannot replace unit-specific evidence.

steps.title: Issuer 與 audience：對照試驗與證據

Record prediction, observation and uncertainty separately, propose two competing causes and use independent evidence from oauth scopes to exclude one. Model outputs must remain labeled simulation, not physical measurements. Explain which requirement to accept, hold or reject and retain recomputable records.

steps.failureEn: Successful authentication automatically grants every resource. This is a misconception to reject; check boundaries, source versions and missing evidence.
steps.check: 提交「Issuer 與 audience」的功能草圖、基準／擾動表、單位或欄位定義、可反駁預測及接受／保留理由。需能重算本課假想例，並說明相鄰機制不可取代的驗證。

steps.title: 因子分類：架構與原理

steps.instructionEn: After the mentor functional diagram, mark inputs, outputs and trust/resource boundaries around factor categories, then arrange components or data flows in the apprentice workspace. Principle: Knowledge, possession and biometrics are distinct factor categories. Create two small authored datasets or spreadsheet cases: a baseline and a one-variable change. steps.checkEn: Submit a functional sketch, baseline/perturbation table, unit/field definitions, falsifiable prediction and accept/hold rationale for factor categories. Recompute the course case and explain verification that the neighboring mechanism cannot replace.

workedExample.text: 假設六位數等機率碼為 1000000 種，最多 5 次猜測的成功率上界 5/1000000=0.0005%；未考慮被竊取、重放或有偏分布，不能據此評估整體 MFA 安全。
workedExample.textEn: A uniform six-digit code has 1000000 values; five guesses bound success at 0.0005%, excluding theft, replay and biased generation and not measuring total MFA security.
workedExample.assumptions: 只採算例中明列的教學條件；效能與安全估計須依拓撲、分布、開銷、版本與不確定度重算。
workedExample.assumptionsEn: Use only the stated teaching assumptions; recalculate for topology, distribution, overhead, versions and uncertainty.
workedExample.sourceScope: 作者自行設定的教學數值；官方來源支援原理與尺寸規格，未聲稱量測此假想平台。
workedExample.sourceScopeEn: Independently chosen teaching inputs; official sources support principles and specified material sizes, not measurements of this hypothetical platform.

title: 公鑰基礎建設
summary: 以信任錨、憑證路徑與撤銷串連 16 個領域技術單元、32 個保存步驟；分析架構、原理、介面、故障、量化案例與防禦證據。
summaryEn: Sixteen domain-specific technical units and 32 saved steps connect trust anchors, certificate paths and revocation through architecture, principles, interfaces, faults, quantitative cases and defensive evidence.

stages.title: 需求、元件與基本模型
stages.description: 四個領域技術單元各完成原理建模與對照證據，共八項可個別保存的作業。
stages.descriptionEn: Four domain units each pair principle modeling with controlled evidence, producing eight separately saved tasks.

steps.title: 信任锚：架構與原理
steps.objective: 針對「信任锚」建立有邊界、可反駁的系統模型。
steps.objectiveEn: For trust anchors, construct a bounded falsifiable system model.
steps.instruction: 觀看師傅的功能示意後，以「信任锚」為中心標出輸入、輸出、信任或資源邊界，並在學徒工作台排列資料流或元件。原理是：信任锚來自策略配置，不由自簽本身建立。 使用自行編寫的兩組小型資料或試算表，建立基準與一次只改一項的對照：固定鏈，只改葉憑證有效時間。 先寫出可被反駁的預測；把「根與中繼」視為相鄰問題，說明它如何影響模型而不能混同。數值只採本課假想算例或自訂並列明單位；本步保存架構圖、假設表與預測。
steps.instructionEn: After the mentor functional diagram, mark inputs, outputs and trust/resource boundaries around trust anchors, then arrange components or data flows in the apprentice workspace. Principle: Trust anchors come from policy configuration, not self-signing alone. Create two small authored datasets or spreadsheet cases: a baseline and a one-variable change. Fix chain and vary leaf validity. Predict a falsifiable outcome before evaluating it. Treat roots and intermediates as a neighboring issue and explain its influence without conflating them. Use only the stated hypothetical case or declared assumed inputs/units. Save the architecture, assumptions and prediction.
steps.observation: 固定鏈，只改葉憑證有效時間。 比較「信任锚」與「根與中繼」的證據是否支持相同推論。
steps.observationEn: Fix chain and vary leaf validity. Compare whether evidence for trust anchors and roots and intermediates supports the same inference.
steps.failure: 鏈上簽章都正確便不需检查名稱與用途。 這是本課要排除的誤判；先核對模型邊界、來源版本及缺失證據。
steps.failureEn: Valid signatures remove the need for name/usage checks. This is a misconception to reject; check boundaries, source versions and missing evidence.
steps.check: 提交「信任锚」的功能草圖、基準／擾動表、單位或欄位定義、可反駁預測及接受／保留理由。需能重算本課假想例，並說明相鄰機制不可取代的驗證。
steps.checkEn: Submit a functional sketch, baseline/perturbation table, unit/field definitions, falsifiable prediction and accept/hold rationale for trust anchors. Recompute the course case and explain verification that the neighboring mechanism cannot replace.

knowledge.title: 原理、架構與適用邊界
knowledge.text: 信任锚來自策略配置，不由自簽本身建立。
knowledge.textEn: Trust anchors come from policy configuration, not self-signing alone.

knowledge.title: 相鄰機制與不可混同處
knowledge.text: 相鄰的「根與中繼」：中繼限制簽發責任並降低根鍵使用頻率。 必須另列其證據，不能把這項機制的通過當作「信任锚」已通過。
knowledge.textEn: Neighboring roots and intermediates: Intermediates scope issuance and reduce root-key use. Record its evidence separately; its success does not prove trust anchors passes.

knowledge.title: 受控對照與證據品質
knowledge.text: 固定鏈，只改葉憑證有效時間。 只變一個條件，保留相同資料格式、時間範圍及分母；模型估計與實測證據要分別標記。
knowledge.textEn: Fix chain and vary leaf validity. Change one condition and retain comparable formats, intervals and denominators; label estimates separately from measured evidence.

knowledge.title: 可重算的原創假想例
knowledge.text: 假想根→中繼→葉三張憑證，驗證兩個非自簽鏈邊各需 1.2 ms，合為 2.4 ms；還需名稱、用途、時間、撤銷检驗，不能把它當成總 TLS 握手時间。
knowledge.textEn: A root→intermediate→leaf path with two non-self-signed edges at 1.2 ms verification each costs 2.4 ms, excluding name, usage, time, revocation checks and total TLS handshake time.

quiz.question: 針對「信任锚」的原理與可觀測性，哪項最直接成立？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement most directly explains the principle/observability of trust anchors?
options: 信任锚來自策略配置，不由自簽本身建立。
鏈上簽章都正確便不需检查名稱與用途。
只檢查「根與中繼」，便可取代「信任锚」的專屬驗證。
optionsEn: Trust anchors come from policy configuration, not self-signing alone.
Valid signatures remove the need for name/usage checks.
Checking roots and intermediates alone replaces verification specific to trust anchors.
quiz.explanation: 信任锚來自策略配置，不由自簽本身建立。 相鄰的「根與中繼」有不同責任：中繼限制簽發責任並降低根鍵使用頻率。因此不能用該項通過或課內誤判取代本單元證據。
quiz.explanationEn: Trust anchors come from policy configuration, not self-signing alone. Neighboring roots and intermediates has a different role: Intermediates scope issuance and reduce root-key use. Its success or the stated misconception cannot replace unit-specific evidence.

steps.title: 信任锚：對照試驗與證據
steps.titleEn: Trust anchors: controlled experiment and evidence
steps.objective: 針對「信任锚」完成含競爭原因及不確定度的驗收紀錄。
steps.objectiveEn: For trust anchors, complete acceptance evidence with competing causes and uncertainty.
steps.instruction: 重播本單元示意，讀取自製的基準與擾動紀錄，不接觸未授權目標。對照「信任锚來自策略配置，不由自簽本身建立。」，執行下列紙上或本地合成資料試驗：固定鏈，只改葉憑證有效時間。 分開記錄預測、觀察與不確定度，再提出至少兩個可能原因；利用「根與中繼」的獨立證據排除一個原因。若結果只來自模型，標記為模擬，不能當作真實設備量測。最後說明目前應接受、保留或拒絕哪一項要求，並保存可重算資料。
steps.instructionEn: Replay the unit diagram and inspect your authored baseline/perturbed records without accessing unauthorized targets. Evaluate the principle: Trust anchors come from policy configuration, not self-signing alone. Conduct this paper or local synthetic-data experiment: Fix chain and vary leaf validity. Record prediction, observation and uncertainty separately, propose two competing causes and use independent evidence from roots and intermediates to exclude one. Model outputs must remain labeled simulation, not physical measurements. Explain which requirement to accept, hold or reject and retain recomputable records.

steps.observationEn: Fix chain and vary leaf validity. Compare whether evidence for trust anchors and roots and intermediates supports the same inference.

steps.failureEn: Valid signatures remove the need for name/usage checks. This is a misconception to reject; check boundaries, source versions and missing evidence.
steps.check: 提交「信任锚」的功能草圖、基準／擾動表、單位或欄位定義、可反駁預測及接受／保留理由。需能重算本課假想例，並說明相鄰機制不可取代的驗證。
steps.checkEn: Submit a functional sketch, baseline/perturbation table, unit/field definitions, falsifiable prediction and accept/hold rationale for trust anchors. Recompute the course case and explain verification that the neighboring mechanism cannot replace.

title: 硬體安全模組整合
summary: 以金鑰不可匯出、模組邊界與授權操作串連 16 個領域技術單元、32 個保存步驟；分析架構、原理、介面、故障、量化案例與防禦證據。
summaryEn: Sixteen domain-specific technical units and 32 saved steps connect nonexportable keys, module boundaries and authorized operations through architecture, principles, interfaces, faults, quantitative cases and defensive evidence.

stages.title: 需求、元件與基本模型
stages.description: 四個領域技術單元各完成原理建模與對照證據，共八項可個別保存的作業。
stages.descriptionEn: Four domain units each pair principle modeling with controlled evidence, producing eight separately saved tasks.

steps.title: 模組邊界：架構與原理
steps.objective: 針對「模組邊界」建立有邊界、可反駁的系統模型。
steps.objectiveEn: For module boundaries, construct a bounded falsifiable system model.
steps.instruction: 觀看師傅的功能示意後，以「模組邊界」為中心標出輸入、輸出、信任或資源邊界，並在學徒工作台排列資料流或元件。原理是：安全模組邊界與應用進程邊界不同。 使用自行編寫的兩組小型資料或試算表，建立基準與一次只改一項的對照：固定鍵，只改調用身份的權限。 先寫出可被反駁的預測；把「Token 與 session」視為相鄰問題，說明它如何影響模型而不能混同。數值只採本課假想算例或自訂並列明單位；本步保存架構圖、假設表與預測。
steps.instructionEn: After the mentor functional diagram, mark inputs, outputs and trust/resource boundaries around module boundaries, then arrange components or data flows in the apprentice workspace. Principle: Security-module and application-process boundaries differ. Create two small authored datasets or spreadsheet cases: a baseline and a one-variable change. Fix keys and vary caller privileges. Predict a falsifiable outcome before evaluating it. Treat tokens and sessions as a neighboring issue and explain its influence without conflating them. Use only the stated hypothetical case or declared assumed inputs/units. Save the architecture, assumptions and prediction.
steps.observation: 固定鍵，只改調用身份的權限。 比較「模組邊界」與「Token 與 session」的證據是否支持相同推論。
steps.observationEn: Fix keys and vary caller privileges. Compare whether evidence for module boundaries and tokens and sessions supports the same inference.

steps.check: 提交「模組邊界」的功能草圖、基準／擾動表、單位或欄位定義、可反駁預測及接受／保留理由。需能重算本課假想例，並說明相鄰機制不可取代的驗證。

knowledge.title: 原理、架構與適用邊界
knowledge.text: 安全模組邊界與應用進程邊界不同。
knowledge.textEn: Security-module and application-process boundaries differ.

knowledge.title: 相鄰機制與不可混同處
knowledge.text: 相鄰的「Token 與 session」：PKCS #11 的 token 對象與 session 狀態需區分。 必須另列其證據，不能把這項機制的通過當作「模組邊界」已通過。
knowledge.textEn: Neighboring tokens and sessions: Distinguish PKCS #11 token objects from session state. Record its evidence separately; its success does not prove module boundaries passes.

knowledge.title: 受控對照與證據品質
knowledge.text: 固定鍵，只改調用身份的權限。 只變一個條件，保留相同資料格式、時間範圍及分母；模型估計與實測證據要分別標記。
knowledge.textEn: Fix keys and vary caller privileges. Change one condition and retain comparable formats, intervals and denominators; label estimates separately from measured evidence.

knowledge.title: 可重算的原創假想例
knowledge.text: 假設單次簽章平均 2 ms，單串行通道理想上限 500 次/s；300 次/s 到達時利用率 60%，排隊與 API 開銷會使實際吞吐降低。
knowledge.textEn: A hypothetical 2 ms signature averages an ideal 500/s serial channel; arrivals at 300/s imply 60% utilization before queues and API overhead.

quiz.question: 針對「模組邊界」的原理與可觀測性，哪項最直接成立？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement most directly explains the principle/observability of module boundaries?
options: 安全模組邊界與應用進程邊界不同。
使用 HSM 會自動修複所有應用授權錯誤。
只檢查「Token 與 session」，便可取代「模組邊界」的專屬驗證。
optionsEn: Security-module and application-process boundaries differ.
An HSM automatically repairs all application authorization errors.
Checking tokens and sessions alone replaces verification specific to module boundaries.
quiz.explanation: 安全模組邊界與應用進程邊界不同。 相鄰的「Token 與 session」有不同責任：PKCS #11 的 token 對象與 session 狀態需區分。因此不能用該項通過或課內誤判取代本單元證據。
quiz.explanationEn: Security-module and application-process boundaries differ. Neighboring tokens and sessions has a different role: Distinguish PKCS #11 token objects from session state. Its success or the stated misconception cannot replace unit-specific evidence.

steps.title: 模組邊界：對照試驗與證據
steps.titleEn: Module boundaries: controlled experiment and evidence
steps.objective: 針對「模組邊界」完成含競爭原因及不確定度的驗收紀錄。
steps.objectiveEn: For module boundaries, complete acceptance evidence with competing causes and uncertainty.
steps.instruction: 重播本單元示意，讀取自製的基準與擾動紀錄，不接觸未授權目標。對照「安全模組邊界與應用進程邊界不同。」，執行下列紙上或本地合成資料試驗：固定鍵，只改調用身份的權限。 分開記錄預測、觀察與不確定度，再提出至少兩個可能原因；利用「Token 與 session」的獨立證據排除一個原因。若結果只來自模型，標記為模擬，不能當作真實設備量測。最後說明目前應接受、保留或拒絕哪一項要求，並保存可重算資料。
steps.instructionEn: Replay the unit diagram and inspect your authored baseline/perturbed records without accessing unauthorized targets. Evaluate the principle: Security-module and application-process boundaries differ. Conduct this paper or local synthetic-data experiment: Fix keys and vary caller privileges. Record prediction, observation and uncertainty separately, propose two competing causes and use independent evidence from tokens and sessions to exclude one. Model outputs must remain labeled simulation, not physical measurements. Explain which requirement to accept, hold or reject and retain recomputable records.
steps.observation: 固定鍵，只改調用身份的權限。 比較「模組邊界」與「Token 與 session」的證據是否支持相同推論。
steps.observationEn: Fix keys and vary caller privileges. Compare whether evidence for module boundaries and tokens and sessions supports the same inference.
steps.failure: 使用 HSM 會自動修複所有應用授權錯誤。 這是本課要排除的誤判；先核對模型邊界、來源版本及缺失證據。
steps.failureEn: An HSM automatically repairs all application authorization errors. This is a misconception to reject; check boundaries, source versions and missing evidence.
steps.check: 提交「模組邊界」的功能草圖、基準／擾動表、單位或欄位定義、可反駁預測及接受／保留理由。需能重算本課假想例，並說明相鄰機制不可取代的驗證。
steps.checkEn: Submit a functional sketch, baseline/perturbation table, unit/field definitions, falsifiable prediction and accept/hold rationale for module boundaries. Recompute the course case and explain verification that the neighboring mechanism cannot replace.

knowledge.title: 原理、架構與適用邊界
knowledge.text: 安全模組邊界與應用進程邊界不同。
knowledge.textEn: Security-module and application-process boundaries differ.

knowledge.title: 相鄰機制與不可混同處
knowledge.text: 相鄰的「Token 與 session」：PKCS #11 的 token 對象與 session 狀態需區分。 必須另列其證據，不能把這項機制的通過當作「模組邊界」已通過。
knowledge.textEn: Neighboring tokens and sessions: Distinguish PKCS #11 token objects from session state. Record its evidence separately; its success does not prove module boundaries passes.

knowledge.title: 受控對照與證據品質
knowledge.text: 固定鍵，只改調用身份的權限。 只變一個條件，保留相同資料格式、時間範圍及分母；模型估計與實測證據要分別標記。
knowledge.textEn: Fix keys and vary caller privileges. Change one condition and retain comparable formats, intervals and denominators; label estimates separately from measured evidence.

knowledge.title: 可重算的原創假想例
knowledge.text: 假設單次簽章平均 2 ms，單串行通道理想上限 500 次/s；300 次/s 到達時利用率 60%，排隊與 API 開銷會使實際吞吐降低。
knowledge.textEn: A hypothetical 2 ms signature averages an ideal 500/s serial channel; arrivals at 300/s imply 60% utilization before queues and API overhead.

steps.title: Token 與 session：架構與原理
steps.titleEn: Tokens and sessions: architecture and principle
steps.objective: 針對「Token 與 session」建立有邊界、可反駁的系統模型。
steps.objectiveEn: For tokens and sessions, construct a bounded falsifiable system model.
steps.instruction: 觀看師傅的功能示意後，以「Token 與 session」為中心標出輸入、輸出、信任或資源邊界，並在學徒工作台排列資料流或元件。原理是：PKCS #11 的 token 對象與 session 狀態需區分。 使用自行編寫的兩組小型資料或試算表，建立基準與一次只改一項的對照：固定鍵，只改調用身份的權限。 先寫出可被反駁的預測；把「對象屬性」視為相鄰問題，說明它如何影響模型而不能混同。數值只採本課假想算例或自訂並列明單位；本步保存架構圖、假設表與預測。
steps.instructionEn: After the mentor functional diagram, mark inputs, outputs and trust/resource boundaries around tokens and sessions, then arrange components or data flows in the apprentice workspace. Principle: Distinguish PKCS #11 token objects from session state. Create two small authored datasets or spreadsheet cases: a baseline and a one-variable change. Fix keys and vary caller privileges. Predict a falsifiable outcome before evaluating it. Treat object attributes as a neighboring issue and explain its influence without conflating them. Use only the stated hypothetical case or declared assumed inputs/units. Save the architecture, assumptions and prediction.
steps.observation: 固定鍵，只改調用身份的權限。 比較「Token 與 session」與「對象屬性」的證據是否支持相同推論。
steps.observationEn: Fix keys and vary caller privileges. Compare whether evidence for tokens and sessions and object attributes supports the same inference.
steps.failure: FIPS 驗證表示任意部署配置都已獲驗證。 這是本課要排除的誤判；先核對模型邊界、來源版本及缺失證據。
steps.failureEn: FIPS validation certifies every possible deployment configuration. This is a misconception to reject; check boundaries, source versions and missing evidence.
steps.check: 提交「Token 與 session」的功能草圖、基準／擾動表、單位或欄位定義、可反駁預測及接受／保留理由。需能重算本課假想例，並說明相鄰機制不可取代的驗證。
steps.checkEn: Submit a functional sketch, baseline/perturbation table, unit/field definitions, falsifiable prediction and accept/hold rationale for tokens and sessions. Recompute the course case and explain verification that the neighboring mechanism cannot replace.

knowledge.textEn: Fix keys and vary caller privileges. Change one condition and retain comparable formats, intervals and denominators; label estimates separately from measured evidence.

quiz.question: 針對「對象屬性」的原理與可觀測性，哪項最直接成立？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement most directly explains the principle/observability of object attributes?
options: 使用 HSM 會自動修複所有應用授權錯誤。
只檢查「鍵生成位置」，便可取代「對象屬性」的專屬驗證。
簽章、解密與匯出許可是不同屬性。
optionsEn: An HSM automatically repairs all application authorization errors.
Checking key-generation location alone replaces verification specific to object attributes.
Signing, decryption and export permissions are distinct attributes.
quiz.explanation: 簽章、解密與匯出許可是不同屬性。 相鄰的「鍵生成位置」有不同責任：在模塊內生成可避免明文鍵離開保護邊界。因此不能用該項通過或課內誤判取代本單元證據。
quiz.explanationEn: Signing, decryption and export permissions are distinct attributes. Neighboring key-generation location has a different role: In-module generation can avoid plaintext keys leaving the boundary. Its success or the stated misconception cannot replace unit-specific evidence.

steps.title: 鍵生成位置：架構與原理
steps.objective: 針對「鍵生成位置」建立有邊界、可反駁的系統模型。
steps.objectiveEn: For key-generation location, construct a bounded falsifiable system model.
steps.instruction: 觀看師傅的功能示意後，以「鍵生成位置」為中心標出輸入、輸出、信任或資源邊界，並在學徒工作台排列資料流或元件。原理是：在模塊內生成可避免明文鍵離開保護邊界。 使用自行編寫的兩組小型資料或試算表，建立基準與一次只改一項的對照：固定鍵，只改調用身份的權限。 先寫出可被反駁的預測；把「不匯出策略」視為相鄰問題，說明它如何影響模型而不能混同。數值只採本課假想算例或自訂並列明單位；本步保存架構圖、假設表與預測。
steps.instructionEn: After the mentor functional diagram, mark inputs, outputs and trust/resource boundaries around key-generation location, then arrange components or data flows in the apprentice workspace. Principle: In-module generation can avoid plaintext keys leaving the boundary. Create two small authored datasets or spreadsheet cases: a baseline and a one-variable change. Fix keys and vary caller privileges. Predict a falsifiable outcome before evaluating it. Treat nonexportability as a neighboring issue and explain its influence without conflating them. Use only the stated hypothetical case or declared assumed inputs/units. Save the architecture, assumptions and prediction.
steps.observation: 固定鍵，只改調用身份的權限。 比較「鍵生成位置」與「不匯出策略」的證據是否支持相同推論。
steps.observationEn: Fix keys and vary caller privileges. Compare whether evidence for key-generation location and nonexportability supports the same inference.
steps.failure: FIPS 驗證表示任意部署配置都已獲驗證。 這是本課要排除的誤判；先核對模型邊界、來源版本及缺失證據。
steps.failureEn: FIPS validation certifies every possible deployment configuration. This is a misconception to reject; check boundaries, source versions and missing evidence.
steps.check: 提交「鍵生成位置」的功能草圖、基準／擾動表、單位或欄位定義、可反駁預測及接受／保留理由。需能重算本課假想例，並說明相鄰機制不可取代的驗證。
steps.checkEn: Submit a functional sketch, baseline/perturbation table, unit/field definitions, falsifiable prediction and accept/hold rationale for key-generation location. Recompute the course case and explain verification that the neighboring mechanism cannot replace.

knowledge.title: 原理、架構與適用邊界
knowledge.text: 在模塊內生成可避免明文鍵離開保護邊界。
knowledge.textEn: In-module generation can avoid plaintext keys leaving the boundary.

knowledge.title: 相鄰機制與不可混同處
knowledge.text: 相鄰的「不匯出策略」：不可匯出降低外流路徑，但不阻止被授權濫用。 必須另列其證據，不能把這項機制的通過當作「鍵生成位置」已通過。
knowledge.textEn: Neighboring nonexportability: Nonexportability reduces exfiltration paths, not authorized misuse. Record its evidence separately; its success does not prove key-generation location passes.

steps.title: 鍵生成位置：對照試驗與證據
steps.titleEn: Key-generation location: controlled experiment and evidence
steps.objective: 針對「鍵生成位置」完成含競爭原因及不確定度的驗收紀錄。
steps.objectiveEn: For key-generation location, complete acceptance evidence with competing causes and uncertainty.
steps.instruction: 重播本單元示意，讀取自製的基準與擾動紀錄，不接觸未授權目標。對照「在模塊內生成可避免明文鍵離開保護邊界。」，執行下列紙上或本地合成資料試驗：固定鍵，只改調用身份的權限。 分開記錄預測、觀察與不確定度，再提出至少兩個可能原因；利用「不匯出策略」的獨立證據排除一個原因。若結果只來自模型，標記為模擬，不能當作真實設備量測。最後說明目前應接受、保留或拒絕哪一項要求，並保存可重算資料。
steps.instructionEn: Replay the unit diagram and inspect your authored baseline/perturbed records without accessing unauthorized targets. Evaluate the principle: In-module generation can avoid plaintext keys leaving the boundary. Conduct this paper or local synthetic-data experiment: Fix keys and vary caller privileges. Record prediction, observation and uncertainty separately, propose two competing causes and use independent evidence from nonexportability to exclude one. Model outputs must remain labeled simulation, not physical measurements. Explain which requirement to accept, hold or reject and retain recomputable records.

steps.observationEn: Fix keys and vary caller privileges. Compare whether evidence for key-generation location and nonexportability supports the same inference.

steps.failureEn: FIPS validation certifies every possible deployment configuration. This is a misconception to reject; check boundaries, source versions and missing evidence.
steps.check: 提交「鍵生成位置」的功能草圖、基準／擾動表、單位或欄位定義、可反駁預測及接受／保留理由。需能重算本課假想例，並說明相鄰機制不可取代的驗證。

steps.instruction: 觀看師傅的功能示意後，以「容量與排隊」為中心標出輸入、輸出、信任或資源邊界，並在學徒工作台排列資料流或元件。原理是：端到端延遲包括 API、網絡及模塊隊列。 使用自行編寫的兩組小型資料或試算表，建立基準與一次只改一項的對照：固定请求率，只改 API 延遲。 先寫出可被反駁的預測；把「高可用」視為相鄰問題，說明它如何影響模型而不能混同。數值只採本課假想算例或自訂並列明單位；本步保存架構圖、假設表與預測。
steps.instructionEn: After the mentor functional diagram, mark inputs, outputs and trust/resource boundaries around capacity and queues, then arrange components or data flows in the apprentice workspace. Principle: End-to-end delay includes API, network and module queues. Create two small authored datasets or spreadsheet cases: a baseline and a one-variable change. Fix request rate and vary API latency. Predict a falsifiable outcome before evaluating it. Treat high availability as a neighboring issue and explain its influence without conflating them. Use only the stated hypothetical case or declared assumed inputs/units. Save the architecture, assumptions and prediction.
steps.observation: 固定请求率，只改 API 延遲。 比較「容量與排隊」與「高可用」的證據是否支持相同推論。
steps.observationEn: Fix request rate and vary API latency. Compare whether evidence for capacity and queues and high availability supports the same inference.
steps.failure: 使用 HSM 會自動修複所有應用授權錯誤。 這是本課要排除的誤判；先核對模型邊界、來源版本及缺失證據。
steps.failureEn: An HSM automatically repairs all application authorization errors. This is a misconception to reject; check boundaries, source versions and missing evidence.
steps.check: 提交「容量與排隊」的功能草圖、基準／擾動表、單位或欄位定義、可反駁預測及接受／保留理由。需能重算本課假想例，並說明相鄰機制不可取代的驗證。
steps.checkEn: Submit a functional sketch, baseline/perturbation table, unit/field definitions, falsifiable prediction and accept/hold rationale for capacity and queues. Recompute the course case and explain verification that the neighboring mechanism cannot replace.

knowledge.text: 端到端延遲包括 API、網絡及模塊隊列。

knowledge.title: 相鄰機制與不可混同處

knowledge.title: 受控對照與證據品質

options: 使用 HSM 會自動修複所有應用授權錯誤。
只檢查「退役驗證」，便可取代「驗證狀態」的專屬驗證。
模塊證書範圍與當前版本模式必須核對。
optionsEn: An HSM automatically repairs all application authorization errors.
Checking retirement verification alone replaces verification specific to validation status.
Check certification scope against current version/mode.
quiz.explanation: 模塊證書範圍與當前版本模式必須核對。 相鄰的「退役驗證」有不同責任：退役須確認秘密清除與備份處置。因此不能用該項通過或課內誤判取代本單元證據。
quiz.explanationEn: Check certification scope against current version/mode. Neighboring retirement verification has a different role: Retirement verifies secret clearing and backup disposition. Its success or the stated misconception cannot replace unit-specific evidence.

steps.title: 退役驗證：架構與原理
steps.objective: 針對「退役驗證」建立有邊界、可反駁的系統模型。
steps.objectiveEn: For retirement verification, construct a bounded falsifiable system model.
steps.instruction: 觀看師傅的功能示意後，以「退役驗證」為中心標出輸入、輸出、信任或資源邊界，並在學徒工作台排列資料流或元件。原理是：退役須確認秘密清除與備份處置。 使用自行編寫的兩組小型資料或試算表，建立基準與一次只改一項的對照：模擬備援模組不可用及核准恢復。 先寫出可被反駁的預測；把「模組邊界」視為相鄰問題，說明它如何影響模型而不能混同。數值只採本課假想算例或自訂並列明單位；本步保存架構圖、假設表與預測。
steps.instructionEn: After the mentor functional diagram, mark inputs, outputs and trust/resource boundaries around retirement verification, then arrange components or data flows in the apprentice workspace. Principle: Retirement verifies secret clearing and backup disposition. Create two small authored datasets or spreadsheet cases: a baseline and a one-variable change. Model standby-module unavailability and approved recovery. Predict a falsifiable outcome before evaluating it. Treat module boundaries as a neighboring issue and explain its influence without conflating them. Use only the stated hypothetical case or declared assumed inputs/units. Save the architecture, assumptions and prediction.
steps.observation: 模擬備援模組不可用及核准恢復。 比較「退役驗證」與「模組邊界」的證據是否支持相同推論。
steps.observationEn: Model standby-module unavailability and approved recovery. Compare whether evidence for retirement verification and module boundaries supports the same inference.
steps.failure: FIPS 驗證表示任意部署配置都已獲驗證。 這是本課要排除的誤判；先核對模型邊界、來源版本及缺失證據。
steps.failureEn: FIPS validation certifies every possible deployment configuration. This is a misconception to reject; check boundaries, source versions and missing evidence.
steps.check: 提交「退役驗證」的功能草圖、基準／擾動表、單位或欄位定義、可反駁預測及接受／保留理由。需能重算本課假想例，並說明相鄰機制不可取代的驗證。
steps.checkEn: Submit a functional sketch, baseline/perturbation table, unit/field definitions, falsifiable prediction and accept/hold rationale for retirement verification. Recompute the course case and explain verification that the neighboring mechanism cannot replace.

knowledge.title: 原理、架構與適用邊界
knowledge.text: 退役須確認秘密清除與備份處置。
knowledge.textEn: Retirement verifies secret clearing and backup disposition.

knowledge.title: 相鄰機制與不可混同處
knowledge.text: 相鄰的「模組邊界」：安全模組邊界與應用進程邊界不同。 必須另列其證據，不能把這項機制的通過當作「退役驗證」已通過。
knowledge.textEn: Neighboring module boundaries: Security-module and application-process boundaries differ. Record its evidence separately; its success does not prove retirement verification passes.

knowledge.title: 受控對照與證據品質
knowledge.text: 模擬備援模組不可用及核准恢復。 只變一個條件，保留相同資料格式、時間範圍及分母；模型估計與實測證據要分別標記。
knowledge.textEn: Model standby-module unavailability and approved recovery. Change one condition and retain comparable formats, intervals and denominators; label estimates separately from measured evidence.

knowledge.title: 可重算的原創假想例
knowledge.text: 假設單次簽章平均 2 ms，單串行通道理想上限 500 次/s；300 次/s 到達時利用率 60%，排隊與 API 開銷會使實際吞吐降低。
knowledge.textEn: A hypothetical 2 ms signature averages an ideal 500/s serial channel; arrivals at 300/s imply 60% utilization before queues and API overhead.

scope: 公開原理的離線／本地合成資料工程教育。只使用自行生成資料或明確獲授權的測試環境；不提供真實目標掃描、漏洞利用、惡意程式、車輛／工控注入或實際射頻發射程序。數值為原創假設，非供應商保證或現場驗收標準。
scopeEn: Offline/local synthetic-data engineering education from public principles. Use authored data or explicitly authorized test environments only. No real-target scanning, exploitation, malware, vehicle/OT injection or live RF procedures. Numerical cases are original assumptions, not supplier guarantees or field acceptance criteria.

workedExample.title: 原創假想量化例與限制
workedExample.titleEn: Original hypothetical quantitative case and limits
workedExample.text: 假設單次簽章平均 2 ms，單串行通道理想上限 500 次/s；300 次/s 到達時利用率 60%，排隊與 API 開銷會使實際吞吐降低。
workedExample.textEn: A hypothetical 2 ms signature averages an ideal 500/s serial channel; arrivals at 300/s imply 60% utilization before queues and API overhead.
workedExample.assumptions: 只採算例中明列的教學條件；效能與安全估計須依拓撲、分布、開銷、版本與不確定度重算。
workedExample.assumptionsEn: Use only the stated teaching assumptions; recalculate for topology, distribution, overhead, versions and uncertainty.
workedExample.sourceScope: 作者自行設定的教學數值；官方來源支援原理與尺寸規格，未聲稱量測此假想平台。
workedExample.sourceScopeEn: Independently chosen teaching inputs; official sources support principles and specified material sizes, not measurements of this hypothetical platform.

title: 密鑰生命週期管理
summary: 以密鑰狀態、期限與受控更換串連 16 個領域技術單元、32 個保存步驟；分析架構、原理、介面、故障、量化案例與防禦證據。
summaryEn: Sixteen domain-specific technical units and 32 saved steps connect key states, lifetimes and controlled rotation through architecture, principles, interfaces, faults, quantitative cases and defensive evidence.

stages.title: 需求、元件與基本模型
stages.description: 四個領域技術單元各完成原理建模與對照證據，共八項可個別保存的作業。
stages.descriptionEn: Four domain units each pair principle modeling with controlled evidence, producing eight separately saved tasks.

steps.title: 資產關聯：架構與原理
steps.objective: 針對「資產關聯」建立有邊界、可反駁的系統模型。
steps.objectiveEn: For asset associations, construct a bounded falsifiable system model.
steps.instruction: 觀看師傅的功能示意後，以「資產關聯」為中心標出輸入、輸出、信任或資源邊界，並在學徒工作台排列資料流或元件。原理是：每把鍵應有關聯資料、用途與責任人。 使用自行編寫的兩組小型資料或試算表，建立基準與一次只改一項的對照：固定資料，只改鑰的 active/retired 狀態。 先寫出可被反駁的預測；把「狀態機」視為相鄰問題，說明它如何影響模型而不能混同。數值只採本課假想算例或自訂並列明單位；本步保存架構圖、假設表與預測。
steps.instructionEn: After the mentor functional diagram, mark inputs, outputs and trust/resource boundaries around asset associations, then arrange components or data flows in the apprentice workspace. Principle: Each key needs associated data, purpose and owner. Create two small authored datasets or spreadsheet cases: a baseline and a one-variable change. Fix data and vary active/retired key states. Predict a falsifiable outcome before evaluating it. Treat key state machine as a neighboring issue and explain its influence without conflating them. Use only the stated hypothetical case or declared assumed inputs/units. Save the architecture, assumptions and prediction.
steps.observation: 固定資料，只改鑰的 active/retired 狀態。 比較「資產關聯」與「狀態機」的證據是否支持相同推論。
steps.observationEn: Fix data and vary active/retired key states. Compare whether evidence for asset associations and key state machine supports the same inference.
steps.failure: 輪替鍵必須刪除所有舊資料才能成功。 這是本課要排除的誤判；先核對模型邊界、來源版本及缺失證據。
steps.failureEn: Key rotation requires deleting all old data. This is a misconception to reject; check boundaries, source versions and missing evidence.
steps.check: 提交「資產關聯」的功能草圖、基準／擾動表、單位或欄位定義、可反駁預測及接受／保留理由。需能重算本課假想例，並說明相鄰機制不可取代的驗證。
steps.checkEn: Submit a functional sketch, baseline/perturbation table, unit/field definitions, falsifiable prediction and accept/hold rationale for asset associations. Recompute the course case and explain verification that the neighboring mechanism cannot replace.

knowledge.title: 原理、架構與適用邊界
knowledge.text: 每把鍵應有關聯資料、用途與責任人。
knowledge.textEn: Each key needs associated data, purpose and owner.

knowledge.title: 相鄰機制與不可混同處
knowledge.text: 相鄰的「狀態機」：預啟用、啟用與停用的操作資格不同。 必須另列其證據，不能把這項機制的通過當作「資產關聯」已通過。
knowledge.textEn: Neighboring key state machine: Preactive, active and deactivated keys have different operation permissions. Record its evidence separately; its success does not prove asset associations passes.

knowledge.title: 受控對照與證據品質
knowledge.text: 固定資料，只改鑰的 active/retired 狀態。 只變一個條件，保留相同資料格式、時間範圍及分母；模型估計與實測證據要分別標記。
knowledge.textEn: Fix data and vary active/retired key states. Change one condition and retain comparable formats, intervals and denominators; label estimates separately from measured evidence.

knowledge.title: 可重算的原創假想例
knowledge.text: 假想每月新建 100 把資料鍵、每鍵 256 bit，原始鍵材每月 3200 byte；索引、包裝與審計通常更多，不能用 3.2 kB 推算完整 KMS 儲存。
knowledge.textEn: Creating 100 assumed 256-bit data keys monthly produces 3200 bytes of raw key material; metadata, wrapping and audits add storage, so 3.2 kB is not total KMS storage.

knowledge.textEn: Fix data and vary active/retired key states. Change one condition and retain comparable formats, intervals and denominators; label estimates separately from measured evidence.

quiz.question: 針對「熵與生成」的原理與可觀測性，哪項最直接成立？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement most directly explains the principle/observability of entropy and generation?
options: 鍵材需要合適隨機來源，不等於可預測编號。
加密資料有備份就代表解密金鑰可恢復。
只檢查「分發通道」，便可取代「熵與生成」的專屬驗證。
optionsEn: Key material needs suitable randomness, not predictable identifiers.
Backing up ciphertext guarantees key recovery.
Checking distribution channels alone replaces verification specific to entropy and generation.
quiz.explanation: 鍵材需要合適隨機來源，不等於可預測编號。 相鄰的「分發通道」有不同責任：鍵分發要維持來源與機密性。因此不能用該項通過或課內誤判取代本單元證據。
quiz.explanationEn: Key material needs suitable randomness, not predictable identifiers. Neighboring distribution channels has a different role: Key distribution must preserve origin and confidentiality. Its success or the stated misconception cannot replace unit-specific evidence.

steps.title: 熵與生成：對照試驗與證據
steps.titleEn: Entropy and generation: controlled experiment and evidence
steps.objective: 針對「熵與生成」完成含競爭原因及不確定度的驗收紀錄。
steps.objectiveEn: For entropy and generation, complete acceptance evidence with competing causes and uncertainty.
steps.instruction: 重播本單元示意，讀取自製的基準與擾動紀錄，不接觸未授權目標。對照「鍵材需要合適隨機來源，不等於可預測编號。」，執行下列紙上或本地合成資料試驗：固定資料，只改鑰的 active/retired 狀態。 分開記錄預測、觀察與不確定度，再提出至少兩個可能原因；利用「分發通道」的獨立證據排除一個原因。若結果只來自模型，標記為模擬，不能當作真實設備量測。最後說明目前應接受、保留或拒絕哪一項要求，並保存可重算資料。
steps.instructionEn: Replay the unit diagram and inspect your authored baseline/perturbed records without accessing unauthorized targets. Evaluate the principle: Key material needs suitable randomness, not predictable identifiers. Conduct this paper or local synthetic-data experiment: Fix data and vary active/retired key states. Record prediction, observation and uncertainty separately, propose two competing causes and use independent evidence from distribution channels to exclude one. Model outputs must remain labeled simulation, not physical measurements. Explain which requirement to accept, hold or reject and retain recomputable records.
steps.observation: 固定資料，只改鑰的 active/retired 狀態。 比較「熵與生成」與「分發通道」的證據是否支持相同推論。
steps.observationEn: Fix data and vary active/retired key states. Compare whether evidence for entropy and generation and distribution channels supports the same inference.
steps.failure: 加密資料有備份就代表解密金鑰可恢復。 這是本課要排除的誤判；先核對模型邊界、來源版本及缺失證據。
steps.failureEn: Backing up ciphertext guarantees key recovery. This is a misconception to reject; check boundaries, source versions and missing evidence.
steps.check: 提交「熵與生成」的功能草圖、基準／擾動表、單位或欄位定義、可反駁預測及接受／保留理由。需能重算本課假想例，並說明相鄰機制不可取代的驗證。
steps.checkEn: Submit a functional sketch, baseline/perturbation table, unit/field definitions, falsifiable prediction and accept/hold rationale for entropy and generation. Recompute the course case and explain verification that the neighboring mechanism cannot replace.

stages.title: 介面、狀態與資源配置
stages.description: 四個領域技術單元各完成原理建模與對照證據，共八項可個別保存的作業。
stages.descriptionEn: Four domain units each pair principle modeling with controlled evidence, producing eight separately saved tasks.

steps.title: 分發通道：架構與原理
steps.objective: 針對「分發通道」建立有邊界、可反駁的系統模型。
steps.objectiveEn: For distribution channels, construct a bounded falsifiable system model.
steps.instruction: 觀看師傅的功能示意後，以「分發通道」為中心標出輸入、輸出、信任或資源邊界，並在學徒工作台排列資料流或元件。原理是：鍵分發要維持來源與機密性。 使用自行編寫的兩組小型資料或試算表，建立基準與一次只改一項的對照：比較更換資料鍵與更換包裝鍵。 先寫出可被反駁的預測；把「密碼期间」視為相鄰問題，說明它如何影響模型而不能混同。數值只採本課假想算例或自訂並列明單位；本步保存架構圖、假設表與預測。
steps.instructionEn: After the mentor functional diagram, mark inputs, outputs and trust/resource boundaries around distribution channels, then arrange components or data flows in the apprentice workspace. Principle: Key distribution must preserve origin and confidentiality. Create two small authored datasets or spreadsheet cases: a baseline and a one-variable change. Compare rotating data keys with wrapping keys. Predict a falsifiable outcome before evaluating it. Treat cryptoperiods as a neighboring issue and explain its influence without conflating them. Use only the stated hypothetical case or declared assumed inputs/units. Save the architecture, assumptions and prediction.
steps.observation: 比較更換資料鍵與更換包裝鍵。 比較「分發通道」與「密碼期间」的證據是否支持相同推論。
steps.observationEn: Compare rotating data keys with wrapping keys. Compare whether evidence for distribution channels and cryptoperiods supports the same inference.
steps.failure: 輪替鍵必須刪除所有舊資料才能成功。 這是本課要排除的誤判；先核對模型邊界、來源版本及缺失證據。
steps.failureEn: Key rotation requires deleting all old data. This is a misconception to reject; check boundaries, source versions and missing evidence.
steps.check: 提交「分發通道」的功能草圖、基準／擾動表、單位或欄位定義、可反駁預測及接受／保留理由。需能重算本課假想例，並說明相鄰機制不可取代的驗證。
steps.checkEn: Submit a functional sketch, baseline/perturbation table, unit/field definitions, falsifiable prediction and accept/hold rationale for distribution channels. Recompute the course case and explain verification that the neighboring mechanism cannot replace.

knowledge.textEn: Neighboring version identifiers: Ciphertext must identify the correct key version. Record its evidence separately; its success does not prove cryptoperiods passes.

knowledge.title: 受控對照與證據品質
knowledge.text: 比較更換資料鍵與更換包裝鍵。 只變一個條件，保留相同資料格式、時間範圍及分母；模型估計與實測證據要分別標記。
knowledge.textEn: Compare rotating data keys with wrapping keys. Change one condition and retain comparable formats, intervals and denominators; label estimates separately from measured evidence.

quiz.question: 針對「密碼期间」的原理與可觀測性，哪項最直接成立？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement most directly explains the principle/observability of cryptoperiods?
options: 加密資料有備份就代表解密金鑰可恢復。
只檢查「版本識別」，便可取代「密碼期间」的專屬驗證。
使用期限依用途與風險，不能只看位元數。
optionsEn: Backing up ciphertext guarantees key recovery.
Checking version identifiers alone replaces verification specific to cryptoperiods.
Cryptoperiods depend on purpose/risk, not bit length alone.
quiz.explanation: 使用期限依用途與風險，不能只看位元數。 相鄰的「版本識別」有不同責任：密文需能找到正確的鍵版本。因此不能用該項通過或課內誤判取代本單元證據。
quiz.explanationEn: Cryptoperiods depend on purpose/risk, not bit length alone. Neighboring version identifiers has a different role: Ciphertext must identify the correct key version. Its success or the stated misconception cannot replace unit-specific evidence.

steps.title: 版本識別：架構與原理
steps.objective: 針對「版本識別」建立有邊界、可反駁的系統模型。
steps.objectiveEn: For version identifiers, construct a bounded falsifiable system model.
steps.instruction: 觀看師傅的功能示意後，以「版本識別」為中心標出輸入、輸出、信任或資源邊界，並在學徒工作台排列資料流或元件。原理是：密文需能找到正確的鍵版本。 使用自行編寫的兩組小型資料或試算表，建立基準與一次只改一項的對照：比較更換資料鍵與更換包裝鍵。 先寫出可被反駁的預測；把「包絡加密」視為相鄰問題，說明它如何影響模型而不能混同。數值只採本課假想算例或自訂並列明單位；本步保存架構圖、假設表與預測。
steps.instructionEn: After the mentor functional diagram, mark inputs, outputs and trust/resource boundaries around version identifiers, then arrange components or data flows in the apprentice workspace. Principle: Ciphertext must identify the correct key version. Create two small authored datasets or spreadsheet cases: a baseline and a one-variable change. Compare rotating data keys with wrapping keys. Predict a falsifiable outcome before evaluating it. Treat envelope encryption as a neighboring issue and explain its influence without conflating them. Use only the stated hypothetical case or declared assumed inputs/units. Save the architecture, assumptions and prediction.
steps.observation: 比較更換資料鍵與更換包裝鍵。 比較「版本識別」與「包絡加密」的證據是否支持相同推論。
steps.observationEn: Compare rotating data keys with wrapping keys. Compare whether evidence for version identifiers and envelope encryption supports the same inference.
steps.failure: 輪替鍵必須刪除所有舊資料才能成功。 這是本課要排除的誤判；先核對模型邊界、來源版本及缺失證據。
steps.failureEn: Key rotation requires deleting all old data. This is a misconception to reject; check boundaries, source versions and missing evidence.
steps.check: 提交「版本識別」的功能草圖、基準／擾動表、單位或欄位定義、可反駁預測及接受／保留理由。需能重算本課假想例，並說明相鄰機制不可取代的驗證。
steps.checkEn: Submit a functional sketch, baseline/perturbation table, unit/field definitions, falsifiable prediction and accept/hold rationale for version identifiers. Recompute the course case and explain verification that the neighboring mechanism cannot replace.

knowledge.text: 包裝鍵保護資料鍵，建立兩層生命周期。

knowledge.text: 相鄰的「輪替範圍」：更換包裝鍵與重新加密全部資料成本不同。 必須另列其證據，不能把這項機制的通過當作「包絡加密」已通過。
knowledge.textEn: Neighboring rotation scope: Rewrapping and reencrypting all data have different costs. Record its evidence separately; its success does not prove envelope encryption passes.

knowledge.title: 可重算的原創假想例
knowledge.text: 假想每月新建 100 把資料鍵、每鍵 256 bit，原始鍵材每月 3200 byte；索引、包裝與審計通常更多，不能用 3.2 kB 推算完整 KMS 儲存。
knowledge.textEn: Creating 100 assumed 256-bit data keys monthly produces 3200 bytes of raw key material; metadata, wrapping and audits add storage, so 3.2 kB is not total KMS storage.

輪替鍵必須刪除所有舊資料才能成功。
只檢查「備份一致性」，便可取代「事故範圍」的專屬驗證。
optionsEn: Trace which data a compromised key protects.
Key rotation requires deleting all old data.
Checking backup consistency alone replaces verification specific to incident scope.
quiz.explanation: 遭泄露鍵關聯哪些資料必須可追溯。 相鄰的「備份一致性」有不同責任：備份密文、鍵版本與包裝資料應可配對。因此不能用該項通過或課內誤判取代本單元證據。
quiz.explanationEn: Trace which data a compromised key protects. Neighboring backup consistency has a different role: Backed-up ciphertext, key versions and wrappers must match. Its success or the stated misconception cannot replace unit-specific evidence.

steps.title: 備份一致性：架構與原理
steps.objective: 針對「備份一致性」建立有邊界、可反駁的系統模型。

knowledge.textEn: Neighboring asset associations: Each key needs associated data, purpose and owner. Record its evidence separately; its success does not prove destruction evidence passes.

knowledge.title: 受控對照與證據品質
knowledge.text: 模擬一個鍵遭撤銷後的历史資料讀取。 只變一個條件，保留相同資料格式、時間範圍及分母；模型估計與實測證據要分別標記。
knowledge.textEn: Model historical reads after one key is revoked. Change one condition and retain comparable formats, intervals and denominators; label estimates separately from measured evidence.

knowledge.title: 可重算的原創假想例
knowledge.text: 假想每月新建 100 把資料鍵、每鍵 256 bit，原始鍵材每月 3200 byte；索引、包裝與審計通常更多，不能用 3.2 kB 推算完整 KMS 儲存。
knowledge.textEn: Creating 100 assumed 256-bit data keys monthly produces 3200 bytes of raw key material; metadata, wrapping and audits add storage, so 3.2 kB is not total KMS storage.

quiz.question: 針對「銷毁證明」的原理與可觀測性，哪項最直接成立？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement most directly explains the principle/observability of destruction evidence?
options: 刪除索引不等於所有備份秘密已被清除。
加密資料有備份就代表解密金鑰可恢復。
只檢查「資產關聯」，便可取代「銷毁證明」的專屬驗證。
optionsEn: Deleting an index does not clear every backed-up secret.
Backing up ciphertext guarantees key recovery.
Checking asset associations alone replaces verification specific to destruction evidence.
quiz.explanation: 刪除索引不等於所有備份秘密已被清除。 相鄰的「資產關聯」有不同責任：每把鍵應有關聯資料、用途與責任人。因此不能用該項通過或課內誤判取代本單元證據。
quiz.explanationEn: Deleting an index does not clear every backed-up secret. Neighboring asset associations has a different role: Each key needs associated data, purpose and owner. Its success or the stated misconception cannot replace unit-specific evidence.

steps.title: 銷毁證明：對照試驗與證據
steps.titleEn: Destruction evidence: controlled experiment and evidence
steps.objective: 針對「銷毁證明」完成含競爭原因及不確定度的驗收紀錄。
steps.objectiveEn: For destruction evidence, complete acceptance evidence with competing causes and uncertainty.
steps.instruction: 重播本單元示意，讀取自製的基準與擾動紀錄，不接觸未授權目標。對照「刪除索引不等於所有備份秘密已被清除。」，執行下列紙上或本地合成資料試驗：模擬一個鍵遭撤銷後的历史資料讀取。 分開記錄預測、觀察與不確定度，再提出至少兩個可能原因；利用「資產關聯」的獨立證據排除一個原因。若結果只來自模型，標記為模擬，不能當作真實設備量測。最後說明目前應接受、保留或拒絕哪一項要求，並保存可重算資料。
steps.instructionEn: Replay the unit diagram and inspect your authored baseline/perturbed records without accessing unauthorized targets. Evaluate the principle: Deleting an index does not clear every backed-up secret. Conduct this paper or local synthetic-data experiment: Model historical reads after one key is revoked. Record prediction, observation and uncertainty separately, propose two competing causes and use independent evidence from asset associations to exclude one. Model outputs must remain labeled simulation, not physical measurements. Explain which requirement to accept, hold or reject and retain recomputable records.
steps.observation: 模擬一個鍵遭撤銷後的历史資料讀取。 比較「銷毁證明」與「資產關聯」的證據是否支持相同推論。
steps.observationEn: Model historical reads after one key is revoked. Compare whether evidence for destruction evidence and asset associations supports the same inference.
steps.failure: 加密資料有備份就代表解密金鑰可恢復。 這是本課要排除的誤判；先核對模型邊界、來源版本及缺失證據。
steps.failureEn: Backing up ciphertext guarantees key recovery. This is a misconception to reject; check boundaries, source versions and missing evidence.
steps.check: 提交「銷毁證明」的功能草圖、基準／擾動表、單位或欄位定義、可反駁預測及接受／保留理由。需能重算本課假想例，並說明相鄰機制不可取代的驗證。
steps.checkEn: Submit a functional sketch, baseline/perturbation table, unit/field definitions, falsifiable prediction and accept/hold rationale for destruction evidence. Recompute the course case and explain verification that the neighboring mechanism cannot replace.

scope: 公開原理的離線／本地合成資料工程教育。只使用自行生成資料或明確獲授權的測試環境；不提供真實目標掃描、漏洞利用、惡意程式、車輛／工控注入或實際射頻發射程序。數值為原創假設，非供應商保證或現場驗收標準。
scopeEn: Offline/local synthetic-data engineering education from public principles. Use authored data or explicitly authorized test environments only. No real-target scanning, exploitation, malware, vehicle/OT injection or live RF procedures. Numerical cases are original assumptions, not supplier guarantees or field acceptance criteria.

workedExample.title: 原創假想量化例與限制

workedExample.text: 假想每月新建 100 把資料鍵、每鍵 256 bit，原始鍵材每月 3200 byte；索引、包裝與審計通常更多，不能用 3.2 kB 推算完整 KMS 儲存。

workedExample.assumptions: 只採算例中明列的教學條件；效能與安全估計須依拓撲、分布、開銷、版本與不確定度重算。
workedExample.assumptionsEn: Use only the stated teaching assumptions; recalculate for topology, distribution, overhead, versions and uncertainty.
workedExample.sourceScope: 作者自行設定的教學數值；官方來源支援原理與尺寸規格，未聲稱量測此假想平台。
workedExample.sourceScopeEn: Independently chosen teaching inputs; official sources support principles and specified material sizes, not measurements of this hypothetical platform.

title: TLS 憑證自動化
summary: 以域名授權、憑證續期與部署一致性串連 16 個領域技術單元、32 個保存步驟；分析架構、原理、介面、故障、量化案例與防禦證據。
summaryEn: Sixteen domain-specific technical units and 32 saved steps connect domain authorization, certificate renewal and deployment consistency through architecture, principles, interfaces, faults, quantitative cases and defensive evidence.

stages.title: 需求、元件與基本模型
stages.description: 四個領域技術單元各完成原理建模與對照證據，共八項可個別保存的作業。
stages.descriptionEn: Four domain units each pair principle modeling with controlled evidence, producing eight separately saved tasks.

steps.title: ACME 角色：架構與原理
steps.objective: 針對「ACME 角色」建立有邊界、可反駁的系統模型。
steps.objectiveEn: For acme roles, construct a bounded falsifiable system model.
steps.instruction: 觀看師傅的功能示意後，以「ACME 角色」為中心標出輸入、輸出、信任或資源邊界，並在學徒工作台排列資料流或元件。原理是：客戶端、帳戶與 CA 之间有不同對象責任。 使用自行編寫的兩組小型資料或試算表，建立基準與一次只改一項的對照：固定域名，只改 challenge 回應是否正確。 先寫出可被反駁的預測；把「帳戶憑據」視為相鄰問題，說明它如何影響模型而不能混同。數值只採本課假想算例或自訂並列明單位；本步保存架構圖、假設表與預測。
steps.instructionEn: After the mentor functional diagram, mark inputs, outputs and trust/resource boundaries around acme roles, then arrange components or data flows in the apprentice workspace. Principle: Clients, accounts and CAs have different object responsibilities. Create two small authored datasets or spreadsheet cases: a baseline and a one-variable change. Fix domain and vary challenge response validity. Predict a falsifiable outcome before evaluating it. Treat account credentials as a neighboring issue and explain its influence without conflating them. Use only the stated hypothetical case or declared assumed inputs/units. Save the architecture, assumptions and prediction.
steps.observation: 固定域名，只改 challenge 回應是否正確。 比較「ACME 角色」與「帳戶憑據」的證據是否支持相同推論。
steps.observationEn: Fix domain and vary challenge response validity. Compare whether evidence for acme roles and account credentials supports the same inference.
steps.failure: 簽發成功表示所有服務節點已更新。 這是本課要排除的誤判；先核對模型邊界、來源版本及缺失證據。
steps.failureEn: Successful issuance proves every service node is updated. This is a misconception to reject; check boundaries, source versions and missing evidence.
steps.check: 提交「ACME 角色」的功能草圖、基準／擾動表、單位或欄位定義、可反駁預測及接受／保留理由。需能重算本課假想例，並說明相鄰機制不可取代的驗證。
steps.checkEn: Submit a functional sketch, baseline/perturbation table, unit/field definitions, falsifiable prediction and accept/hold rationale for acme roles. Recompute the course case and explain verification that the neighboring mechanism cannot replace.

knowledge.text: 客戶端、帳戶與 CA 之间有不同對象責任。

knowledge.text: 相鄰的「帳戶憑據」：ACME 帳戶鍵與 TLS 服務私鍵並不相同。 必須另列其證據，不能把這項機制的通過當作「ACME 角色」已通過。

knowledge.title: 可重算的原創假想例
knowledge.text: 假想憑證有效 90 日、到第 60 日開始续期，可用续期窗口 30 日；若每 12 h 尝试，理想有 60 次機會，不能假設這些尝试獨立或都成功。
knowledge.textEn: An assumed 90-day certificate renewed from day 60 leaves 30 days; attempts every 12 h give 60 nominal opportunities, not necessarily independent or successful.

quiz.question: 針對「域名授權」的原理與可觀測性，哪項最直接成立？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement most directly explains the principle/observability of domain authorization?

取得憑證等於取得網站全部業務授權。
只檢查「Challenge 類型」，便可取代「域名授權」的專屬驗證。

Obtaining a certificate grants all website business permissions.
Checking challenge types alone replaces verification specific to domain authorization.

stages.title: 介面、狀態與資源配置
stages.description: 四個領域技術單元各完成原理建模與對照證據，共八項可個別保存的作業。
stages.descriptionEn: Four domain units each pair principle modeling with controlled evidence, producing eight separately saved tasks.

steps.title: Challenge 類型：架構與原理
steps.objective: 針對「Challenge 類型」建立有邊界、可反駁的系統模型。
steps.objectiveEn: For challenge types, construct a bounded falsifiable system model.
steps.instruction: 觀看師傅的功能示意後，以「Challenge 類型」為中心標出輸入、輸出、信任或資源邊界，並在學徒工作台排列資料流或元件。原理是：不同挑战要求不同可達性或 DNS 控制。 使用自行編寫的兩組小型資料或試算表，建立基準與一次只改一項的對照：比較已簽發但未部署與已部署憑證。 先寫出可被反駁的預測；把「CSR 與鍵」視為相鄰問題，說明它如何影響模型而不能混同。數值只採本課假想算例或自訂並列明單位；本步保存架構圖、假設表與預測。
steps.instructionEn: After the mentor functional diagram, mark inputs, outputs and trust/resource boundaries around challenge types, then arrange components or data flows in the apprentice workspace. Principle: Different challenges need different reachability/DNS control. Create two small authored datasets or spreadsheet cases: a baseline and a one-variable change. Compare issued-but-undeployed versus deployed certificates. Predict a falsifiable outcome before evaluating it. Treat csr and keys as a neighboring issue and explain its influence without conflating them. Use only the stated hypothetical case or declared assumed inputs/units. Save the architecture, assumptions and prediction.
steps.observation: 比較已簽發但未部署與已部署憑證。 比較「Challenge 類型」與「CSR 與鍵」的證據是否支持相同推論。
steps.observationEn: Compare issued-but-undeployed versus deployed certificates. Compare whether evidence for challenge types and csr and keys supports the same inference.
steps.failure: 簽發成功表示所有服務節點已更新。 這是本課要排除的誤判；先核對模型邊界、來源版本及缺失證據。
steps.failureEn: Successful issuance proves every service node is updated. This is a misconception to reject; check boundaries, source versions and missing evidence.
steps.check: 提交「Challenge 類型」的功能草圖、基準／擾動表、單位或欄位定義、可反駁預測及接受／保留理由。需能重算本課假想例，並說明相鄰機制不可取代的驗證。
steps.checkEn: Submit a functional sketch, baseline/perturbation table, unit/field definitions, falsifiable prediction and accept/hold rationale for challenge types. Recompute the course case and explain verification that the neighboring mechanism cannot replace.
