steps.instruction: 觀看師傅的功能示意後，以「服務重載」為中心標出輸入、輸出、信任或資源邊界，並在學徒工作台排列資料流或元件。原理是：磁碟文件更新不保證進程已使用新鏈。 使用自行編寫的兩組小型資料或試算表，建立基準與一次只改一項的對照：固定有效期，只改续期服務中斷時長。 先寫出可被反駁的預測；把「監測到期」視為相鄰問題，說明它如何影響模型而不能混同。數值只採本課假想算例或自訂並列明單位；本步保存架構圖、假設表與預測。
steps.instructionEn: After the mentor functional diagram, mark inputs, outputs and trust/resource boundaries around service reload, then arrange components or data flows in the apprentice workspace. Principle: Updated files do not prove running processes use the new chain. Create two small authored datasets or spreadsheet cases: a baseline and a one-variable change. Fix validity and vary renewal-service outage duration. Predict a falsifiable outcome before evaluating it. Treat expiry monitoring as a neighboring issue and explain its influence without conflating them. Use only the stated hypothetical case or declared assumed inputs/units. Save the architecture, assumptions and prediction.
steps.observation: 固定有效期，只改续期服務中斷時長。 比較「服務重載」與「監測到期」的證據是否支持相同推論。
steps.observationEn: Fix validity and vary renewal-service outage duration. Compare whether evidence for service reload and expiry monitoring supports the same inference.
steps.failure: 取得憑證等於取得網站全部業務授權。 這是本課要排除的誤判；先核對模型邊界、來源版本及缺失證據。
steps.failureEn: Obtaining a certificate grants all website business permissions. This is a misconception to reject; check boundaries, source versions and missing evidence.
steps.check: 提交「服務重載」的功能草圖、基準／擾動表、單位或欄位定義、可反駁預測及接受／保留理由。需能重算本課假想例，並說明相鄰機制不可取代的驗證。

knowledge.title: 原理、架構與適用邊界
knowledge.text: 磁碟文件更新不保證進程已使用新鏈。

knowledge.title: 相鄰機制與不可混同處
knowledge.text: 相鄰的「監測到期」：到期監測應讀取實際服務的憑證。 必須另列其證據，不能把這項機制的通過當作「服務重載」已通過。
knowledge.textEn: Neighboring expiry monitoring: Expiry monitoring inspects certificates actually served. Record its evidence separately; its success does not prove service reload passes.

knowledge.title: 受控對照與證據品質

只檢查「監測到期」，便可取代「服務重載」的專屬驗證。
磁碟文件更新不保證進程已使用新鏈。

Checking expiry monitoring alone replaces verification specific to service reload.
Updated files do not prove running processes use the new chain.

title: 後量子密碼遷移
summary: 以後量子演算法角色、資產盤點與遷移串連 16 個領域技術單元、32 個保存步驟；分析架構、原理、介面、故障、量化案例與防禦證據。
summaryEn: Sixteen domain-specific technical units and 32 saved steps connect post-quantum algorithm roles, inventory and migration through architecture, principles, interfaces, faults, quantitative cases and defensive evidence.

stages.title: 需求、元件與基本模型
stages.description: 四個領域技術單元各完成原理建模與對照證據，共八項可個別保存的作業。
stages.descriptionEn: Four domain units each pair principle modeling with controlled evidence, producing eight separately saved tasks.

steps.title: 風險時間線：架構與原理
steps.objective: 針對「風險時間線」建立有邊界、可反駁的系統模型。
steps.objectiveEn: For risk timelines, construct a bounded falsifiable system model.
steps.instruction: 觀看師傅的功能示意後，以「風險時間線」為中心標出輸入、輸出、信任或資源邊界，並在學徒工作台排列資料流或元件。原理是：長保存秘密需考慮今天收集未來解密風險。 使用自行編寫的兩組小型資料或試算表，建立基準與一次只改一項的對照：固定安全目標，只改 KEM 與簽章用途。 先寫出可被反駁的預測；把「密碼盤點」視為相鄰問題，說明它如何影響模型而不能混同。數值只採本課假想算例或自訂並列明單位；本步保存架構圖、假設表與預測。
steps.instructionEn: After the mentor functional diagram, mark inputs, outputs and trust/resource boundaries around risk timelines, then arrange components or data flows in the apprentice workspace. Principle: Long-lived secrets need harvest-now/decrypt-later risk analysis. Create two small authored datasets or spreadsheet cases: a baseline and a one-variable change. Fix goals and compare KEM versus signature roles. Predict a falsifiable outcome before evaluating it. Treat cryptographic inventory as a neighboring issue and explain its influence without conflating them. Use only the stated hypothetical case or declared assumed inputs/units. Save the architecture, assumptions and prediction.
steps.observation: 固定安全目標，只改 KEM 與簽章用途。 比較「風險時間線」與「密碼盤點」的證據是否支持相同推論。
steps.observationEn: Fix goals and compare KEM versus signature roles. Compare whether evidence for risk timelines and cryptographic inventory supports the same inference.
steps.failure: ML-KEM 直接提供任意長度資料的數字簽章。 這是本課要排除的誤判；先核對模型邊界、來源版本及缺失證據。
steps.failureEn: ML-KEM directly signs arbitrary-length data. This is a misconception to reject; check boundaries, source versions and missing evidence.
steps.check: 提交「風險時間線」的功能草圖、基準／擾動表、單位或欄位定義、可反駁預測及接受／保留理由。需能重算本課假想例，並說明相鄰機制不可取代的驗證。
steps.checkEn: Submit a functional sketch, baseline/perturbation table, unit/field definitions, falsifiable prediction and accept/hold rationale for risk timelines. Recompute the course case and explain verification that the neighboring mechanism cannot replace.

knowledge.title: 可重算的原創假想例
knowledge.text: ML-KEM-768 的公鑰為 1184 byte、ciphertext 為 1088 byte，合計傳輸鍵材為 2272 byte。二者通常在不同方向／協議訊息傳送，不能當成單一 IP 封包；每份鍵材本身均小於假想 1500 byte MTU，仍須逐訊息計入協議標頭並區分 MTU 與 TCP MSS。

knowledge.title: 可重算的原創假想例
knowledge.text: ML-KEM-768 的公鑰為 1184 byte、ciphertext 為 1088 byte，合計傳輸鍵材為 2272 byte。二者通常在不同方向／協議訊息傳送，不能當成單一 IP 封包；每份鍵材本身均小於假想 1500 byte MTU，仍須逐訊息計入協議標頭並區分 MTU 與 TCP MSS。

steps.instruction: 觀看師傅的功能示意後，以「驗證向量」為中心標出輸入、輸出、信任或資源邊界，並在學徒工作台排列資料流或元件。原理是：已知答案測试驗證實作，不能證明所有路徑無錯。 使用自行編寫的兩組小型資料或試算表，建立基準與一次只改一項的對照：模擬不支持新格式客戶端的受控遷移。 先寫出可被反駁的預測；把「遷移試點」視為相鄰問題，說明它如何影響模型而不能混同。數值只採本課假想算例或自訂並列明單位；本步保存架構圖、假設表與預測。

Model controlled migration for clients lacking new formats. Predict a falsifiable outcome before evaluating it. Treat migration pilots as a neighboring issue and explain its influence without conflating them. Use only the stated hypothetical case or declared assumed inputs/units. Save the architecture, assumptions and prediction.

scope: 公開原理的離線／本地合成資料工程教育。只使用自行生成資料或明確獲授權的測試環境；不提供真實目標掃描、漏洞利用、惡意程式、車輛／工控注入或實際射頻發射程序。數值為原創假設，非供應商保證或現場驗收標準。
scopeEn: Offline/local synthetic-data engineering education from public principles. Use authored data or explicitly authorized test environments only. No real-target scanning, exploitation, malware, vehicle/OT injection or live RF procedures. Numerical cases are original assumptions, not supplier guarantees or field acceptance criteria.

workedExample.title: 原創假想量化例與限制
workedExample.titleEn: Original hypothetical quantitative case and limits
workedExample.text: ML-KEM-768 的公鑰為 1184 byte、ciphertext 為 1088 byte，合計傳輸鍵材為 2272 byte。二者通常在不同方向／協議訊息傳送，不能當成單一 IP 封包；每份鍵材本身均小於假想 1500 byte MTU，仍須逐訊息計入協議標頭並區分 MTU 與 TCP MSS。
workedExample.textEn: ML-KEM-768 has a 1184-byte public key and 1088-byte ciphertext, totaling 2272 bytes of key-establishment material. They normally travel in different directions/messages, not one IP packet; each alone is below an assumed 1500-byte MTU. Evaluate actual message framing and distinguish MTU from TCP MSS.
workedExample.assumptions: 只採算例中明列的教學條件；效能與安全估計須依拓撲、分布、開銷、版本與不確定度重算。
workedExample.assumptionsEn: Use only the stated teaching assumptions; recalculate for topology, distribution, overhead, versions and uncertainty.
workedExample.sourceScope: 作者自行設定的教學數值；官方來源支援原理與尺寸規格，未聲稱量測此假想平台。
workedExample.sourceScopeEn: Independently chosen teaching inputs; official sources support principles and specified material sizes, not measurements of this hypothetical platform.

title: 安全電子郵件閘道
summary: 以郵件身份、網域對齊與隔離判讀串連 16 個領域技術單元、32 個保存步驟；分析架構、原理、介面、故障、量化案例與防禦證據。
summaryEn: Sixteen domain-specific technical units and 32 saved steps connect mail identity, domain alignment and quarantine analysis through architecture, principles, interfaces, faults, quantitative cases and defensive evidence.

stages.title: 需求、元件與基本模型
stages.description: 四個領域技術單元各完成原理建模與對照證據，共八項可個別保存的作業。
stages.descriptionEn: Four domain units each pair principle modeling with controlled evidence, producing eight separately saved tasks.

steps.title: Envelope 與 From：架構與原理
steps.titleEn: Envelope and From: architecture and principle
steps.objective: 針對「Envelope 與 From」建立有邊界、可反駁的系統模型。
steps.objectiveEn: For envelope and from, construct a bounded falsifiable system model.
steps.instruction: 觀看師傅的功能示意後，以「Envelope 與 From」為中心標出輸入、輸出、信任或資源邊界，並在學徒工作台排列資料流或元件。原理是：傳輸寄件身分與可見 From 可能不同。 使用自行編寫的兩組小型資料或試算表，建立基準與一次只改一項的對照：固定郵件內容，只改 envelope 與 From 網域。 先寫出可被反駁的預測；把「SPF 邊界」視為相鄰問題，說明它如何影響模型而不能混同。數值只採本課假想算例或自訂並列明單位；本步保存架構圖、假設表與預測。
steps.instructionEn: After the mentor functional diagram, mark inputs, outputs and trust/resource boundaries around envelope and from, then arrange components or data flows in the apprentice workspace. Principle: Transport sender identity can differ from visible From. Create two small authored datasets or spreadsheet cases: a baseline and a one-variable change. Fix content and vary envelope/From domains. Predict a falsifiable outcome before evaluating it. Treat spf boundaries as a neighboring issue and explain its influence without conflating them. Use only the stated hypothetical case or declared assumed inputs/units. Save the architecture, assumptions and prediction.
steps.observation: 固定郵件內容，只改 envelope 與 From 網域。 比較「Envelope 與 From」與「SPF 邊界」的證據是否支持相同推論。
steps.observationEn: Fix content and vary envelope/From domains. Compare whether evidence for envelope and from and spf boundaries supports the same inference.
steps.failure: SPF 通過表示郵件所有內容必定安全。 這是本課要排除的誤判；先核對模型邊界、來源版本及缺失證據。
steps.failureEn: SPF pass proves all message content safe. This is a misconception to reject; check boundaries, source versions and missing evidence.
steps.check: 提交「Envelope 與 From」的功能草圖、基準／擾動表、單位或欄位定義、可反駁預測及接受／保留理由。需能重算本課假想例，並說明相鄰機制不可取代的驗證。
steps.checkEn: Submit a functional sketch, baseline/perturbation table, unit/field definitions, falsifiable prediction and accept/hold rationale for envelope and from. Recompute the course case and explain verification that the neighboring mechanism cannot replace.

knowledge.title: 原理、架構與適用邊界
knowledge.text: 傳輸寄件身分與可見 From 可能不同。
knowledge.textEn: Transport sender identity can differ from visible From.

knowledge.title: 相鄰機制與不可混同處
knowledge.text: 相鄰的「SPF 邊界」：SPF 驗證網域授權發送 IP，不分析全部內容。 必須另列其證據，不能把這項機制的通過當作「Envelope 與 From」已通過。

knowledge.title: 受控對照與證據品質
knowledge.text: 固定郵件內容，只改 envelope 與 From 網域。 只變一個條件，保留相同資料格式、時間範圍及分母；模型估計與實測證據要分別標記。
knowledge.textEn: Fix content and vary envelope/From domains. Change one condition and retain comparable formats, intervals and denominators; label estimates separately from measured evidence.

knowledge.title: 可重算的原創假想例
knowledge.text: 假想每日 10000 封、100 封惡意；規則偵測 90 封且誤標正常信 99 封，precision=90/(90+99)=47.62%，recall=90%。高 recall 仍可能有大量誤攔。
knowledge.textEn: Of 10000 hypothetical messages, 100 malicious, detecting 90 with 99 benign false alarms gives precision=47.62% and recall=90%; high recall can coexist with many false blocks.

steps.failureEn: SPF pass proves all message content safe. This is a misconception to reject; check boundaries, source versions and missing evidence.
steps.check: 提交「Envelope 與 From」的功能草圖、基準／擾動表、單位或欄位定義、可反駁預測及接受／保留理由。需能重算本課假想例，並說明相鄰機制不可取代的驗證。

steps.title: 報告資料：架構與原理
steps.objective: 針對「報告資料」建立有邊界、可反駁的系統模型。

steps.instruction: 觀看師傅的功能示意後，以「報告資料」為中心標出輸入、輸出、信任或資源邊界，並在學徒工作台排列資料流或元件。原理是：彙總與逐封失敗報告範圍不同；須最小化個資並核對來源。 使用自行編寫的兩組小型資料或試算表，建立基準與一次只改一項的對照：比較簽章後內容被改動與未改動的合成記錄。 先寫出可被反駁的預測；把「附件分析」視為相鄰問題，說明它如何影響模型而不能混同。數值只採本課假想算例或自訂並列明單位；本步保存架構圖、假設表與預測。

knowledge.title: 相鄰機制與不可混同處
knowledge.text: 相鄰的「信任邊界」：跨邊界輸入須依格式與用途驗證。 必須另列其證據，不能把這項機制的通過當作「應用資產」已通過。
knowledge.textEn: Neighboring trust boundaries: Boundary-crossing input needs format/purpose validation. Record its evidence separately; its success does not prove application assets passes.

knowledge.title: 受控對照與證據品質
knowledge.text: 固定規則，只改正常輸入的格式變體。 只變一個條件，保留相同資料格式、時間範圍及分母；模型估計與實測證據要分別標記。
knowledge.textEn: Fix rules and vary benign input formatting. Change one condition and retain comparable formats, intervals and denominators; label estimates separately from measured evidence.

knowledge.title: 可重算的原創假想例
knowledge.text: 假想每秒 2000 請求，每請求純檢查消耗平均 0.4 ms CPU 時間（不是含等待的經過時間），需求為 0.8 CPU-s/s；單核心理想利用率 80%，未計 TLS、排隊與多執行緒額外成本。
knowledge.textEn: Assume 2000 requests/s and 0.4 ms CPU time per inspection, not elapsed time including waits: demand is 0.8 CPU-s/s, an ideal 80% single-core load before TLS, queues and additional threading costs.

quiz.question: 針對「應用資產」的原理與可觀測性，哪項最直接成立？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement most directly explains the principle/observability of application assets?
options: 先界定資料與動作，才可驗證保護要求。
部署 WAF 後就不需應用端授權。
只檢查「信任邊界」，便可取代「應用資產」的專屬驗證。
optionsEn: Define data/actions before verifying protection requirements.
A WAF removes the need for application authorization.
Checking trust boundaries alone replaces verification specific to application assets.

quiz.explanationEn: Define data/actions before verifying protection requirements. Neighboring trust boundaries has a different role: Boundary-crossing input needs format/purpose validation. Its success or the stated misconception cannot replace unit-specific evidence.

steps.title: 應用資產：對照試驗與證據
steps.titleEn: Application assets: controlled experiment and evidence
steps.objective: 針對「應用資產」完成含競爭原因及不確定度的驗收紀錄。
steps.objectiveEn: For application assets, complete acceptance evidence with competing causes and uncertainty.
steps.instruction: 重播本單元示意，讀取自製的基準與擾動紀錄，不接觸未授權目標。對照「先界定資料與動作，才可驗證保護要求。」，執行下列紙上或本地合成資料試驗：固定規則，只改正常輸入的格式變體。 分開記錄預測、觀察與不確定度，再提出至少兩個可能原因；利用「信任邊界」的獨立證據排除一個原因。若結果只來自模型，標記為模擬，不能當作真實設備量測。最後說明目前應接受、保留或拒絕哪一項要求，並保存可重算資料。
steps.instructionEn: Replay the unit diagram and inspect your authored baseline/perturbed records without accessing unauthorized targets. Evaluate the principle: Define data/actions before verifying protection requirements. Conduct this paper or local synthetic-data experiment: Fix rules and vary benign input formatting. Record prediction, observation and uncertainty separately, propose two competing causes and use independent evidence from trust boundaries to exclude one. Model outputs must remain labeled simulation, not physical measurements. Explain which requirement to accept, hold or reject and retain recomputable records.
steps.observation: 固定規則，只改正常輸入的格式變體。 比較「應用資產」與「信任邊界」的證據是否支持相同推論。
steps.observationEn: Fix rules and vary benign input formatting. Compare whether evidence for application assets and trust boundaries supports the same inference.
steps.failure: 部署 WAF 後就不需應用端授權。 這是本課要排除的誤判；先核對模型邊界、來源版本及缺失證據。
steps.failureEn: A WAF removes the need for application authorization. This is a misconception to reject; check boundaries, source versions and missing evidence.
steps.check: 提交「應用資產」的功能草圖、基準／擾動表、單位或欄位定義、可反駁預測及接受／保留理由。需能重算本課假想例，並說明相鄰機制不可取代的驗證。
steps.checkEn: Submit a functional sketch, baseline/perturbation table, unit/field definitions, falsifiable prediction and accept/hold rationale for application assets. Recompute the course case and explain verification that the neighboring mechanism cannot replace.

steps.title: 信任邊界：架構與原理
steps.objective: 針對「信任邊界」建立有邊界、可反駁的系統模型。
steps.objectiveEn: For trust boundaries, construct a bounded falsifiable system model.
steps.instruction: 觀看師傅的功能示意後，以「信任邊界」為中心標出輸入、輸出、信任或資源邊界，並在學徒工作台排列資料流或元件。原理是：跨邊界輸入須依格式與用途驗證。 使用自行編寫的兩組小型資料或試算表，建立基準與一次只改一項的對照：固定規則，只改正常輸入的格式變體。 先寫出可被反駁的預測；把「授權責任」視為相鄰問題，說明它如何影響模型而不能混同。數值只採本課假想算例或自訂並列明單位；本步保存架構圖、假設表與預測。

Principle: Boundary-crossing input needs format/purpose validation. Create two small authored datasets or spreadsheet cases: a baseline and a one-variable change. Fix rules and vary benign input formatting. Predict a falsifiable outcome before evaluating it. Treat authorization responsibilities as a neighboring issue and explain its influence without conflating them. Use only the stated hypothetical case or declared assumed inputs/units. Save the architecture, assumptions and prediction.

steps.failureEn: Higher rejection rates necessarily mean greater security. This is a misconception to reject; check boundaries, source versions and missing evidence.
steps.check: 提交「信任邊界」的功能草圖、基準／擾動表、單位或欄位定義、可反駁預測及接受／保留理由。需能重算本課假想例，並說明相鄰機制不可取代的驗證。
steps.checkEn: Submit a functional sketch, baseline/perturbation table, unit/field definitions, falsifiable prediction and accept/hold rationale for trust boundaries. Recompute the course case and explain verification that the neighboring mechanism cannot replace.

steps.title: 防護驗收：架構與原理
steps.objective: 針對「防護驗收」建立有邊界、可反駁的系統模型。
steps.objectiveEn: For protection acceptance, construct a bounded falsifiable system model.
steps.instruction: 觀看師傅的功能示意後，以「防護驗收」為中心標出輸入、輸出、信任或資源邊界，並在學徒工作台排列資料流或元件。原理是：正常、邊界與合成異常案例均需覆蓋。 使用自行編寫的兩組小型資料或試算表，建立基準與一次只改一項的對照：模擬規則更新後可審查的回滾。 先寫出可被反駁的預測；把「應用資產」視為相鄰問題，說明它如何影響模型而不能混同。數值只採本課假想算例或自訂並列明單位；本步保存架構圖、假設表與預測。

title: 企業端點偵測與回應

Predict a falsifiable outcome before evaluating it. Treat process events as a neighboring issue and explain its influence without conflating them. Use only the stated hypothetical case or declared assumed inputs/units. Save the architecture, assumptions and prediction.

title: 安全資訊事件管理
summary: 以日誌正規化、事件關聯與可用性串連 16 個領域技術單元、32 個保存步驟；分析架構、原理、介面、故障、量化案例與防禦證據。
summaryEn: Sixteen domain-specific technical units and 32 saved steps connect log normalization, event correlation and availability through architecture, principles, interfaces, faults, quantitative cases and defensive evidence.

stages.title: 需求、元件與基本模型
stages.description: 四個領域技術單元各完成原理建模與對照證據，共八項可個別保存的作業。
stages.descriptionEn: Four domain units each pair principle modeling with controlled evidence, producing eight separately saved tasks.

steps.title: 來源盤點：架構與原理
steps.objective: 針對「來源盤點」建立有邊界、可反駁的系統模型。
steps.objectiveEn: For source inventory, construct a bounded falsifiable system model.
steps.instruction: 觀看師傅的功能示意後，以「來源盤點」為中心標出輸入、輸出、信任或資源邊界，並在學徒工作台排列資料流或元件。原理是：事件來源應有責任人、格式與健康指標。 使用自行編寫的兩組小型資料或試算表，建立基準與一次只改一項的對照：固定事件，只改時區及時間偏差。 先寫出可被反駁的預測；把「收集通道」視為相鄰問題，說明它如何影響模型而不能混同。數值只採本課假想算例或自訂並列明單位；本步保存架構圖、假設表與預測。
steps.instructionEn: After the mentor functional diagram, mark inputs, outputs and trust/resource boundaries around source inventory, then arrange components or data flows in the apprentice workspace. Principle: Sources need owners, formats and health indicators. Create two small authored datasets or spreadsheet cases: a baseline and a one-variable change. Fix events and vary timezones/clock offsets. Predict a falsifiable outcome before evaluating it. Treat collection channels as a neighboring issue and explain its influence without conflating them. Use only the stated hypothetical case or declared assumed inputs/units. Save the architecture, assumptions and prediction.
steps.observation: 固定事件，只改時區及時間偏差。 比較「來源盤點」與「收集通道」的證據是否支持相同推論。
steps.observationEn: Fix events and vary timezones/clock offsets. Compare whether evidence for source inventory and collection channels supports the same inference.
steps.failure: 把所有日誌集中便能自動判斷事故。 這是本課要排除的誤判；先核對模型邊界、來源版本及缺失證據。
steps.failureEn: Centralizing every log automatically identifies incidents. This is a misconception to reject; check boundaries, source versions and missing evidence.
steps.check: 提交「來源盤點」的功能草圖、基準／擾動表、單位或欄位定義、可反駁預測及接受／保留理由。需能重算本課假想例，並說明相鄰機制不可取代的驗證。
steps.checkEn: Submit a functional sketch, baseline/perturbation table, unit/field definitions, falsifiable prediction and accept/hold rationale for source inventory. Recompute the course case and explain verification that the neighboring mechanism cannot replace.

steps.instruction: 觀看師傅的功能示意後，以「存取稽核」為中心標出輸入、輸出、信任或資源邊界，並在學徒工作台排列資料流或元件。原理是：讀取敏感日誌也應有最小權限與記錄。 使用自行編寫的兩組小型資料或試算表，建立基準與一次只改一項的對照：模擬事件儲存中斷與緩衝回補。 先寫出可被反駁的預測；把「復原驗收」視為相鄰問題，說明它如何影響模型而不能混同。數值只採本課假想算例或自訂並列明單位；本步保存架構圖、假設表與預測。
steps.instructionEn: After the mentor functional diagram, mark inputs, outputs and trust/resource boundaries around access audits, then arrange components or data flows in the apprentice workspace. Principle: Sensitive-log access needs least privilege and auditing. Create two small authored datasets or spreadsheet cases: a baseline and a one-variable change. Model storage outage and buffered recovery. Predict a falsifiable outcome before evaluating it. Treat recovery acceptance as a neighboring issue and explain its influence without conflating them. Use only the stated hypothetical case or declared assumed inputs/units. Save the architecture, assumptions and prediction.
steps.observation: 模擬事件儲存中斷與緩衝回補。 比較「存取稽核」與「復原驗收」的證據是否支持相同推論。
steps.observationEn: Model storage outage and buffered recovery. Compare whether evidence for access audits and recovery acceptance supports the same inference.
steps.failure: 把所有日誌集中便能自動判斷事故。 這是本課要排除的誤判；先核對模型邊界、來源版本及缺失證據。
steps.failureEn: Centralizing every log automatically identifies incidents. This is a misconception to reject; check boundaries, source versions and missing evidence.
steps.check: 提交「存取稽核」的功能草圖、基準／擾動表、單位或欄位定義、可反駁預測及接受／保留理由。需能重算本課假想例，並說明相鄰機制不可取代的驗證。
steps.checkEn: Submit a functional sketch, baseline/perturbation table, unit/field definitions, falsifiable prediction and accept/hold rationale for access audits. Recompute the course case and explain verification that the neighboring mechanism cannot replace.

knowledge.title: 受控對照與證據品質
